items.name: Windbreak
items.description: Turns aside the gale, most blades, and precisely none of the existential vertigo.

items.name: Gilded Stilettos
items.description: It was completed despite unanimous hesitation, a compromise nobody is fully willing to defend.

items.name: Crownless Blade
items.description: Its purpose was reconsidered after it was finished, a small mercy, considering the alternative.

items.name: Groundwire
items.description: Grounds you, literally, to a world whose ground is a running joke. Mixed results.

items.name: Obsidian Core
items.description: The dense middle of a glass flow. Cut it wrong and the whole thing votes to become a thousand knives.

items.name: Hollow Shiv
items.description: Paired blades wound in grave-silk. The dead, as it turns out, have remarkably fine taste in handles.

items.name: Origin Crest
items.description: Marked with the line the world tore along, so the wearer never forgets which way is down. Down, here, being a direction with opinions.

items.name: Glacial Medallion
items.description: A medallion of pure frost crystal. Worth a fortune. Feels like a debt.

items.name: Riftbread
items.description: Whatever a Riftling eats between molts, dried and pressed into bars. Keeps for years. Tastes like the inside of a very old drawer.

items.name: Slothfur Fists
items.description: Marked with the old signal-code the pyre priests used. Fingers move faster than the reading does.

items.name: Basalt Knobstick
items.description: Maple, well floured, swung with the authority of someone who has waited up all night for you.

items.name: Feranpelt Cinch
items.description: Tanned from a Cinder Shade hide using a process that involves smoke, patience, and a working understanding of things that shouldn't still be warm. Holds more weight than it looks like it should.

items.name: Nightfang Daggers
items.description: Twin blades that vanish in shadow and reappear in spines. Chiropractors recommend them.

items.name: Bristlemail Gauntlets
items.description: Chain links threaded through boar bristles that refuse, on principle, to lie flat.

items.name: Wither Gaia
items.description: Wherever it walks, the flowers arrange themselves into something almost too lovely to call dying. A devoted pack animal, provided you've made peace with what it does to a garden by teatime.

items.name: Bearclaw Jerkin
items.description: Protects the vital organs. The non-vital ones are on their own.

items.name: Choir Hymnbread
items.description: Baked during a homily that refused to end. The crust set somewhere around the fourth hour.

items.name: Chitin Cutlass
items.description: Half chitin, half rusty metal. Surprisingly effective at making things regret getting close.

items.name: Woundgrip
items.description: Knuckle-plated in wound-glass that flakes a little with every strike. Alarming for the enemy; considered acceptable wear by everyone else.

items.name: Obsidian Cordial Choir
items.description: For cooking, the label insists. The cook insists otherwise.

items.name: Glacial Scepter
items.description: The crystal crowning it hasn't melted once, not through forge-heat, not through summer, not through spite. Handy for keeping a drink cold. Considerably more convincing on an enemy.

items.name: Green Mushroom
items.description: A sickly fungus whose pale verdure suggests it thrives on something other than sunlight.

items.name: Bearclaw Walkers
items.description: Every step leaves a print the size of a dinner plate. Subtlety was never the point.

items.name: Weaver's Silk Vest
items.description: Spun from weaver silk so fine it's almost invisible. The tailor charged double because, and I quote, 'you can't prove it's not there.'

items.name: Heartwood Spear
items.description: Shafted from a shaving cut straight off the world-tree's actual heart, which regrew within the week. The tree doesn't seem to mind lending out pieces of itself.

items.name: Primordial Totem Club
items.description: Carved by whoever prophesied here before the sundering made prophecy mostly redundant. The totem's face has worn smooth from being right too often.

items.name: Loosechange
items.description: Frozen crab armor that never thaws. Smiths work it in sub-zero forges, complaining the whole time.

items.name: Koagulant Wand
items.description: Pulses with sticky energy, healing wounds by coating them in something best not examined closely.

items.name: Wheat Flour
items.description: Some adventurers dream of legendary swords, others of crusty baguettes warm from the oven. The latter tend to live longer, if considerably less gloriously.

items.name: Bonelord's Flail
items.description: The bones are genuine. Bound with sinew from the thing that walked these marches. It swings heavier than physics allows; the smiths stopped asking.

items.name: Allweather Cinch
items.description: Works equally well in swamps, deserts, and tundra. Looks bad absolutely everywhere.

items.name: Lorito Cloak (Opal)
items.description: A parrot-feather cloak dyed to a gemstone hue. Loud, cheerful, and entirely cosmetic.

items.name: Resonant Pike
items.description: The head wore out three centuries back. The handle refuses retirement.

items.name: Ursine Ring
items.description: Your finger is now, legally speaking, a fortification.

items.name: Leafcharm Conduit
items.description: Crowned with a living kweebec leaf and wrapped in magmooligan wood. It hums when it's ignored.

items.name: Green Bread
items.description: Dense, doughy, and faintly luminescent — this mushroom bread sustains the body while testing the spirit. Some prisoners request it specifically, just to prove they've hit rock bottom.

items.name: Fingerbind
items.description: Fits every finger it's tried on so far — a fact the smith who made it never found reassuring.

items.name: Frostwolf Hauberk
items.description: You will never be cold again. You will also never be invited south again.

items.name: Riftmarrow
items.description: Drawn from the hollow of a Riftling bone, which is hollow because the Riftling is, in a structural sense, not entirely finished existing. One dose buys one clear decision.

items.name: Glassong Grips
items.description: Rubber to the elbow. The sink water here dissolves spoons, so they run a little thick.

items.name: Saurian Throwing Spear
items.description: Balanced more by drift-serpent instinct than by craft. Thrown once, it corrects its own course.

items.name: Ursinepulse
items.description: Weighs eight kilograms and still radiates warmth. Enchanters bind these into protection amulets. Bears did it for free.

items.name: Scrap Cuirass
items.description: Hammered from salvaged metal plates. The gaps are 'ventilation features' according to the smith. Sure they are.

items.name: Abyssgrown Signet
items.description: Its seal-face grew a pattern that changes slightly each time you look away, which no two witnesses have ever described the same.

items.name: Scarguard Helm
items.description: Standard-issue for whoever stands watch at the last wall, visor angled so the wearer never has to look directly at the Wound for long.

items.name: Fangs of the Abyss
items.description: Pulled from something that should have stayed sleeping at the bottom of the void. The handles still twitch sometimes.

items.name: Faded Spellbook
items.description: Half the pages are missing and the rest are smudged. Contains one legible spell: a grocery list from 200 years ago.

items.name: Undermoss
items.description: Moss that grows only where the first light still lands, and dies the instant it's shaded. Harvesters work fast and apologize to nobody in particular.

items.name: Duskbloom
items.description: A pale flower that opens only in full dark and shuts at the first hint of light, which makes gathering it a matter of feeling around and hoping.

items.name: Grizzly Stormcleaver
items.description: Bear claws for a crossguard, stormfeathers in the fuller. Beautiful. Deeply unbothered by your opinion.

items.name: Scarak Shellplate
items.description: Chitin plates harvested during molting season. The scaraks were furious, but also technically naked, so their protest lacked authority.

items.name: Copper Band
items.description: Turns your finger green after an hour. The jeweler insists it's 'patina' not 'copper poisoning'. Reassuring.

items.name: Antiphon Treads
items.description: Outdoor boots end at the porch. The cathedral is firm about this, and the lava respects tradition.

items.name: Rankfall
items.description: Every step lands like the verdict some Sundered Soldier court-martial never got to deliver. Slow, deliberate, and absolutely final, gravity permitting.

items.name: Hornhead Hatchet
items.description: Forged around a hornhead's broken horn. The hornhead wants it back but lacks the thumbs.

items.name: Vitrified Glaive
items.description: Long enough to brown bread over the great pyre without losing your eyebrows entirely. Entirely.

items.name: Molten Verse Hauberk Choir
items.description: Issued to whoever scrubs the vitrified floors. The stains have seniority.

items.name: Phantom Razors
items.description: So thin they barely exist. Victims only notice the cut when they try to pick something up and realize they have fewer fingers.

items.name: Totemfire Bastion Mace
items.description: Issued to whoever held the line last. That was a long time ago.

items.name: Groundwork
items.description: Built to stand where nothing else will. The 'nothing else' includes the ground.

items.name: Wraithwhisper Amulet
items.description: A translucent pendant that murmurs in a tongue you almost follow. Its last owner translated exactly one word before selling it off in a hurry: behind. Nobody since has requested a second.

items.name: Dawnwrap
items.description: Packed with moss that only opens at first light, so the wound underneath heals on a schedule the sun sets and you don't.

items.name: Hivewax Signet
items.description: Carved from royal jelly hardened in venom, it buzzes with disapproval at decisions the wearer hasn't made yet. You learn to stop asking how it knows. Every household has one relative like that.

items.name: Gecko Venom Lance
items.description: The wound is the easy part, over in a moment. What the gecko's venom leaves behind takes considerably longer to forgive you for showing up.

items.name: Tideplate
items.description: Forged in water too salt to drink and too fresh to preserve anything, a compromise the plate wears as a permanent, faint smell.

items.name: Windstrider Sandals
items.description: Open enough to drain fast. Wet feet dry quicker than heavy boots ever do.

items.name: Radiant
items.description: A primal hunter whose luminous fur blazes with the captured essence of celestial light.

items.name: Lorito Cloak (Amber)
items.description: A parrot-feather cloak dyed to a gemstone hue. Loud, cheerful, and entirely cosmetic.

items.name: Grave Dust
items.description: Fine grey powder from a hollow's bones. Necromancers pay well. Your reputation in town, however, will not recover.

items.name: Nave
items.description: Domed like a chapel roof, and about as good at keeping the congregation's opinions out.

items.name: Primordial Tonic
items.description: Steeped from the oldest living moss anyone's found, which regrows the moment it's picked and appears mildly annoyed to be brewed.

items.name: Cinder Cuirass
items.description: Lined with cinder heart fragments. Keeps you warm in the tundra and slightly on fire everywhere else.

items.name: Archaeoplume
items.description: A proto-feather from a creature still deciding, evolutionarily, whether it's a lizard or a bird.

items.name: Coda
items.description: The part of the song after everyone assumed it was over. Comes as a surprise. Always the last one.

items.name: Bearheart Signet
items.description: Set with a claw-fragment matching a Bear Patriarch's own in scale. Wear it long enough and you forget how to throw a punch — you just remember how to survive one.

items.name: Militia Breastplate
items.description: Standard issue for village guards who can't afford real armor. Deflects arrows if you believe in it hard enough.

items.name: Voidstaff Nihil
items.description: Carved from crystallized Voidmoth silence — the specific quiet between one wingbeat and the next. Casts spells that technically never happened, which the tax office has strong opinions about.

items.name: Maw Cleaver
items.description: Whoever made it changed their mind halfway through, which the maker calls character.

items.name: Rotgreave
items.description: Soft with rot in a way that turns out to move quietly, which is the only currency the fen respects.

items.name: Skyheld Halberd
items.description: It was completed despite unanimous hesitation, so the original argument was declared a draw.

items.name: Suize Bricheton
items.description: Its crystal tusks chime in the wind, in a melody every other bricheton finds deeply personal.

items.name: Widow's Mandate
items.description: Wrapped in widow silk that hardens on impact. The spiders didn't volunteer their silk.

items.name: Koa Eye Legguards
items.description: One Cinder Shade knelt a century at the same forge; the knee plates carry that wear. Good for hauling uphill. For kneeling anywhere else — never again.

items.name: Fengland Greaves
items.description: Half-earthen, half-oceanic. Each half is convinced the other one is just for show.

items.name: Draconic Bricheton
items.description: A scaled warthog that looks at you like it's the dragon and you're the reincarnation joke.

items.name: Sunfossil
items.description: Smells like a forest that died a very long time ago and is still bitter about it.

items.name: Barley Hardtack
items.description: Military rations that outlast the soldiers who carry them. Jewelers use the crumbs as polishing abrasive.

items.name: Courtcinch
items.description: Its court buckle corroded into an abstract shape that means nothing now, which is more honest than what it meant before.

items.name: Silk Tunic
items.description: Woven by cave-dwelling spiders who work exclusively in total darkness and total silence.

items.name: Ring of the Worldeater
items.description: Pried from a socket too large to be a finger and worn anyway, on a chain instead. The Worldeater ate seven worlds before anyone checked whether it was simply hungry. Nobody has checked since.

items.name: Needle-Drop Gland
items.description: Tiny but potent. The venom isn't lethal to humans but it will ruin your entire week. Apothecaries love them.

items.name: Antiphon Visor Voices
items.description: Slotted so twelve narrow views become one. It is still, somehow, a worse view.

items.name: Rotstock
items.description: Stock left to rot to exactly the right degree, a window the master crafters guard jealously and the apprentices ruin routinely.

items.name: Glacial Signet
items.description: Carved from a glacier's heart-crystal. It deadens whichever finger it rides on, which the maker swears is a feature.

items.name: Razlord Trophy Belt
items.description: Hung with tokens taken off things that no longer needed them. Heavier every season.

items.name: Blastpowder
items.description: Homemade explosive compound. Goblins measure quantities by vibes. Survival rates reflect this methodology.

items.name: Barley
items.description: A humble sheaf of pale green barley, its grains plump with the promise of bread or beer.

items.name: Hornhead Legplates
items.description: The hornhead whose horn adorns these legplates charged seventeen times before the blacksmith got the hint. The eighteenth charge was the hornhead's last, and the blacksmith's finest hour.

items.name: Finlash
items.description: Emerald and venomous. The color is doing the warning label's job for free.

items.name: Hadean Gate Key
items.description: Cut from a tooth pulled from something that used to watch this gate before the Gate Watchers took over the shift. Holding it makes your molars ache in sympathy. Nobody's explained why yet.

items.name: Barrowbone
items.description: Pulled from the lowest layer of the oldest barrow. Older than any name still recorded there.

items.name: Epoch Cleaver
items.description: Standard-issue after the third muster. Nobody asks where the second went.

items.name: Bag of Cursed Gems
items.description: The bag whispers your deepest fears. Mostly about inventory management and weight limits.

items.name: Widowshell
items.description: Exoskeleton plate from the white widow herself. Darker than obsidian and twice as hard. Armorers weep with joy.

items.name: Lastwhisper
items.description: Carries a spell so old the syllables have worn smooth. Whatever it originally said, it still works.

items.name: Zukin Muru Cowl
items.description: A shinobi cowl for people who want to look like they left quietly, even when they slam the door.

items.name: Boglure
items.description: Attracts prey. Repels literally everyone else, including its own species, at range.

items.name: Fincoil
items.description: Every leatherworker wants one. Fewer fingers come back per attempt than you'd hope.

items.name: Moonclad Visor
items.description: Plated in Moonclaw shell that catches what moonlight makes it this deep, which is almost none, so it mostly just reminds you there used to be a moon.

items.name: Skywalkers
items.description: Not the flying kind. The 'the ground left and you're improvising' kind.

items.name: Mirecinder
items.description: A core hardened over cold bog-fire, which leaves it dense and quietly wrong to the touch, a feel that never quite goes away.

items.name: Bristlemail Warhelm
items.description: Standard issue for soldiers who haven't done anything to earn a cooler hat yet.

items.name: Lorito Cloak (Garnet)
items.description: A parrot-feather cloak dyed to a gemstone hue. Loud, cheerful, and entirely cosmetic.

items.name: Cracked Bone
items.description: A femur that's seen better centuries, surprisingly solid despite the cracks. Dogs still want it. So do necromancers.

items.name: Shadowsteel Shard
items.description: Broken from armor where the darkness wasn't decoration but load-bearing structure. Smiths handle it with tongs, a prayer, and the specific caution of people who've heard what happens to those who skip the prayer.

items.name: Anglerkey
items.description: Slick with weald damp that never dries, faintly warm the way anglerlight is warm right before it isn't. The Anglerdeep Matron keeps better track of these than she lets on.

items.name: Wheat Bricheton
items.description: A miniature warthog that has imprinted on wheat fields and considers your inventory an extension of its territory.

items.name: Totem of the Wee Folk
items.description: Carved from Kweebec elder-wood by hands so small the tool marks look like calligraphy. The totem depicts a creature that the Kweebec refuse to name, describe, or acknowledge exists. They do, however, charge handsomely for its likeness.

items.name: Duke's Regalia
items.description: Engraved with a crest of two goblins fighting over one coin. Neither goblin wins.

items.name: Rex Stompers
items.description: Reinforced with rex bone. Every step sounds like a minor earthquake. Subtlety was never the plan.

items.name: Vitrified Stompers
items.description: Every footfall taps like a struck goblet. You are, at all times, announcing yourself.

items.name: Bag of Blood Wheat
items.description: It throbs, faintly, on a schedule nobody's identified. Unsettling in a grain sack. Considerably worse in luggage you were planning to sleep next to.

items.name: Silversteel Saber
items.description: Gleams in any light available. Attracts attention, mostly the kind you were trying to avoid.

items.name: Cocoon King's Chain
items.description: A golden silk chain still warm from the cocoon it was cut from. The King never asks for it back out loud. He doesn't have to; the wearer's thoughts get quieter every day.

items.name: Bara Hood (Ruby)
items.description: A plain hooded cowl offered in a spread of gemstone linings. Cheap, honest, everywhere.

items.name: Deepdraw
items.description: Pulled from as far down the fault as a rope and a brave idiot will reach.

items.name: Feranpelt Leggings
items.description: Cut from the Cinder Shade that stood still until the ground memorized its shape. Agility drains out through the soles; endurance floods in to replace it. Running stops being on the menu.

items.name: Bag of Quartz
items.description: Fifty pieces of cloudy crystal rattling around like a sack of broken promises.

items.name: Cinderchoir Cincture Vitrified
items.description: A tailor ribbon marked in thumbs and handspans. It has measured three emperors and lied to all of them.

items.name: Crownrot Helm Godbone
items.description: The instructions were lost in a heated debate, and the wearer decided long ago to take it on faith.

items.name: Shadowsteel Visor
items.description: The eye slit stays deliberately narrow. Shadow knights consider peripheral vision a moral failing.

items.name: Voidpiercer
items.description: Pierces the void between dimensions. Also useful for kebabs at interdimensional cookouts.

items.name: Rat Skin Trousers
items.description: A patchwork garment fashioned from rodent hides, each seam telling the story of a desperate struggle beneath the city streets. Wearing them is proof that dignity is the first casualty of poverty.

items.name: Longreach
items.description: Extends the wielder's range past the point most opponents consider fair. Fairness was never part of the brief.

items.name: Silkweave Treads
items.description: Issued to whoever draws the furthest post. The walk back is longer than the walk out.

items.name: Frostkoa Cleaver
items.description: Forged in ice-frog bile, the blade sheds a cold sweat that refuses to freeze even down here. It never asks for sympathy. It gets some anyway.

items.name: Scalehide Cinch
items.description: Weighted to keep footing on ground that shifts underfoot. The marsh always shifts.

items.name: Choirforged Greatblade
items.description: Brought out when the roast is whole and the family is seated. The roast is rarely the only thing carved.

items.name: Pawhide
items.description: One hide, one full armor set, one bear who is filing a complaint in the afterlife.

items.name: Frostwolf Mitts
items.description: Your hands stay warm. Everyone you shake hands with stays reminded who's in charge.

items.name: Goblin Hoard Seal
items.description: Given to whoever survives the muster roll intact. Rotates more than it should.

items.name: Quillcrown
items.description: A crown that has forgotten what it crowns. It sits uneasily, unconvinced of its own authority or purpose.

items.name: Null Essence
items.description: Liquid absence that dissolves container walls if stored too long. Enchanters pay obscene prices. Storage is your problem.

items.name: Feranpelt Stompers
items.description: Broken in by runners who carried word faster than the war moved.

items.name: Ossuary
items.description: Somehow still liquid after centuries in a skeleton. Tastes like sadness and old copper. Please don't ask how we know.

items.name: Hayate Helm
items.description: Swift-wind steel. Light enough to run in, loud enough to be heard coming.

items.name: Glowsteel
items.description: Metal seeded with ghost-cap spores that keep it faintly aglow, warm to work and impossible to lose track of on a dark bench.

items.name: Fenrot Greatblade
items.description: Left in the fen long enough to pit and scar, which the smith reframed as character and priced up accordingly.

items.name: Zenithglass
items.description: An alloy that only takes at the highest forge on the mountain, where the air is thin enough that the smiths swear it stops arguing with them. It holds an edge nothing lower can match.

items.name: Hivewax
items.description: Amber and waterproof, harvested from hive chambers the scarak abandoned mid-argument.

items.name: Seraph Chain
items.description: It was approved on a split decision, which explains the crossed-out warranty clause.

items.name: Omendraught
items.description: Ash Prophets brew this the night before a cataclysm they've already seen and can't unsee. It doesn't prevent anything. It just steadies the hand that has to watch.

items.name: Ensable Beach Key
items.description: Insert it wrong and the lock fills with obsidian. Fortune favors the careful.

items.name: Silkwalker Treads
items.description: Virtually silent footwear spun from cave spider silk. Perfect for stealth, terrible for announcing your presence at dinner parties. The silk sometimes sticks to surfaces, which is either a design flaw or the spider's final act of revenge.

items.name: Terminal Cordial
items.description: Kept in the wall infirmary for the cases past mending, then found to work embarrassingly well on the cases that weren't. Reputation adjusted accordingly.

items.name: Bark Grimoire
items.description: Pages made of pressed bark. The spells are mostly drawings of angry sheep.

items.name: Grimoire of Embers
items.description: Each spell cast singes a page pulled from a Cinder Shade's own molted hide-parchment. Finish the book and you'll have memorized the Shade's temperament along with the incantations.

items.name: Mothhush
items.description: Wingdust from a moth that flies without a sound it's ever willing to make. Alchemists prize it for exactly that reason. The moth has never once explained why.

items.name: Wealdstring
items.description: Strung taut enough to loose an arrow silently through the weald's thick dark, where sound carries further than sight ever does. The pack hunts by ear down here; so should you.

items.name: Void Eye Lens
items.description: A crystallized lens from a Void Eye. Sees into parallel dimensions. Most of them are worse than this one, somehow.

items.name: Cursed Gem Cactee
items.description: Mutters dark prophecies about inventory weight while loyally carrying your stuff. Conflicted creature.

items.name: Farinanivalis
items.description: The pinnacle of milling, ground from grain so rare that the flour itself judges the bakers who attempt to use it.

items.name: Wound Pilgrim Boots
items.description: Soled for the long climb to the Wound and, less often, for the walk back down. Most pairs only ever make the one trip.

items.name: Elorie's Spines
items.description: Cultivated by someone named Elorie for cruelty, not mercy. History hasn't recorded which one won.

items.name: The Ember King's Latch
items.description: Legend has the Ember King minting one true key from his own banked heart-fire, too hot for mortal hands to hold bare. This is not that key. It is, several smiths swear, close enough.

items.name: Kraken Ink
items.description: Harvested from the Kraken's deepest glands. Writes prophecies. Also just regular grocery lists. It's not picky.

items.name: Bone Charm Necklace
items.description: Small bones threaded on a cord. Looks either tribal-chic or serial-killer-chic depending on your outfit.

items.name: Saltweave
items.description: Layered stock cured in salt water, which leaves it stronger and stranger, prone to a smell that intensifies right when you'd rather it didn't.

items.name: Arcanite Pickaxe
items.description: Shatters reality-hardened minerals like a tax collector shatters dreams. The vein doesn't stand a chance.

items.name: Bloodveil
items.description: A crimson orchid whose petals weep a sap so dark it stains anything it touches, including your reputation as a serious herbalist.

items.name: Siltgrip
items.description: Caked in silt that hardens over the knuckles, so the first punch also delivers a fistful of the weald floor.

items.name: Goblin Duke's Signet
items.description: Nobility, goblin-style: awarded for how many peers you've personally shoved downstairs.

items.name: Convergence Pendant
items.description: Two gems, one setting, one ongoing argument about whose sunrise counts.

items.name: Tusk Bludgeon
items.description: A tusklet ivory club. The tusklet died of natural causes. Naturally, you caused them.

items.name: Matronweave
items.description: Wound from the Matron's own thread, which holds a knot no human hand tied and will not be talked out of it.

items.name: Woolano
items.description: The perfect accessory for heroes who prefer their jewelry machine-washable.

items.name: Frostclaw Warhelm
items.description: Forged from titan claw chitin and tempered in glacier runoff. The cold never bothered it. You, however, will shiver.

items.name: Glimmerdust
items.description: Powdered magical residue that jewelers sprinkle on accessories to make them glow ominously. Fashion meets function, barely.

items.name: Elixir of Intelligence
items.description: Sharpens the mind for an hour and the ego for considerably longer.

items.name: Ringfast
items.description: Doesn't come off. This was explained to every buyer, clearly, before the sale. Most buy it anyway.

items.name: Brackish Legguards Throne
items.description: Recovered from a courtier who sat too long in the drowned hall, and are, technically, still sitting.

items.name: Sabertooth Sandals
items.description: Leaves no tracks. Mostly because you never touch the ground long enough to make one.

items.name: Warspoils
items.description: Severed goblin auditory organs, still slick with ichor and reeking of the creatures' infamous hygiene.

items.name: Twelvefold
items.description: The choir has twelve voices. This settles arguments with all of them at once.

items.name: Bear Claw Ring
items.description: The bear fought for this. It lost. Mostly on a technicality.

items.name: Butcher's Talon
items.description: Curved, razor-sharp, and still warm. Weaponsmiths forge these into daggers. The raptor used it as a can opener.

items.name: Firewater
items.description: One swallow and your ears ring, your eyes water, and your wounds close out of sheer intimidation.

items.name: Firstlit
items.description: Plated over soles the smiths swear were the first ever cut. Whether or not that's true, they walk like they have nothing left to prove.

items.name: Chokepoint
items.description: Sits exactly where a throat narrows to nothing. The jeweler who designed it insists that's a coincidence.

items.name: Toll of the Pilgrim
items.description: The cheap draught sold at the foot of the climb to anyone who thinks a bottle will make the mountain shorter. It won't. It helps a little with the parts that hurt.

items.name: Quillfeather
items.description: An iridescent black feather that quill makers pay well for. The crow's ghost will haunt your pen strokes. Allegedly.

items.name: Venomweave Legguards
items.description: Saturated in toxins that are mostly, technically, probably harmless to you specifically.

items.name: Wooligan's Hammer
items.description: The wooligan used it to flatten grass. You found a more creative purpose.

items.name: Frostwolf Leggings
items.description: Soft as a den. Armored as a siege. The pack contains multitudes.

items.name: Frostshell Grimoire
items.description: Bound in frozen crab shell. It introduces itself before it introduces frostbite.

items.name: Glasswrought Brew
items.description: Stewed on the stovetop since dawn. Strong enough to argue with.

items.name: Meltpoint
items.description: Alchemical flux that lowers the melting point of rare metals. Weapon smiths literally cannot forge high-tier gear without it.

items.name: Hiveguard Hammer
items.description: Sealed against fire and flood both, the way the old tales say the Combmother's favorites always are. The scarak approve of it, in the grudging way an old aunt approves of a wedding she didn't arrange.

items.name: Truffle Gaia
items.description: A Gaia whose nose was refined so far past reasonable that it now finds you personally offensive.

items.name: Marrowbone Legplates
items.description: Bone-white iron from the undying forges below, where the smiths never speak a word while they work. Peaceful, until you remember exactly why they've gone quiet.

items.name: Splitfang
items.description: Two blades grown from the same Riftling molt, still arguing about which one is the original. The gap between them is exactly where an opponent's plan stops fitting.

items.name: Silkgarrote
items.description: Gossamer-thin, absurdly strong. Spun by something that eats prey four sizes north of sensible.

items.name: Void Whisper
items.description: Fires arrows that don't exist until they arrive. Quantum archery is a liability disclaimer waiting to happen.

items.name: Goblin Cleaver
items.description: Stolen from a goblin who insisted it was a family heirloom. It was not.

items.name: Aberrant Edge
items.description: Forged wrong. The steel bends instead of breaks. Command it carefully—it answers to angles, not strength.

items.name: Gilded Brew
items.description: The recipe was argued over more than it was brewed, which the brewer insists was intentional.

items.name: Aloe Gaia
items.description: A medicinal variant, oozing a soothing sap that treats small cuts, sunburn, and wounded pride. Every scratch gets treated like a mortal wound — it hovers anxiously until the concern is acknowledged. The sap tastes awful, which it insists is preventative.

items.name: Geckoscale Leggings
items.description: The gecko's tail grew back within the week. Your reputation may take considerably longer.

items.name: Chitin Walkers
items.description: These boots wriggle with each step, for the chitin plates are merely a shell for the creatures living within.

items.name: Kneebreakers
items.description: Reinforced at the joint where three prior pairs failed. The wearer walks fine. Everyone else finds that suspicious.

items.name: Runic Blade
items.description: Runes run the length of the blade, and no two scholars agree what they say. The enchanter insists it's an old dialect. The smith insists it's just decoration he liked the look of. Nobody consulted the blade.

items.name: Infested Legguards
items.description: These greaves writhe with colonies of parasitic growth, the chitinous mesh having long since bonded with the iron beneath.

items.name: Rex Hunter's Longbow
items.description: Designed specifically for rex hunting. The rex hunters who tested it were never seen again, but the bow came back.

items.name: Leather Treatment
items.description: Chemical bath that turns raw hides into supple crafting leather. Tanners cannot function without a steady supply of this.

items.name: Practice Longsword
items.description: A blunted training blade. The only thing it cuts is your dignity when someone sees you wielding it.

items.name: Tin Cap
items.description: A doll-sized dome that trades brains for bounce. You will outlive your own good ideas.

items.name: Ectoplasm Chain
items.description: Each link is a separate Cinder Shade ember, cooled and joined by someone with more patience than sense. Getting them to glow in unison takes a very particular kind of stillness.

items.name: Faultcore
items.description: The dense knot left where a quake spent itself. Warm, patient, still deciding whether it's done.

items.name: Solutiarcana
items.description: Endgame alchemical reagent pulsing with raw magical potential. One drop on bare skin causes temporary synesthesia.

items.name: Duke's Ceremonial Sash
items.description: Worn to every execution he personally didn't attend. Optics matter.

items.name: Orchid-Spore Blend
items.description: Ground orchid petals blended with crushed spores in a process that smells worse than the result tastes.

items.name: Standing Wave
items.description: A frozen ripple of stone caught mid-collapse. It looks temporary. It has looked temporary for centuries.

items.name: Minor Healing Brew
items.description: A tepid green sludge that heals paper cuts and bruised egos. Tastes like regret with a hint of moss.

items.name: Feran Stalker Trousers
items.description: Fur below, feather-down lining above. Deeply unsettling in a mirror, somehow perfect in motion.

items.name: Emberchant Hand Axe
items.description: Light enough to hurl, nasty enough to hang onto. That choice haunts every fight.

items.name: Guardian's Verdict
items.description: Wielded by the Last Guardian on the rare occasion words aren't enough. Everyone who's seen it swung agrees: words weren't going to be enough anyway.

items.name: Grizzly Jawbreaker
items.description: Studded with fangs and wrapped in stolen fleece. Amplifies every grudge behind the swing.

items.name: Fenrot Gauntlets
items.description: The rot ate the fine motor control years ago. What's left is a grip that has genuinely never once let go, on purpose or otherwise.

items.name: Heartwood Caller
items.description: Carved from weald heartwood that still answers when knocked on, in a language nobody's translated yet. The Moss Bears seem to understand it fine.

items.name: Silkspinner Greaves
items.description: Scored where the kneeling happens. The marsh takes its toll on posture.

items.name: Jones
items.description: Pray its appetite for worship exceeds its appetite for its own keeper's fingers.

items.name: Embergrip
items.description: Forged near the end of everything, when the smiths stopped decorating and started just making things that would hold. These hold.

items.name: Raptor Javelin
items.description: Tipped with a raptor claw that has seen better days. And worse prey.

items.name: Frozen Tear of the Leviathan
items.description: A single crystallized tear shed by a frost dragon during what witnesses describe as an emotional disagreement with a glacier. The tear never melts, never warms, and has been known to make drinks uncomfortably cold from across the room. Alchemists have tried to study it, but their instruments keep freezing shut.

items.name: Retarded Daggers
items.description: They say the village idiot made these. The village idiot disagrees, claiming he has standards.

items.name: Stitched Trousers
items.description: Double-stitched for durability. The tailor was so proud they signed it on the inside. In visible ink, poorly.

items.name: Boneherald's Oath
items.description: Sworn on bones that predate every crown ever melted down for a better one. The oath, everyone agrees, is unbreakable. The sword itself, the herald will remind you, is still very much for sale.

items.name: Razmaster's Grudge
items.description: Taken off a barrow rat that had clearly been bitten first.

items.name: Nexus Blade
items.description: Forged at the causeway where three roads meet the dead. It still hums at dusk.

items.name: Embalmed Club
items.description: Every swing wakes something that was sleeping for a very good reason.

items.name: Cinder Litany
items.description: An endless scroll of housework. Read aloud, it makes the dust rearrange itself out of sheer guilt.

items.name: Diadem Cordial
items.description: The label lists an ingredient nobody can identify, a fact quietly omitted from the label.

items.name: Reckoning of the End
items.description: The last helm the wall's armory ever forged, because after this altitude there is no next size up, and no next wearer expected to need one.

items.name: Scarrion
items.description: Iron pulled straight from the exposed rock of the Scar, still holding the cold of the depth it came from. Smiths let it warm before working it, out of respect and mild self-preservation.

items.name: Backbone
items.description: Plated along the spine first, on the sound theory that a standing corpse still counts as holding the line.

items.name: Pawrelic
items.description: Recently attached to a much larger, much less cooperative bear.

items.name: Wooligan Hat
items.description: Guaranteed to keep the head warm, though sadly not the brain inside it.

items.name: Hymnbound Core
items.description: Waxed kindling brick from the sexton private stash. Lights first time, which here counts as a miracle.

items.name: Orchid Gaia
items.description: A gentle spirit of the earth, bound to safeguard the land's treasures from those who would plunder them recklessly.

items.name: Basalt Core
items.description: The unmelted centre of a lava bomb. Cold on the outside, still deciding on the inside. Do not rush it.

items.name: Feran Whiskered Grips
items.description: Feran-fur lined and taloned to match. The ferans have not forgiven the tailor.

items.name: Reaver's Visage
items.description: Worn by polar reavers who patrol the ice wastes. The frost runes carved into it are purely decorative. Mostly.

items.name: Ocean Sigil
items.description: Carved coral bearing talokan runes. Scholars have decoded three of the nine. The other six are worse.

items.name: Zenith Staff
items.description: Cut from a shard of the zenith's original peak, before the Scar took the rest of it. It points true toward whatever's left standing.

items.name: Diadem Casque Godbone
items.description: The craftsmanship is sound; the premise is not, which is exactly as reassuring as it sounds.

items.name: Koa Eye Striders
items.description: Infused with Koa essence. The eyes on the buckles follow you around the room. Politely.

items.name: Silkwinder Lance
items.description: Wrapped in spider silk that makes it whistle through the air. Enemies hear it coming but cannot agree on which direction.

items.name: Tanjirize
items.description: Golden stalks harvested from the demon slayer's ancestral fields, still humming with the warmth of a sun that never truly sets.

items.name: Infested Sash
items.description: Pulsing veins run through the tainted fabric as if the garment itself were somehow still alive and digesting. Wearing it constitutes an intimate relationship with disease.

items.name: Frostshamble Treads
items.description: Leaves footprints that keep shuffling for a few steps after you've stopped.

items.name: Frostwolf Fang Ring
items.description: Bites back when you try to take it off. The pack does not forget insults.

items.name: Tarnished Torc
items.description: An amulet that grants action point by accident, not design. Its bearer cannot decide if they've been blessed or burdened.

items.name: Doomhammer Eternal
items.description: The hammer a Sundered Soldier's line used to end arguments, combats, and eventually its own service record. Still swings like the argument isn't quite over.

items.name: Farwalker
items.description: Built for a distance nobody's supposed to need at the wall. Somebody clearly needed it anyway.

items.name: Coronet Edge
items.description: Its behavior contradicts its own description, a footnote the maker kept postponing until it stopped mattering.

items.name: Concussion
items.description: Named clinically by whoever it last hit, in the brief window before they forgot how language works.

items.name: Riven Saber
items.description: Cut from a Riftling's own severed limb-blade, still keening faintly at the frequency of the rift it came from. Coroners describe the sound it makes on impact as 'unhelpful.'

items.name: Creeping Fen-Moss
items.description: Toxic swamp moss that thrives on fen creatures. Herbalists use it in poison remedies. Irony is not lost on them.

items.name: Primordial Cleaver
items.description: Older than most of the doctrines it was used to end. The grip runs warm for reasons the prophet who carried it never explained and the current owner has stopped asking about.

items.name: Bannerscrap
items.description: Torn from the ashen standard before it fell. The line it marked has not been reassembled since.

items.name: Glacial Basinet
items.description: A helmet so cold it fogs up from the inside. Visibility optional, survival mandatory.

items.name: Crown Dust
items.description: It was catalogued twice, under two different theories, by a committee that has since disbanded.

items.name: Vitrified Lattice
items.description: A frozen web of molten strands. Handle it by the thick parts; the thin parts handle you.

items.name: Riftsteel
items.description: Forged in the seam where two worlds grind. It remembers the pressure and holds a grudge.

items.name: Ironjaw
items.description: Built to keep the wearer's teeth where they started the fight. A modest ambition, rarely met at this altitude.

items.name: Kamui Cloak
items.description: A cloak cut from something that should not have had a hide. It remembers being worn by worse.

items.name: Chantmarked Warbelt Choir
items.description: The line the song keeps coming back to. Buckle it on and you keep coming back too. Annoyingly.

items.name: Canopylore
items.description: Its pages are pressed ghost-cap, legible only in the dark they glow in, which makes the deep weald the one place you can actually read it.

items.name: Kweebec Leaf Locket
items.description: Carved from a totem the Sky Matron guarded longer than Pandora Reach has had a name.

items.name: Bag of Phantom Spores
items.description: Fifty spores that are only sometimes there, the way a promise is only sometimes kept. Count them twice. Count them a third time out of spite. The number will not agree with itself.

items.name: Faultbrew
items.description: Steeped from Gate Watcher marrow-salt, drunk by sentries who count breaches instead of sheep. It mends the small wounds first — the big ones, it reckons, can wait their turn.

items.name: Titanmoss
items.description: Moss that grew in the living fur of a titan bear. Infused with centuries of apex predator energy. Druids go feral.

items.name: Pearl Shard
items.description: A cracked pearl fragment from inside a hermit crab's shell. Worth something to jewelers, nothing to the crab.

items.name: Hornhead Plate
items.description: The hornhead charged into battle headfirst. This is what's left of that plan.

items.name: Scale Plate
items.description: A thick reptile scale the size of a dinner plate. Armorers love it. The raptor is less enthusiastic about the arrangement.

items.name: Plaguefang Blade
items.description: Tempered in extract drawn from a plague fang, with an edge that's gone a colour metallurgists have strong, worried opinions about. It cuts fine. It's the aftercare nobody wants to discuss.

items.name: Scar Maul
items.description: Quarried from Scar-stone heavy enough that swinging it feels like the last argument the wound will ever need to hear.

items.name: Padded Boots
items.description: Extra padding for when you step on things you shouldn't. Which, in this world, is basically everything.

items.name: Floodmark
items.description: Marked at the exact height the water rose the night the weald took the lower tiers, worn as a reminder and, occasionally, a warning.

items.name: Basalt Crest Antiphon
items.description: Wearing it does not make you invisible at the party. It does stop the drips of burning wax.

items.name: Anglerlight
items.description: Rendered from Anglerqueen lure-glands, faintly luminous even in the bottle. Best swallowed before it starts attracting things.

items.name: Haloforged Circle
items.description: It works on the honor system, which the maker calls character.

items.name: Wealdwarden
items.description: Carried by whoever the weald's packs respect enough not to test alone. Solo use is technically possible. The weald does not recommend it.

items.name: Tide Throne Key
items.description: Cast in coral that only hardens below the tideline. The Drowned Regent still holds court down there, and still expects it back.

items.name: Chitin-Shell Cinch
items.description: Beetle plates that interlock like a puzzle built by a bug with no hobbies and no friends. It cinches on its own, still obeying the hive's final order: squeeze.

items.name: Chittin Hoe
items.description: A rustic farming tool reinforced with jagged blue antennae, their sensory hairs still twitching with residual reflex.

items.name: Bag of Arcanize
items.description: Purple luminescence seeps through the stitching. The grain inside hums at a frequency that gives nearby cats a crisis.

items.name: Milled Shadow of the Deep
items.description: So dark it makes true shadow look sunlit by comparison. Cosmetic sellers tried it exactly once, the story goes, and the customer was never seen leaving the shop in daylight again.

items.name: Rex Knuckle Guards
items.description: Reinforced with rex fang fragments on the knuckles. Punching things now counts as prehistoric.

items.name: Courtwake
items.description: Court footwear built for standing perfectly still on ceremony, now perfect for standing perfectly still while something large passes.

items.name: Blizzard Tassets
items.description: Thorium leg plates crusted with frost crystals. Every step sounds like breaking glass.

items.name: Oathbreaker's Penance
items.description: Forged from promises nobody kept. Every swing is an apology that showed up far too late.

items.name: Beast Hauler's Sash
items.description: Cinched by whoever dragged the salvage carts. Frayed exactly where the rope sat.

items.name: Halo Striders
items.description: These boots dispute the concept of walking. They believe movement is a matter of philosophical opinion rather than physical fact.

items.name: Zenith Greaves
items.description: Plated to survive the climb up the fractured peak, joints reinforced where most pilgrims' knees give out first.

items.name: Hollow Judge
items.description: Wound in grave-silk, notched with old rulings. Mercy was never part of the design.

items.name: Pyreward Diadem
items.description: Warm on the brow at all hours. On the day it runs cold, run too.

items.name: Brackish Edge
items.description: The salt-water quench left it just corroded enough to hurt in ways a clean cut doesn't, which the weald counts as a feature.

items.name: Wornleaf
items.description: Cites a source that no longer exists, for a claim nobody's been able to disprove either.

items.name: Kindling
items.description: Carved from wood the wound never finished burning. It still remembers the shape of the fire.

items.name: Stormhawk's Reach
items.description: Built from a stormhawk's own tailfeathers strung on mithril wire. The archer takes the credit. The wind, if it could talk, would have several corrections to make.

items.name: Frostmaw Waraxe
items.description: Frostshell plates on the blade, glacial heart in the pommel. The weight trains your arms. The cold trains your resolve.

items.name: Chipped Axe
items.description: The blade has more chips than a bag of crisps. Each swing sends fragments flying. Natural AoE.

items.name: Obsidian Flux
items.description: Caustic paste that strips soot, varnish and fingerprints. Mind which of those you still wanted.

items.name: Crabclaw Cowl
items.description: Crab shells rattle faintly in combat. Veterans call it 'the applause'. It is not applause.

items.name: Gravedigger's Choice
items.description: The last gravedigger kept this. Seven hundred graves and counting. The work doesn't stop, so the tool doesn't rust.

items.name: Ageclosure
items.description: Plated in the pale metal that only forms where the first dawn still reaches. There is less of that surface every year, and the smiths have noticed.

items.name: Crystal Focus Staff
items.description: Mounted with a fractured shard that bends every spell toward wherever it likes best, which is rarely wherever you were pointing. The old mages call this 'character.' Everyone downrange calls it something shorter.

items.name: Moltcast
items.description: Holds a grudge the way a Riftling's shell holds a crack: slowly, then all at once, then permanently. Downhill swings are recommended. Uphill swings are also technically possible.

items.name: Surimi Relic
items.description: This sacred remnant of the Surimi pulses with ancient power, its surface worn smooth by the reverent touch of pilgrims long dead. Strange that holiness should feel so suspiciously like processed seafood.

items.name: Hivewax Cleaver
items.description: Cut from sun-warmed scale and sealed in amber wax, it hums a note the woolice have learned to fear before they see the blade. A useful reputation. Rarely an earned one, the shepherds mutter.

items.name: Embercore Rod
items.description: Crowned with an ember that refuses to die, much like the mage carrying it.

items.name: Spectral Ruin
items.description: Forged from a Voidmoth carapace thin enough to see through in the right light, and thin enough to cut with in any light at all. The ghosts of its previous owners occasionally offer unsolicited advice.

items.name: Jade Cactee
items.description: Remarkably serene for a walking cactus. Meditates at inappropriate times like during combat.

items.name: Feranpelt Striders
items.description: Each step sinks half an inch and rises clean. The marsh hasn't learned to keep them yet.

items.name: Scalegrain
items.description: Requires fireproof gloves to knead. The resulting loaf has, on occasion, growled back.

items.name: Forgedross
items.description: What the furnace spits out once it's decided it's finished with something. Miners keep it anyway — waste, the old saying goes, is just ore that hasn't been asked nicely.

items.name: Final Draft
items.description: The smith's last creation before retirement. The retirement was not voluntary.

items.name: Moonhusk
items.description: A neck-ring of pale shell that the court wore to catch moonlight through a hall now a hundred feet under silt. It has caught none since.

items.name: Slabcrust
items.description: Less bread, more building material. Armorsmiths grind it into gap filler and never look back.

items.name: Jade
items.description: Green enough to make an emerald jealous, yet somehow cheaper than a tavern meal.

items.name: Drownmarked Elixir
items.description: Bears the pale tideline of everything the deep weald has touched, which the label lists as a mark of authenticity and the wise read as a mark of where it's been.

items.name: Yeti Scalp Hood
items.description: Smells like something that was definitely, probably, almost certainly real.

items.name: Halfmarch
items.description: Left greave and right greave were forged from two different Sundered Soldiers who never served in the same era. They still don't fully agree on the marching order.

items.name: Scaled Hide
items.description: Tiny overlapping scales that catch the light. Leatherworkers stitch dozens together and complain the entire time.

items.name: Feran Stalker Gloves
items.description: The fur stands on end when prey draws close — and also in thunderstorms, near campfires, and the instant its wearer lies. A hunting glove and a conscience, sewn into one pelt whether you asked for the second part or not.

items.name: Hadean Ice
items.description: Ice from before the sun existed that doesn't melt and has outlived galaxies. You are an inconvenience.

items.name: Moonclad Tonic Matron
items.description: Bottled under the pale shell that keeps it cool, the closest thing to moonlit water anyone brews this far below.

items.name: Shark Leather Belt
items.description: Rough enough to double as sandpaper. The shark did not survive the metaphor.

items.name: Mirework
items.description: A living crystal frame that keeps growing after harvest, slowly, in whatever direction the last handler faced it, out of stubbornness or habit.

items.name: Resonance Band
items.description: Rings by itself the instant a matching note sounds nearby. Handy warning, unless the note is your own funeral.

items.name: Heraklion
items.description: The infamous Skeleton Lord Nerak bred these hounds to hunt the living, their hollow ribs echoing with an appetite that death alone could not satiate. Domestication remains... inadvisable.

items.name: Sloth Fur
items.description: Incredibly soft and smells like moss and patience. Tailors love it. The slothian just sighed very slowly.

items.name: Glasswrought Philter Pyre
items.description: Burns twice: going in, and again when you speak your mind afterward.

items.name: Thumpmeal
items.description: Milled a faint crimson, best baked into bread eaten quickly and thought about never. The occasional throb is, bakers insist, purely cosmetic.

items.name: Scarwater
items.description: Drawn from the meltwater that pools along the Scar and settles clear if you wait, cloudy if you're in a hurry. Most drinkers here are in a hurry.

items.name: Wraith-Touched Treads
items.description: Every step echoes across two planes at once. The neighbours in both have filed a formal noise complaint, and for once, both complaints agree on every detail.

items.name: Pyre Channeler
items.description: Carried by the pyre priests. Ash never quite settles around it.

items.name: Hollowichor
items.description: Drained from the oldest hollows in the marsh. Embalmers thin it before use; nobody says why.

items.name: Anchorfeet
items.description: Weighted soles so the thin gravity doesn't walk off with you mid-stride.

items.name: Etched Signet
items.description: Bears an etched crest that could be a wolf, a cat, or abstract art. The jeweler wasn't sure either.

items.name: Bag of Cursed Fungi
items.description: Fifty cursed fungi sealed within a bag that murmurs in a rotating selection of languages, none of which belong to any living civilization, addressing its bearer by names they do not recognize but which nonetheless produce an involuntary chill. Seasoned herbalists carry it at arm's length, not because the manual recommends it but because the bag made the suggestion itself.

items.name: Frostshell Aegis
items.description: Layers of frozen crab shell over thorium plate. Marine biology, weaponized.

items.name: Suize
items.description: The harvest was traditional; the authentication was anything but, immortalized forever in blockchain's cold embrace.

items.name: Quillweave Grips
items.description: It performs adequately, by its own admission, which the wearer has decided to take on faith.

items.name: Coronet Band
items.description: Nobody remembers agreeing to how this turned out, a claim tested exactly zero times.

items.name: Corvid Feather Lance
items.description: Fletched with corvid feathers for aerodynamics. The corvids are still upset about it.

items.name: Feathergilt Visor Godbone
items.description: It does its job, then apologizes for doing it, so the original complaint was never formally withdrawn.

items.name: Deepwoven Carapace
items.description: Layered like the canopy it's named for, each ply grown from the one below, which makes repairing it a matter of gardening more than smithing.

items.name: Rex Sinew Belt
items.description: Woven from the sinews of a rex alpha. Holds your armor together and your organs inside. Multitasking.

items.name: Summitbloom
items.description: Rendered from summit moss under pressure, concentrated enough that a single drop does the work of a full flask and costs about as much to replace.

items.name: Shineloaf
items.description: So mineral-dense that smiths shatter it for the shards instead of eating it. Understandable.

items.name: Vitrified Elixir
items.description: Salt water and stubbornness. The choir swears by it, an octave higher than before.

items.name: Browbeaten
items.description: Dented in the same spot by the same falling debris often enough that the dent has its own name among the pilgrims.

items.name: Sealwafer
items.description: Thin, crystalline, and airtight the moment it hardens. Handymen hoard these and admit nothing.

items.name: Amphibian Oil
items.description: Refined from koa glands. Waterproofs leather, lubricates gears, and makes everything smell like a swamp forever.

items.name: Guardian Gauntlets
items.description: Cast to match the Last Guardian's own grip, the only known pair not currently being worn at the wall. Everyone assumes there's a reason for that.

items.name: Ocean Sigil Mantle
items.description: Rings like a buoy in a storm. Your allies always know where you are. So do enemies.

items.name: Stormplume Cuisses
items.description: So light they feel like wearing nothing. Which is also an option, but less protective.

items.name: Dragonmote
items.description: Fine golden dust harvested from dragonlily stamens that registers as mildly concerning on every alchemical measurement device ever invented, emitting a warmth that suggests proximity to forces better left undisturbed. It is universally allergenic, extraordinarily valuable, and carries the faint but unmistakable scent of regret.

items.name: Sigil of the Scar
items.description: Stamped with the same sigil the Scar Chanters carve into the fracture walls, meant to ward off whatever the Wound sends climbing back up.

items.name: Amulet of the First Hollow
items.description: Recovered from the hollow left by the first Voidmoth ever catalogued, back when the catalogers still numbered them instead of naming them. It predates the naming convention. It remembers being numbered.

items.name: Corbac Helmet
items.description: The corbac headdress’s field-issue cousin. Same crow, fewer ceremonies.

items.name: Breach Ash
items.description: The soot that never lands. It drifts sideways here, out of spite for gravity.

items.name: Firstwritten
items.description: Bound in pages older than the fracture itself, the only known record of what the zenith looked like whole. The Deep Auditors have spent generations arguing over the last chapter.

items.name: Spectre's Ledger
items.description: A running tally of debts owed by the dead. It updates itself. It is never in your favor.

items.name: Cordwood
items.description: Measured in the old unit nobody uses for lumber anymore, because there isn't enough lumber left to need it.

items.name: Kraken Depth Staff
items.description: Said to channel the deepest ocean trenches. Wielders report feeling watched. They are.

items.name: Cursed Treads
items.description: A cursed boot that trades freedom of movement for stubbornness. The wearer moves clumsily but thinks themselves invincible through sheer contradiction.

items.name: Graybark
items.description: Carved over decades by arthritic hands. Radiates calm wisdom and mild disapproval of everything you've done today.

items.name: Spider Fang Daggers
items.description: Twin blades of crystallized venom that hum, very faintly, whenever violence becomes likely.

items.name: Silkling Stingers
items.description: The near-microscopic barbs ensure wounds fester for weeks, which is arguably the point.

items.name: Feathergilt Ingot
items.description: Its classification has been disputed since it was found, so buyers are advised to judge for themselves.

items.name: Antiphon Breastplate
items.description: Waterproof, fireproof, gravy-proof. Drape it over furniture or over yourself, whichever needs saving.

items.name: Corbac Headdress
items.description: A crow-skull crown for the carrion-minded. The beak points at whatever you are about to loot.

items.name: Longfall
items.description: In this world gravity is a suggestion, so a downswing takes about a week to land. Pack a lunch.

items.name: Rough Mitts
items.description: Thick leather mittens that sacrifice dexterity for warmth. Gripping a sword is now a team sport with your hands.

items.name: Barley Bricheton
items.description: Its digestive system converts barley into loyalty at a conversion rate that economists find deeply troubling.

items.name: Knucklebone
items.description: Cast from the knuckles of a mold nobody kept records on. Fits like it was made for a hand slightly larger than yours.

items.name: Silt Wrapped Cuirass
items.description: Caked in a silt shell that hardens to stone in the dry and softens in the wet, which in the weald means it is always, quietly, in transition.

items.name: Green Stew
items.description: This emulsion of forest growth and desperation restores vitality to those desperate enough to ignore its resemblance to goblin bile.

items.name: Hunting Javelin
items.description: Designed for hunting small game. Also works on large game if you throw it enough times and believe hard enough.

items.name: Goldfleece Warhelm
items.description: Extra pockets on the inside. Nobody in the show ring asks what's in them.

items.name: Bent Sword
items.description: Forged by someone who clearly confused 'tempering' with 'stepping on it'. Still functional. Barely.

items.name: Underweald Stompers
items.description: Weighted to keep a footing in current, because down here the ground is a suggestion the water is free to overrule.

items.name: Goblin Grudge Axe
items.description: Every goblin who owned this axe eventually used it on another goblin. The cycle continues.

items.name: Nightmash
items.description: The foundation of every questionable potion ever brewed after midnight by someone who should have gone to bed.

items.name: Warden's Spear
items.description: A sapling warden's ceremonial spear, repurposed for violence the kweebec never quite forgave.

items.name: Corvid Leggings
items.description: Worn closest to the pyre pits. The hem never stops smoking.

items.name: Fenrot Helm
items.description: The leather's gone soft with rot and stayed that way, which turns out to cushion a blow better than anything the dry-landers sell.

items.name: Cured Gauntlets
items.description: Properly cured leather. Finally something that doesn't smell like a wet dog. It smells like a dry dog instead.

items.name: Faultline Torc
items.description: A Gate Watcher wore this while staring at a sky that had, technically, stopped being one sky. Reflects the horizon twice along the seam. The second reflection watches back, allegedly.

items.name: Bristleboar Mace
items.description: Every swing smells faintly of barn. Nobody has explained why. Nobody wants to.

items.name: Coronet Treads
items.description: The design survived three separate objections, so nobody bothered filing a complaint.

items.name: Scalehide Clutch
items.description: Worn by runners who carried word between the tomb lines. None of them stopped running.

items.name: Draconize
items.description: Wheat grown in volcanic soil soaked through with draconic blood, its kernels hot enough to boil water on contact. A single loaf feeds a family for a week, assuming the family enjoys internal combustion.

items.name: Runic Grimoire
items.description: Half its pages hold real spells. The other half are complaints about the mages who kept getting them wrong, filed in the margins by a hand nobody in the cult will admit to recognizing.

items.name: Moonclad Crusher
items.description: Faced in pale shell that shows every crack it makes in white, keeping a tidy, glowing tally the wielder can't switch off.

items.name: Weepwheat
items.description: Cut it and it bleeds — a thick, dark sap the colour of an old wound, as though whatever soil grew it had been hurt first and asked questions later.

items.name: Ravenbeak Crown
items.description: Sights through eye-slits worn thin by watching. The marsh watches back.

items.name: Vitrified Casque
items.description: Knitted for a teapot that exploded anyway. Keeps a head at serving temperature.

items.name: Feran Leather Hauberk
items.description: Feran pelts: ethically dubious, structurally unimpeachable, and reportedly machine-washable, though nobody has dared.

items.name: Swamp Trident
items.description: Three prongs of corroded metal, perfect for skewering anything that crawls out of the mire.

items.name: Bristleguard Warplate
items.description: Standard-issue to whoever still holds a column together. Rare, now.

items.name: Palecinch
items.description: Dyed by mire-water to a color that only reads as anything under moonlight, which never reaches this deep, so it stays a mystery on purpose.

items.name: Tokek Paw
items.description: A severed paw from a tokek gecko, still faintly warm and clutching at nothing.

items.name: Talokan Codex
items.description: Written in ink that only appears when submerged. Very inconvenient study material.

items.name: Nightcap
items.description: Glows faintly under moonlight, from a moonfang that was once a legend. Now it's a crafting material.

items.name: Heartstring
items.description: Pulls faintly toward the Scar at all times, the way a compass pulls toward north. Some wearers stop fighting it.

items.name: Cinderbelt
items.description: Buckled with a clasp cut from the Scar's edge, which means it never quite closes flush. The gap is small, and it is always there.

items.name: Reinforced Mitts
items.description: Metal studs on the knuckles add both protection and a menacing aesthetic. Handshakes become a statement.

items.name: Silkweave Stompers
items.description: Leaves a faint scorch with every print. Fades by the time anyone thinks to follow it.

items.name: Lastbind
items.description: The single piece of Sundered Soldier kit that never came apart, however thoroughly everything else in the story did. Holds. Just holds.

items.name: Sandwraith Legplates
items.description: Bone-white plates that materialized in a desert tomb alongside a note reading 'TAKE THEM AND LEAVE.' Nobody knows who left the note. Nobody wants to find out. The sand that perpetually falls from the joints isn't from any known desert, and sweeping it up is futile — it reappears by morning.

items.name: Molten Verse Charm
items.description: A bead of glass that never fully cools. Comforting in the hand until you forget and set it on parchment.

items.name: Wound Salve
items.description: Packed into cracks the Scar itself won't close, meant for wounds it has personally caused. Effective on lesser injuries too, which is the only mercy involved.

items.name: Woundweave
items.description: Layered stock that carries the Wound's mark all the way through, so cutting it never removes the mark — it just makes two of it.

items.name: Feranpelt Sash
items.description: Two Cinder Shade hides layered against each other, each one insulating exactly what the other one can't. The overlap runs warm enough to dry laundry.

items.name: Seraphbound Longsword
items.description: The design survived three separate objections, which is either the whole design or a rounding error.

items.name: Choirforged Ration
items.description: Somebody mother packed this. The sandwiches are cut into triangles; the apocalypse can wait.

items.name: Zephyr-Silk Gauntlets
items.description: So light you'll forget you're wearing gloves. You'll remember at the worst possible moment.

items.name: Mudshackle
items.description: Woven from bog-reed that never fully dries. It clears the head wonderfully, mostly by emptying it — the wearer feels marvelous and can no longer explain why.

items.name: Aberrant Faceguard
items.description: Modeled off a face that stopped being one. Deters conversation.

items.name: Wolfsinew Girdle
items.description: The alpha didn't give up its sinew willingly. But then again, alphas never volunteer for anything except violence. At least this one's been repurposed for holding up trousers.

items.name: Cleancut
items.description: Leaves an edge so precise the wound closes wrong around it. Surgeons study the scars. They don't publish their findings.

items.name: Nullstone
items.description: Weighs nothing and drops anyway. Physicists were consulted; the physicists left.

items.name: Petalflare
items.description: Eight ingredients, one vial, zero of the warmth explained by the label as 'magic.'

items.name: Shamblerbone
items.description: A shard broken from a rib that grew where no rib should.

items.name: Underhelm
items.description: Meant for the tiers below the roots, where the dark is total and a helmet's only real job is to stop you cracking your own skull on the ceiling.

items.name: Bonelord Legguards
items.description: Carved from femurs too large for anything that still breathes. The fit is exact.

items.name: Bag of Jade
items.description: Enough green stones to make a merchant weep tears of joy and then suspicion.

items.name: Voiddust
items.description: Voidmoths line their burrows with something that isn't quite dust and isn't quite light. Distilled, it fills the stomach and empties the head, in that order.

items.name: Seraphine Hauberk
items.description: The maker's notes consist entirely of crossed-out ideas, so the disagreement was quietly absorbed into the design.

items.name: Trainee Battle axe
items.description: Thick, blunt, and ponderous—everything a master weapon should not be. One might bludgeon a foe to death with it, assuming they can first lift it above their shoulders.

items.name: Cursed Fungus
items.description: The undisputed apex of herbalist ambition, a fungus of such concentrated malevolence that it whispers the names of those who approach in a voice like dry leaves scraping across a coffin lid. Veteran gatherers report that it does not so much get harvested as it permits itself to be taken, which is a distinction that brings no comfort whatsoever.

items.name: Haloforged Fists Throne
items.description: Nobody has confirmed it does what the label claims, a subject the wearer has chosen not to revisit.

items.name: Bag of Himalayan Wheat
items.description: Harvested from altitudes where the air is thin and the farming regulations are nonexistent.

items.name: Godstep Sandals
items.description: It does exactly one thing, and disputes even that, which is either reassuring or deeply concerning.

items.name: Canvas Boots
items.description: Waterproof for the first three seconds. After that they're sponges with laces. Comfort rating: damp.

items.name: Woundseal
items.description: Wrapped twice, the way the Wall Fragments wrap anything they don't fully trust to stay shut. So far the waist has cooperated.

items.name: Grimoire of Tides
items.description: The pages stay permanently damp. Reading it feels like drowning, which the author considered a feature.

items.name: Inheritance of the Ancients
items.description: Ringed in metal pilgrims swear predates the fracture, though the smiths who'd know for certain didn't survive to confirm it.

items.name: Ghostcap Warboots
items.description: Soled in glowing caps that give the wearer away in the dark, which the maker considered a fair trade for never getting lost.

items.name: Greater Healing Potion
items.description: Brewed from nightcap extract and questionable biological fluids. Closes wounds fast enough to make surgeons jealous.

items.name: Girthstone
items.description: Sized by a tailor who measured the wearer's ambitions rather than their waist. Both turned out larger than expected.

items.name: Anglerlure
items.description: Topped with a captured lure-light, still pulsing the same rhythm that draws prey through the deep weald. Best not to stare at it too long.

items.name: Miremail
items.description: Ringed in bog-iron that never rusts because it was never dry long enough to start, a property the smiths sell as a feature.

items.name: Zephyr Silk Cowl
items.description: Woven from creatures that spend entire lives riding updrafts and never once look down.

items.name: Hairline
items.description: Small wounds. Lots of them. The bleeding does the negotiating.

items.name: Evenhand
items.description: Balanced to a fraction the smith won't disclose. Every wielder swears it favors them personally. It doesn't.

items.name: Zenith Signet
items.description: Marks its wearer as having stood at the true zenith, before the fracture, according to a claim exactly nobody currently alive can verify or deny.

items.name: Archaeo Plume Javelin
items.description: Fletched with proto-feathers. It flies straighter than anything with feathers has any right to.

items.name: Matroncasque
items.description: Cut from a plate the Anglerdeep Matron shed and did not come back for, which is either luck or an invitation nobody wants to have accepted.

items.name: Key of Aragog's nest
items.description: Covered in silk and venom residue, this ornate key pulses with the heartbeat of the Forbidden Forest's most terrifying colony.

items.name: Sharkfin Longbow
items.description: Shark-fin limbs and frostshell plating. Drawing it takes both arms and a grudge.

items.name: Cursed Wheat
items.description: A stalk of grain blackened by fell magic, its kernels whispering with discontent.

items.name: Lavaclaw Reckoning
items.description: Two-handed, double-bladed, and triple the regret. Magmaclaw chitin keeps the edge forever hot. Literally.

items.name: Diamond Bread
items.description: A loaf of bread dusted with crushed diamonds, each bite a satisfying crunch that punishes the jaw.

items.name: Witherbloom
items.description: A flower that achieves the full splendor of its bloom only in the final moments of its decay, petals unfurling with theatrical timing that suggests a flair for the dramatic. Poets compose entire elegies about it, while alchemists merely note its decomposition rate with clinical detachment.

items.name: Basalt Carapace
items.description: Volcanic plate that drinks the light. In a dim nave you are, effectively, a hole.

items.name: Corvid Pendant
items.description: Contains a preserved corvid eye that blinks when danger is near. Also just blinks sometimes. Unclear why.

items.name: Hornhead Circlet
items.description: Quenched in barrow-water instead of brine. Holds a dent well.

items.name: Malt Bricheton
items.description: Permanently smells of fermentation and carries your goods with the unsteady gait of a creature that sampled too much of its feed.

items.name: Shadowsteel Gauntlets
items.description: Standard issue shadow knight gauntlets. The previous owner's grip marks are still visible in the metal, frozen in an expression of 'oh no, not again.'

items.name: Staff of the Deep
items.description: Pulled from a sunken temple no one remembers building. The barnacles are the least strange part.

items.name: Scalehide Fists
items.description: Knuckles reinforced against whatever nests in the old graves.

items.name: Stillstone
items.description: Worn smooth by centuries of being held during arguments it was never actually part of.

items.name: Iyashi Living Branch
items.description: The tree it came from died centuries ago. Nobody told the branch. It still buds every spring.

items.name: Swampfire Grips
items.description: History's worst decisions, several of them, are stained directly into the leather.

items.name: Lavachitin Tunic
items.description: Woven from fiber that still remembers being on fire and won't let you forget either.

items.name: Magmooligan Hoop
items.description: Felted from volcanic wool. Keeps your finger warm, which is a stranger comfort than it sounds.

items.name: Choirforged Sabatons
items.description: Rated for floodwater, mud, and shallow magma. One size too big, as is proper.

items.name: Chitin Gauntlets
items.description: Lamellated insect husk fashioned into gauntlets, lightweight yet durable enough to turn aside glancing blows. The previous wearer reportedly found them quite comfortable right up until the poison sac burst.

items.name: Duskite
items.description: A mineral that absorbs light so aggressively miners keep losing it in their own pockets.

items.name: Waverbow
items.description: A bow that shoots at distance, but argues about whether distance is real. Its arrows reach targets only by theoretical necessity.

items.name: Keepsake of the Dawn
items.description: Holds a pinch of the first dawn, sealed before it could fade. It hasn't. The wearer is advised not to open it and find out why.

items.name: Widow's Kiss
items.description: Two fangs from two different widows. They still don't get along.

items.name: Cinder Band
items.description: One shard of a heart that used to be whole. It remembers. It wants the rest back.

items.name: Canopycrest
items.description: Threaded through with living canopy-vine that keeps growing on the wearer's head, slowly, in a direction the wearer does not choose.

items.name: Novice Wand
items.description: Carved from a branch that was clearly not ready for this responsibility. Sparks occasionally. Mostly at inconvenient times.

items.name: Cinder Heart Scepter
items.description: Point it at the complete set and something in your chest gets ideas.

items.name: Rootoracle
