items.description: Bound in root-bark still damp from wherever it was found, pages soft with rot but the ink somehow untouched. The Deep Oracle is rumored to have written the margins.

items.name: Scorched Bricheton
items.description: A soot-covered companion whose proximity provides warmth in winter and a persistent fire insurance problem year-round.

items.name: Truestrike
items.description: Aimed by pilgrims taught that the Scar rewards conviction over aim. The blade disagrees, quietly, every single time.

items.name: Haloglass
items.description: Its purity is graded on a sliding, negotiable scale, by a committee that has since disbanded.

items.name: Ember-Step Walkers
items.description: The soles never cool: a marvel of enchantment, or possibly just a serious design flaw.

items.name: Pale Petal
items.description: Whether it counts as one material or several remains unsettled, and the report was filed anyway, caveats included.

items.name: Emberchant Legguards
items.description: Winter-weight wool in a building heated by a dragon. Grandmother does not accept counterarguments.

items.name: Scroll of Forgotten Arts
items.description: Contains forbidden knowledge so earth-shattering that your brain simply chose violence and deleted your OS entirely. At least you'll finally forget that embarrassing thing you said at the tavern.

items.name: Canticle Greataxe
items.description: Kept for the stubborn logs the rest of the pile hides. It also ends most other disagreements on the property.

items.name: Apexward
items.description: Meant for the hands that reach the peak and still have to grip something once they arrive. Most don't. These assume you will.

items.name: Skyheld Carapace
items.description: It was finished out of sheer stubbornness, a decision made under considerable time pressure.

items.name: Ectoplasm
items.description: Translucent ghost residue. Passes through non-enchanted containers. Storage is an adventure in itself.

items.name: Hornsaur
items.description: Carved from a throat that hasn't drawn breath in ten thousand years. Still louder than you'd like at 3am.

items.name: Glacial Grips
items.description: Gauntlets that never thaw. Your fingers will go numb, but at least you will grip things with conviction.

items.name: Sapling Bark Boots
items.description: The wood is technically still alive, and technically still furious about the arrangement.

items.name: Moonclad Poultice
items.description: Wrapped in pale shell, cold against a fever, a comfort the drowned court prized and the drowned court no longer needs.

items.name: Wolfsinew Recurve
items.description: Strung with alpha-wolf sinew that tightens, ever so slightly, whenever you lie about your draw weight.

items.name: Tideflame Treads
items.description: Boots infused with both glacial and cinder essences. Your left foot is warm, your right foot is cold. Balance achieved.

items.name: Kiln-Fired Charite Brick
items.description: A dense brick of burnt flour and amber. Armorsmiths grind it into a bonding agent that holds plate seams together.

items.name: Shark Vertebra Ring
items.description: A single shark vertebra, ground and polished. The jawline it came from is still, technically, hunting.

items.name: Marrow Knuckles
items.description: Gauntlets carved from the marrow-bones of something that died a long time ago and isn't entirely over it. They're cold in summer, colder in winter, and ice-cold when something undead is nearby. A terrible early warning system, since by the time your fingers go numb, the thing is already breathing down your neck. Figuratively. The dead don't breathe.

items.name: Jawbone of the Void Tyrant
items.description: Wrenched from a dragon that had been consuming void energy so long it forgot what sunlight tasted like. The jawbone hums with a frequency that makes furniture rearrange itself and causes anyone nearby to suddenly remember every embarrassing thing they have ever done. Warriors who carry it report feeling significantly stronger, though also significantly more existentially unsettled.

items.name: Marrow's ring
items.description: Necromancers love these for that 'freshly exhumed' aesthetic without the hassle of digging.

items.name: Bloodgrit
items.description: Unnervingly warm in the palm. Alchemists adore it. Everyone else keeps a healthy distance.

items.name: Cinderflour
items.description: Pre-toasted flour that saves bakers the trouble of burning their bread themselves, a service most consider thoughtful.

items.name: Quartz
items.description: A cloudy crystal that vibrates at frequencies only pretentious alchemists claim to understand.

items.name: Vitrified Vambraces
items.description: Not armor. A statement. Somebody in this cathedral is about to get cleaned.

items.name: Siltlance
items.description: Its silt shell cracks off on the first hit and takes the enemy's attention with it, which the second hit uses.

items.name: Magmooligan Waraxe
items.description: Magmooligans are small, mean, and forever setting things alight for no reason a sane creature would accept. This axe is what's left when a smith finally caught one. The fire never did calm down.

items.name: Breachforged Carapace
items.description: Peeled whole from a Voidmoth that outgrew the fifth breach and had nowhere left to molt. Fits like a second exoskeleton, because functionally, now it is one.

items.name: Ironhide Girdle
items.description: Thick enough to turn a blade, stiff enough to make kneeling a decision, not a reflex.

items.name: Nerak Marrow Bow
items.description: Strung with a tendon Nerak shed centuries ago and never once asked after. Draw it, and the string hums the same low note his court still sings underground, whether or not you meant to join in.

items.name: Scorched Loaf
items.description: Burnt on purpose, and don't you dare imply otherwise. That crunch is the entire point, not some baker's shame.

items.name: Ocean Sigil Circle
items.description: Made from compressed sea salt and talokan pearl. Dissolves if you swim with it. Don't swim with it.

items.name: Crazy Tunic
items.description: A crimson robe previously worn by a goblin whose sanity had long since departed.

items.name: Shark Harpoon
items.description: Tipped with an ethically sourced shark fin. The shark would disagree with 'ethically'.

items.name: Bag of Suize
items.description: The grains inside catch light like they're auditioning for a better container.

items.name: Vitrified Cord
items.description: Double-knotted the way mother insisted. Untying them is how accidents start.

items.name: Lantern Shard Ring
items.description: A sliver of a wraith lantern, still dimly glowing. It whispers the time of day to you, which would be useful if it weren't perpetually wrong and deeply passive-aggressive about corrections.

items.name: Trufflemarrow
items.description: The dense, pulsating core pulled from the deepest chamber a crimson truffle ever grew.

items.name: Seraph Plume
items.description: Its purity is graded on a sliding, negotiable scale, so the ledger simply lists both, side by side.

items.name: Titan Koa Greaves
items.description: The leathery hide of a titan koa, shaped into leggings. They croak when you bend your knees.

items.name: Polar Reaver's Crook
items.description: Once a shepherd's staff, now a thief's. The sheep were the lucky ones.

items.name: Lastashen
items.description: Iron-shod for footing on scar-stone, which shifts underfoot with the patience of something waiting for you to trust it.

items.name: Lavachitin Pounders
items.description: Everything you touch gets warmer. Handshakes have become a diplomatic incident.

items.name: Arcane Bricheton
items.description: Runic patterns crawl across its hide in sequences scholars identified as an ancient grain inventory system.

items.name: Chantmarked Twin Knives
items.description: Grandmother knitting needles. The scarf was never finished; the burglar never recovered.

items.name: Ember Scripture
items.description: Inked in a script that surfaces only under heat. Reading it calls for a hearth and the patience of a saint.

items.name: Silury
items.description: The last of an ancient lineage, this weathered creature carries the weight of millennia upon its timeworn shell. Legend claims it still hasn't forgiven the mammals for the whole 'extinction' business.

items.name: Choirforged Gauntlets
items.description: Slotted to breathe off the heat, which they do, directly onto your wrists. A trade, not a gift.

items.name: Saurian Scale Helm
items.description: The old lizard-kings never understood why smaller folk bothered with helmets — their own skulls could open a wall unassisted. They assumed anyone wearing one was simply showing off. They were, the tale admits, not entirely wrong.

items.name: Knucklevow
items.description: Engraved with a promise nobody living can read anymore. The metal remembers it better than any translator would.

items.name: Koagulant Longbow
items.description: The bowstring secretes a thin mucus. Nobody knows why. Nobody wants to know.

items.name: Frosthewn Axe
items.description: Hewn from a glacier, edged with adamantite. Serves cold, every time.

items.name: Wolfsinew Band
items.description: Braided from an alpha wolf's sinew. It tightens, almost imperceptibly, whenever you're about to make a mistake.

items.name: Weepsap
items.description: Resin that bled from a tree the deep water claimed, still weeping slowly, which the crafters take as a sign it hasn't finished dying.

items.name: Halo Splitter
items.description: It functions on a technicality, which is technically true and completely unhelpful.

items.name: Woundstitch Grips
items.description: Stitched by the Suture Priests from whatever holds a seam at the zenith's altitude, meaning not much, and not for long.

items.name: Underweald Charm
items.description: A knot of root and bone that guides swear wards off the things below. No one who tested it has ever come back to confirm it works.

items.name: Grips of the Deathless
items.description: Every prophecy needs a hand steady enough to point at the bad outcome without shaking. These were that hand's gloves. The prophet is gone. The steadiness stayed behind.

items.name: Boar Gorer
items.description: Designed for boar hunting but works on anything that charges at you with poor decision-making skills.

items.name: Primordial Lance
items.description: An ancient weapon that predates most civilizations. Still sharper than your average political debate.

items.name: Silk Gloves
items.description: The height of fashion for the terminally unemployed, and whose blood runs considerably warmer than their hands ever will.

items.name: Soul Shard Loop
items.description: Holds a sliver of something that hasn't fully left yet.

items.name: Matronsilk
items.description: Spun from silk the Anglerdeep Matron sheds during her deepest hunts, soft enough that crossing the weald floor makes no sound at all. Silence is the whole point down here.

items.name: Yeast Cake
items.description: A risen dough cake that smells of ambition and poor ventilation. Handymen use it as industrial sealant.

items.name: Raven-Eye Talisman
items.description: Amber-sealed and copper-bound, it grants the wearer a hawk's patience and a vulture's judgment.

items.name: Tremorline
items.description: There's a seam down the front that grows a hair's width every season, tracking the same crack that split the Riftling it came from. Nobody's told the wearer yet. Someone should.

items.name: Bara Hood (Amber)
items.description: A plain hooded cowl offered in a spread of gemstone linings. Cheap, honest, everywhere.

items.name: Haloforged Crest
items.description: Its maker refused to elaborate further, a compromise nobody is fully willing to defend.

items.name: Lorito Cloak (Jade)
items.description: A parrot-feather cloak dyed to a gemstone hue. Loud, cheerful, and entirely cosmetic.

items.name: Pyre Handler Mitts
items.description: Stitched for the kiln that fires the choir glass. Hold anything. Regret nothing.

items.name: Key of the Sealed Barrow
items.description: Cut to fit a lock that was never meant to open twice.

items.name: Rex Jawbone Cleaver
items.description: A cleaver made from a rex alpha jawbone. The teeth along the edge are original.

items.name: Bag of Obsidianite
items.description: Handle it gently, or don't, and either way plan your excuse for the healer in advance. They've heard every version of 'I was just carrying it.'

items.name: Genesis Loop
items.description: Cast from the first alloy the world ever cooled into, if the Auditors are to be believed, and they are, mostly, when they agree, which is rarely.

items.name: Reckoning of the First
items.description: Worn by the Deep Auditors while they argue the oldest records. Padded thick, because the arguments run long and occasionally come to blows.

items.name: Eternal Wisdom Chain
items.description: Carries a key for every crate that ever shipped through this post.

items.name: Glasswrought Falchion
items.description: Serrated for crusts that fight back. In this parish, they do.

items.name: Skyburial Bow
items.description: It functions under advisement, which the wearer has chosen not to think about.

items.name: Stopgap
items.description: Not a cure. A pause. Use the pause to reconsider whatever led you here.

items.name: Void Distillate
items.description: Liquid nothingness extracted from Void family remains. Staring into it too long causes existential dread and mild nausea.

items.name: Bag of Moonstone
items.description: Glows through the fabric at night, making stealth entirely impossible for thieves.

items.name: Twofist
items.description: The left gauntlet remembers gripping a shield that no longer exists; its Sundered Soldier does not. The right has never held anything. Wearers pick a favorite side without meaning to.

items.name: Crazy Hood
items.description: Assembled by a goblin who heard a rumor about helmets once, secondhand, from someone unreliable.

items.name: Ravenbeak Skullcap
items.description: Razord feathers line the interior, and the wearer's opinions grow noticeably sharper.

items.name: Boneguard's Edge
items.description: Taken from a boneguard who, in fairness, wasn't putting up much of a fight for it at the time — mostly on account of being thoroughly, professionally dead.

items.name: Wooliboots
items.description: Perfect for when the cold creeps in through the floorboards and dignity has already fled out the door.

items.name: Scarak Stinger
items.description: Pulled straight from a scarak and mounted on a stick. Still twitching.

items.name: Fenswamp Gland Charm
items.description: Swamp-born and swamp-scented. Pairs well with social isolation.

items.name: Tusk-Buckle Girdle
items.description: The buckle is a genuine tusklet fang. The leather smells like something that charged at you and lost. Fastening it requires a brief wrestling match that the belt wins about half the time.

items.name: Clawsliver
items.description: A claw fragment from the Moonclaw Empress. Glows under moonlight. Enchanters who touch it report hearing purring.

items.name: Razendril
items.description: A rat's fang, meticulously carved into a blade of surprising elegance and lethality.

items.name: Diadem Chausses
items.description: It was finished purely out of stubbornness, which nobody has the energy to dispute anymore.

items.name: Godbone Torc
items.description: It was forged during an argument nobody won, so the wearer has stopped asking.

items.name: Marrow-Cinch Belt
items.description: Carved from a spine that stood upright once and had strong opinions the whole time. It tightens on its own whenever a meal gets skipped, judging your habits from whatever's left of the afterlife.

items.name: Choirforged Signet
items.description: Iron, dented, one size fits none. It has turned aside needles, splinters, and one assassination.

items.name: Turnipkey
items.description: Rattles with a cold draft no cellar should produce. The Cellar Maw minted a hundred of these; it has never once needed to use a lock.

items.name: Shoreguard Helm
items.description: A bronze dome adorned with barnacles that no amount of scrubbing will remove. The original owner was a coastal guard who reportedly loved the sea until the very day the sea loved him back. Permanently.

items.name: Riftsplinter
items.description: Cracked clean along the same line a Riftling's shell cracks at first molt, and just as considered lucky for it. The logic doesn't travel well outside this world. Here, it's gospel.

items.name: Saurian Fang Fists
items.description: Scaled knuckles, campfire smell included. The previous owner did NOT consent to the upcycling.

items.name: Saltdeep
items.description: Pressure-rated for depths the weald officially doesn't have, which is the sort of thing a smith stamps on a plate and then doesn't like to talk about.

items.name: Diadem Elixir
items.description: Its effect kicks in, or it doesn't, unpredictably, so it's sold with a shrug instead of a guarantee.

items.name: Diadem Vambraces Crown
items.description: It does the job it was eventually assigned, which is either the whole design or a rounding error.

items.name: Polar Reaver's Breastplate
items.description: Taken off a raider who mistook the marsh for open ground. It wasn't.

items.name: Senshi's wooden Sword
items.description: It's a stick. You taped a handle to it. You're not fooling anyone, least of all the goblins who are absolutely going to tell their friends about this.

items.name: Woolamu
items.description: This tuft of spun wool brings warmth to the chest and absolutely nothing else to the battlefield. At least the wearer will die cozy.

items.name: Wound Ward Bow
items.description: Strung to loose arrows along the Scar's fracture lines without widening them further, a discipline the Wall Fragments enforce without exception.

items.name: Archaeo Plume Bow
items.description: Fletched in plumes from a bird that crossed the depths long before anyone kept a calendar to write the date down. The arrows still seem to know the old route. They take it whether or not it's where you're aiming.

items.name: Kilnward Grips
items.description: A quilted square that fears no oven. Carry anything in the kitchen except a tune, a needle, or the feeling in your fingertips.

items.name: Inferno Shard
items.description: Fused stove waste raked from the grate. The furnace keeps its receipts.

items.name: Featherfall Daggers
items.description: Nobody remembers agreeing to how this turned out, and the committee never reconvened to revisit it.

items.name: Koa Eye Seal
items.description: Worn on the last rotation before the posts went silent.

items.name: Sundered Vambraces
items.description: Padded thick over the ears of the arm, which makes no anatomical sense until you remember whose arm it was. Blocks sound almost as well as it blocks blades.

items.name: Bara Hood (Emerald)
items.description: A plain hooded cowl offered in a spread of gemstone linings. Cheap, honest, everywhere.

items.name: Behemoth Heart Pearl
items.description: Set with a fragment too smooth to have broken on its own.

items.name: Razorfang
items.description: Carved from the oversized fangs of sewer-dwelling vermin, these jagged blades carry the curse of pestilence.

items.name: Hymnbound Girdle Pyre
items.description: Glows dull red along the buckle. It is either a warning or a fashion statement, and it never clarifies.

items.name: Goldfang
items.description: A gold-capped canine ripped from a goblin officer's mouth. The gold is real. The dentistry was not.

items.name: Baked Compound
items.description: A hardened lump of baked flour and mushroom spores. Alchemists love it. Everyone else questions the smell.

items.name: Smolderfleece
items.description: Fire-resistant wool that still smolders. Weavers report mild burns and existential questions about flammable fabric.

items.name: Maw Tooth Ring
items.description: A ring that firmly denies its own existence while being worn. It is both absolutely certain and entirely doubtful.

items.name: Riftsunder Helm
items.description: The final tremor a particular Riftling ever caused left a hum in this shell-casque that hasn't faded since. Outlasts hearing. Then, presumably, outlasts you.

items.name: Summitvein
items.description: Adamant quarried at the very summit, where the ore sits closest to whatever the mountain is made of underneath. Heavy in a manner that feels deliberate.

items.name: The Old Man's Crutch
items.description: Disguised as a walking stick. The fire at the tip is less convincing.

items.name: Firstlight
items.description: Distilled at the exact minute of first light, which gives the alchemists one shot a day and a very short temper by noon.

items.name: Quartz Choker
items.description: A polished quartz stone set in a wire frame. Vibrates gently when magic is nearby. Or when it's windy.

items.name: Choirforged Greaves
items.description: Bicycle clips in a cathedral with no bicycles. Preparedness is its own reward.

items.name: Mender's Cuisses
items.description: Padded with healing herbs. Kneel, breathe, let the paperwork — sorry, the herbs — do the rest.

items.name: Musterbound
items.description: Strapped on for a roll call that never finished being taken. The arms remember standing ready long after the mind would rather not. Endurance without end is still, technically, endurance.

items.name: Shadowfang Longsword
items.description: Wolf sinew wraps a blade of shadow knight steel. Sharp, dark, and deeply uninterested in your feelings.

items.name: Phacochere's Son
items.description: The runt of the litter, following its parent everywhere except into anything actually dangerous.

items.name: Goldfleece Hauberk
items.description: More pockets than armor plates. Priorities.

items.name: Velkarion Pyre Key
items.description: The grand pyre gate has nine locks, six wards and exactly one key, and the sexton keeps it precisely where you think he does.

items.name: Marrowbone War Spear
items.description: Tipped with an ancient marrow shard that refuses to fully dry. Whatever gave its life to make this spear hasn't entirely stopped giving — call it dedication, or call it an unfinished transaction.

items.name: Skyfin
items.description: A translucent fin that still tries, out of habit, to catch the wind.

items.name: Basalt Flail
items.description: Swung on a chain, it sounds like a funeral bell. Fitting, given the appointments it keeps.

items.name: Arcanite Cactee
items.description: Hums a lullaby in frequencies that put small animals to sleep and give wizards migraines.

items.name: Hushrot
items.description: Sealed close enough to keep the fen out and, some wearers note uneasily, close enough to keep a held breath in.

items.name: Scalehide Grips
items.description: The scales still flex when you clench a fist, like the original owner never quite let go.

items.name: Hornhead Horn
items.description: A spiraling ram horn, still warm. The previous owner headbutted a tree and lost. Nature is metal.

items.name: Ensable Pincers
items.description: Something down there wants this back badly enough to still be looking.

items.name: Patchwork Trousers
items.description: Sewn from whatever fabric was lying around. Each leg is a different color. Fashion statement or cry for help?

items.name: Infernal Cleaver
items.description: Burns with the fury of a thousand performance reviews. Ironic, for an ice world. Nobody's complained yet.

items.name: Bristlemail Binding
items.description: The buckle alone weighs more than most belts. That's the selling point.

items.name: Bristlemail Treads
items.description: Three layers of tusker leather. Your feet will outlive your knees by a comfortable margin.

items.name: Scarab Tassets
items.description: Stained past saving by the fourth week. Nobody issues a fresh pair.

items.name: Crystal Bread
items.description: The crust sparkles. The crumb shimmers. Your dentist will have opinions, artisanal ones.

items.name: Obsidianite Cactee
items.description: Every spine is glass-sharp and entirely serious about staying that way. The old warning painted on its crate has one line, and the line is correct: do not hug.

items.name: Deathgrip
items.description: Locks the fingers at the moment of impact and stays locked a beat longer than the wearer would prefer.

items.name: Windspun
items.description: Wind-infused silk thread that floats on its own. Tailors adore it. Their cats consider it a personal enemy.

items.name: Ramrage Waraxe
items.description: Balanced by a ramrage horn counterweight. Balanced is relative when the axe weighs forty pounds.

items.name: Wisdom's Embrace
items.description: Counted every requisition twice before signing off. Habits like that don't die easily.

items.name: Handholds
items.description: When the floor stops being reliable, you learn to grab things. These grab back.

items.name: Malt Bread
items.description: Suspiciously sweet bread that may or may not have fermented in your bag. Either way, morale is improved.

items.name: Cinderchoir Tassets Pyre
items.description: Smoulders gently at the hem. Fashionable, warm, and a genuine liability near dry grass.

items.name: Zenithscar Greatblade
items.description: Balanced along the exact seam where the world came apart, so it always knows which way to fall. Usually onto someone.

items.name: Bag of Malt
items.description: The faint aroma of fermentation suggests this malt has already begun planning its next career as a beverage.

items.name: Frostweaver Wraps
items.description: Woven from yeti fur, reinforced with glacial heart shards. The yeti has opinions about this.

items.name: Titan Shell Hauberk
items.description: Boiled and beaten flat. Whatever wore it first still leaves a smell.

items.name: Jitterbrew
items.description: Restores health and installs a permanent low-grade tremor in both hands. Net positive, they insist.

items.name: Bedrock
items.description: The single most stubborn thing you will ever strap to a knee. It objects, strenuously, to being moved.

items.name: Glacial Pike
items.description: Tipped with glacial crystal. Keeps enemies at a distance they didn't choose.

items.name: Anglerhide
items.description: Cut from Anglerqueen hide, lure-glands left dark and dormant, mostly. Best not to test how dormant.

items.name: Sunkamber
items.description: Resin that hardened underwater and trapped whatever was passing at the time, which is best not examined by candlelight.

items.name: Embalmed Silk
items.description: Bindings pulled off a frostshamble, kept fresh by centuries of cold rather than any embalmer's craft. Makes fine bandages, provided you've decided not to ask where they've been.

items.name: Embalmed Grips
items.description: Wrapped in the same silk as the dead. Grip doesn't loosen, even after.

items.name: Glasswrought Philter Vitrified
items.description: Medicinal, according to the charwoman. Grey, according to everyone.

items.name: Crownrot Signet
items.description: It functions, technically, in most conditions, and the wearer has learned to live with the ambiguity.

items.name: Underweald Hauberk Matron
items.description: Overlapped in scales the Anglerdeep Matron sheds by the hundred, which sounds abundant until you learn what she does to anyone collecting them.

items.name: Faultline Draw
items.description: Bled from a live crack. Handlers wear gloves; the crack does not care about the gloves.

items.name: Wealdcrest
items.description: Woven so tight underwater that it never fully dried, and now weighs a hair more than it should, forever, out of spite.

items.name: Riftbrace
items.description: Doesn't win fights so much as postpone them, one crumbling wall at a time, the same patient way a Riftling outlasts a collapsing tunnel. Slow magic. Reliable magic.

items.name: Plague Fang
items.description: A jagged rat tooth coated in something you really don't want identified. Handle with thick gloves. Thicker.

items.name: Enriched Dough
items.description: Raw dough so enriched with minerals it practically qualifies as a geological sample. Handymen swear by it.

items.name: Ribcracker
items.description: Marketed to the Scar's remaining butchers as a kitchen tool. Repurposed almost immediately. The manufacturer has stopped commenting.

items.name: Chantmarked Legguards Verse
items.description: Reserved for services, funerals, and days when both happen at once. Here, that is most days.

items.name: Bloodstone Cactee
items.description: Its needles stay permanently crimson. Veterinarians decline to examine it, as a rule.

items.name: Godbone Shard
items.description: Its exact properties depend on who is asked, and the case file was quietly closed, unresolved.

items.name: Glowscript
items.description: Bioluminescent ink that retains magical charge. Used by handymen to inscribe functional runes on equipment and furniture.

items.name: Tusker Musk Gland
items.description: Produces a smell that can clear a room, a building, or a small district. Alchemists extract pheromones from it.

items.name: Deepreach
items.description: Extends the caster's reach into places the caster would rather not personally visit.

items.name: Seraphbound Cordial Godbone
items.description: It was brewed to settle an argument, and didn't, so drink at your own risk, formally speaking.

items.name: Spiderweb Pants
items.description: Spun from thread no spider ever willingly gave up. Ethical sourcing was never on the table.

items.name: Lastmile
items.description: Named for the stretch every pilgrim swears is shorter than the last one. It never is.

items.name: Sparkweave Hood
items.description: Keeps the head warm. Keeps the eyebrows nowhere in particular.

items.name: Wooden Greataxe
items.description: More fence post than weapon. The splinters do half the damage.

items.name: Shadowforge Incandescent
items.description: Forged so hot the smith is said to have misplaced his own name somewhere in the quench. The blade remembers the heat perfectly. Whatever he lost that day, the blade has never given it back.

items.name: Scarhewn Axe
items.description: Chipped from the Scar's own broken wall, edge kept jagged the way the fracture line itself is jagged. It cuts like the world already gave up resisting.

items.name: Lure Light Pendant
items.description: Holds a sliver of captured anglerlight, pulsing on its own rhythm regardless of what's carrying it. The weald's real lures have started drifting closer to whoever wears it. This is not considered a good sign.

items.name: Chanterbrew
items.description: Mixed to the rhythm the Scar Chanters keep, one measure per line of their song, which is why no two batches taste identical and none are ever rushed.

items.name: Voidpierce Stilettos
items.description: Ground to an edge fine enough to slip between a Voidmoth's carapace plates without the Voidmoth noticing until well after the fact. Works on most things with a similar disregard for warning.

items.name: Draconite
items.description: Crystallized dragon essence that dragons would very much like back, please stop mining it.

items.name: Crownrot Helm Crown
items.description: It works exactly as described, allegedly, and the maker moved on before finishing the thought.

items.name: Feranpelt Waistguard
items.description: Worn through three campaigns and re-buckled for a fourth. The leather remembers all of them.

items.name: Abyssgrown Gauntlets
items.description: Grew claws the smith never added and can't remove; the wearer files them under perks and moves on.

items.name: Pyrehymn Greaves Choir
items.description: Cast from cooled runoff, flaws and all. The flaws are load-bearing now, so leave them be.

items.name: Obsidian Stompers
items.description: Polished glass soles, mirror-bright. The last thing a tripped enemy sees is their own surprised face.

items.name: Firstlattice
items.description: The same lattice grown at the mountain's oldest vent instead of the Scar, where it comes out cleaner and, the crafters insist, faintly smug about it.

items.name: Ursine Crusher
items.description: The bear asked for royalties on this design. Legal said no. The bear disagreed, loudly.

items.name: Holy Bible
items.description: Divine scripture capable of scrubbing a conscience clean, assuming one still possesses a conscience to scrub.

items.name: Copper Pickaxe
items.description: Soft enough to dent on a bad swing. Miners compensate with more swings. The mountain, as always, remains unimpressed.

items.name: Gilded Locket
items.description: It agrees to function, under written protest, a detail everyone involved has agreed to forget.

items.name: Courtvisor
items.description: Recovered from the silt-choked hall the weald's guides still call a throne room, out of habit more than any evidence a throne was ever there.

items.name: Duskring
items.description: Forged in the final years, when jewelers stopped signing their work. Nobody was sure there'd be anyone left to read the name.

items.name: Coronet Tonic
items.description: Opinions on its aftertaste vary considerably, a fact quietly omitted from the label.

items.name: Ursine Choker
items.description: Protects the neck. Which is surprisingly underrated as a survival strategy.

items.name: Lorito Cloak (Amethyst)
items.description: A parrot-feather cloak dyed to a gemstone hue. Loud, cheerful, and entirely cosmetic.

items.name: Fuwa Hood (Black)
items.description: The matching hood. Wearing both at once is a documented cause of spontaneous cuteness.

items.name: Wyrmdust
items.description: Smokes faintly at room temperature. Storage requires a fireproof vault and a very calm mindset.

items.name: Longwatch
items.description: Standard plate for the summit watch, weighted so the wearer can stand still for a full turn without swaying. Sitting down is a separate problem it does not solve.

items.name: Glacial Buckle
items.description: The buckle is a frost shard that never melts. Convenient. Occasionally load-bearing.

items.name: Airborne
items.description: Weightless in the thin gravity, which feels great until you need to actually hit something.

items.name: Pearlshard Pendant
items.description: A cracked pearl from an oyster that reportedly fought back. The harvester lost two fingers and gained a healthy respect for bivalves. The pearl glows faintly underwater, which is beautiful and completely useless given that you can't breathe there.

items.name: Crackvault
items.description: There's a fissure across the brow. The smith calls it a 'stress-relief channel'. The smith lies.

items.name: Silkgland
items.description: A gelatinous organ producing thread stronger than steel wire of the same width. Handle it gently regardless.

items.name: Old Woolame
items.description: Recovered from the glistening depths of a wooligan's digestive tract, this blade bears the unmistakable sheen of gastric survival.

items.name: Longdraw
items.description: Takes a full breath to draw and a full breath to regret. Both breaths are optional if the target is fast enough.

items.name: Throneless Pendant Godbone
items.description: Nobody has confirmed it does what the label claims, a fact the maker considers a feature.

items.name: Crownrot Cuirass Godbone
items.description: It does what it's told, eventually, a resolution that resolved very little.

items.name: Bag of Amber
items.description: A heavy sack of fossilized tears. The tree cried so you could get rich.

items.name: Hushcrown
items.description: Grown, not forged, from a shell the deep weald started and abandoned. The wearer inherits both the protection and the unfinished business.

items.name: Rustshore Cutlass
items.description: A sailor's blade that has seen more tavern brawls than naval battles, by a wide margin.

items.name: Toll of the Priest
items.description: The plain version the Suture Priests keep for themselves, without the presentation they put on for pilgrims. It tastes worse and works faster.

items.name: Courtfang
items.description: Court daggers dredged from the drowned hall, still crossed the way they were laid on a body the silt has long since claimed.

items.name: Deepwoven Tassets
items.description: Grown in overlapping fronds like the canopy above, so a low blow just parts the leaves and finds more leaves.

items.name: Aragog's Venom Fang
items.description: The Mother of Spiders shed this fang voluntarily — and by voluntarily, we mean someone pried it out while she was digesting a particularly large adventurer. It still drips with venom that makes your enemies reconsider their life choices.

items.name: Breachforged Greatbow
items.description: Strung by one Gate Watcher who measured range in thresholds crossed, never in paces. The arrow stays a full threshold ahead of whatever regret loosed it.

items.name: Choirblade Altus
items.description: One full yard of seasoned oak. Every child in the parish knows exactly how much trouble it measures.

items.name: The Bonelord's Heart
items.description: Pulled from the Bonelord after the third attempt. Still beats to a rhythm nobody can march to.

items.name: Basalt Fists
items.description: Wire bristles across the knuckles. Grime, rust and hope come off with equal ease.

items.name: Dragon Gaia
items.description: Imposing, iridescent, and one bad mood away from redecorating the camp.

items.name: Ember Silkblade
items.description: Forged from silk fibers ignited and tempered into a burning edge that refuses to cool. Flexible enough to tie in a knot, assuming one's fingers are immune to third-degree burns.

items.name: Glacialheart Katana
items.description: A katana with a glacial heart in the hilt. The edge is so fine it cuts through pretension. And also through people. The cold numbs the guilt.

items.name: Bag of Nightcaps
items.description: A bag containing fifty nightcaps that appears to devour ambient light in its immediate vicinity, creating a localized pocket of darkness that follows its bearer with the quiet persistence of a guilty conscience. Prolonged proximity reportedly induces a creeping existential unease that herbalists have learned to mistake for professionalism.

items.name: Empyrean Elixir
items.description: The dosage instructions contradict themselves halfway down the label, and no refund request has ever been filed, yet.

items.name: Keepsake
items.description: Inside sits dust off the very first thing that fell here. There is, rest assured, no shortage of dust in this place.

items.name: Cinder Sash
items.description: Woven from cinder-heart thread. Keeps a watch bearable through the coldest hour.

items.name: Warboots of the Fracture
items.description: Laced to carry a pilgrim through the one hour the Wound stays quiet. Miss the window and the boots are the least of the problems.

items.name: Lorito Cloak (Emerald)
items.description: A parrot-feather cloak dyed to a gemstone hue. Loud, cheerful, and entirely cosmetic.

items.name: Marchworn
items.description: Already broken in by someone who didn't survive to keep wearing them. Sized generously, as a professional courtesy.

items.name: Reliquary
items.description: Holds one saint's fingerbone in the crest, for luck. The saint's luck is a matter of record.

items.name: Tremorseal
items.description: Stopped humming the instant a Riftling's last tremor died in its shell. Now it just sits cold on the hand, which the previous wearer found more unsettling than the humming ever was.

items.name: Stormfeather Longbow
items.description: Every arrow crackles before release. Every archer swears they meant for it to do that.

items.name: Koa Eye Talisman
items.description: Kept warm by whoever called the last roll. Still keeps time with a pulse no one else can hear.

items.name: Throatlatch
items.description: Clasped shut by whoever wore it first and never reopened since. The clasp still works. Nobody's tested it.

items.name: Ashscale Pike
items.description: Tipped with sunwarmed scale and shafted in kweebec bark. Long enough to poke from a comfortable distance. Strategy or cowardice, your call.

items.name: Ironrank
items.description: Baked to the recipe a Sundered Soldier company followed before the company stopped being whole. Dense enough to use as a weapon. Some did.

items.name: Training Helmet
items.description: Protects against gentle breezes and strongly worded insults. Actual combat protection: theoretical.

items.name: Bindthread Amulet
items.description: Threaded from Static Shepherd cord, humming faintly whenever the herd is close. Rex packs mistake the wearer for one of their own, briefly.

items.name: Shark Bone Choker
items.description: A necklace of shark vertebrae. Fashionable in coastal towns. Terrifying literally everywhere else.

items.name: Tidetread
items.description: The salt-water tanning left them permanently damp and permanently silent, a fair trade in a place where sound draws teeth.

items.name: Shadowsteel Warhelm
items.description: So dark it absorbs compliments along with light. The visor opens only from the inside — somebody's idea of a joke.

items.name: Shadowsteel Lash
items.description: A flexible dusk-forged blade wrapped in bristlemail. Bends like a promise nobody intends to keep.

items.name: Fen Impaler
items.description: Pulled from a swamp that filed a formal, sopping objection.

items.name: Canopyglow
items.description: Studded with a rarer cap that glows only in true dark, which under the deep canopy is always, so they never once go dim.

items.name: Hemmed Leggings
items.description: At least the hems are straight. Everything else about these leggings is a work in progress.

items.name: Mokan Hat
items.description: A wide woven hat. Keeps the rain off and the questions away.

items.name: Boar Hide
items.description: Thick, bristly, and smells like mud. The boar was unreasonably angry about losing it. Standard procedure.

items.name: Tusk Ivory
items.description: Dense ivory from a warthog's tusk. Carvers shape these into chess pieces, because apparently that's a market.

items.name: Godbone Saber
items.description: It does the job it was eventually assigned, and the paperwork reflects none of this.

items.name: Tribal Cudgel
items.description: Wrapped in totemic charms that channel spirits said to judge every swing on form as much as force. By all accounts they remain unimpressed. The cudgel hits just as hard regardless of their opinion.

items.name: Berserker Helm
items.description: Forged for those who answer every problem with more axe. Rage not included, but implied.

items.name: Plaguemo Skullcap
items.description: Fashioned from the plaguemo's own cranial plate, which was, somehow, the least concerning part of the process.

items.name: Riftsalve
items.description: Packed into the seams of a molting Riftling to keep the new shell from setting crooked. Works about as well on people — unevenly, that is, but it works.

items.name: Tidebound Visor
items.description: Salt-crusted from being worn where the tide reaches, which the weald insists it doesn't have and the visor's corrosion insists it does.

items.name: Collapse Alloy
items.description: Blended from things that fell together. It only feels stable because the parts already gave up.

items.name: Bag of Green Mushrooms
items.description: Fifty green mushrooms. Legally and botanically distinct from the fun kind.

items.name: Diadem Vambraces Godbone
items.description: It performs its stated function with visible reluctance, so the debate was tabled indefinitely.

items.name: Polar Fortress Plate
items.description: So heavily armored, mobility becomes a rumor. Nothing gets through. Including you, eventually.

items.name: Diadem Lattice Godbone
items.description: Whether it counts as one material or several remains unsettled, and the second explanation was never fully ruled out.

items.name: Cocoon King's Cowl
items.description: Woven from the same golden silk, worn low over the eyes. Everything past arm's reach blurs to a comfortable gold haze — a mercy, or perhaps the whole point.

items.name: Ashwing
items.description: Hard as iron and sharp as malice. Weaponsmiths attach these to flails. The raven had other plans for it.

items.name: Breachforged Splitter
items.description: Four earlier ones didn't take. This one was forged in a worse mood.

items.name: Doomfang Twins
items.description: Paired blades off the Cinder Widow. They still remember the bite.

items.name: Ember Heart of the Firstborn
items.description: The dragon died centuries ago. Nobody told the central heating. Somewhere under the nave it still burns on schedule, and the radiators knock twice before every service.

items.name: Cinderchoir Crest
items.description: Worn upside down since the flood of ash. Smells of lye and quiet determination.

items.name: Abyssal Warplate
items.description: The difference between a war story and a eulogy.

items.name: Embalmed Cuirass
items.description: Lined with embalming silk salvaged from the barrow-workers' stores. Holds its shape after everything else has given out.

items.name: Glasswrought Carapace
items.description: Strapped on front-first. Folds flat for storage and unfolds with a shriek that clears the room.

items.name: Koa Slime Codex
items.description: The pages are stuck together with koa slime. Reading it requires both skill and a strong stomach.

items.name: Liquid Koa
items.description: A slime that never learned to hold a shape and made peace with it. Mostly.

items.name: Splinter of the Wound
items.description: Holds a splinter the Wound left behind, sealed the way the Wound Oracle seals everything else — carefully, and with little confidence it'll hold.

items.name: Magmooligan Woolmail
items.description: Felted volcanic wool over old bronze rings, warm enough for blizzards and unbearable everywhere else. On cold nights something in the weave still bleats, faintly. The armourer's oath that the beast was thoroughly finished beforehand has grown less convincing with every retelling.

items.name: Void Shard
items.description: A fragment of nothing given physical form. Looking at it too long causes nosebleeds and philosophical crises.

items.name: Shrooms Gaia
items.description: A gentle spirit of the earth, bound to safeguard the land's treasures from those who would plunder them recklessly.

items.name: Ursine Girdle
items.description: Protects everything between chest and legs. Also known as 'everything important.'

items.name: Stormweave Leggings
items.description: Woven grey from wear, not from dye. Nobody remembers the original color.

items.name: Lorito Cloak (Rose Quartz)
items.description: A parrot-feather cloak dyed to a gemstone hue. Loud, cheerful, and entirely cosmetic.

items.name: Zephyr Silk Leggings
items.description: Light as a breeze. Tough as whatever made the breeze in the first place.

items.name: Legguards of the Primordial
items.description: Cast from the hide an Ash Prophet sheds when a vision runs long. Wearer's stride slows to a prophet's pace: deliberate, unhurried, and always arriving exactly when the bad news does.

items.name: Shadowsteel Battleplate
items.description: Shadow knights forge their armor only during eclipses, which is nowhere near often enough for demand.

items.name: Koa Tongue
items.description: Three feet of prehensile muscle. Stretches, snaps, and occasionally catches something other than flies.

items.name: Shore Finns
items.description: The carapace of great crabs, fashioned into rugged leg armor that crackles faintly with the scent of sea salt and sunbaked tide.

items.name: Abyss Core
items.description: Pulsing orb of concentrated void energy. Contains the dreams of a dead reality. Handle with existential caution.

items.name: Arcanite Sickle
items.description: Forged from crystallized mana and bad decisions. Cuts through cursed thickets like they owe it money.

items.name: Fenfang
items.description: Bent from a single curved fang, small enough to forget you're wearing it until something in the weald reacts to it first.

items.name: Pepe Royal Crown
items.description: The pepe ascended. A gilded crown for those who bought the top and never sold.

items.name: Stitchring
items.description: Touched once by the Wound and left with a scar of its own, which the ring wears more gracefully than most of its bearers manage.

items.name: Tidemark
items.description: Bears the pale tideline the deep weald leaves on everything it takes and gives back, which is more things than the weald likes to admit giving back.

items.name: Recurve Practice Bow
items.description: The recurve adds power. The shoddy craftsmanship removes it. Net result: slightly better than throwing rocks.

items.name: Ironbark Treads
items.description: Bark from a tree that saw the axe coming and left first. Footsteps sound faintly like agreement.

items.name: Guidethread
items.description: The plain version the guides carry, half the strength and twice the reliability, which down here is the trade that keeps you breathing.

items.name: The Condemned Edge
items.description: Every swing whispers the name of someone you forgot. Coincidence, probably.

items.name: Behemoth Pearl
items.description: Found in the gullet of an ancient Titan Koa. Worth a fortune, assuming you can retrieve it politely.

items.name: Golden Silkling
items.description: A larva spun from precious thread, its tiny form radiating the kind of unyielding determination that turns feeble strikes into crushing blows.

items.name: Moonstone Pickaxe
items.description: The head pulses with pale luminescence. Miners swear it finds veins on its own. The pickaxe has no comment.

items.name: Frozen Striders
items.description: Ice-treated leather that finally lets go of standing still. Motion, at last.

items.name: Tempered Glass
items.description: Choir-glass sheets that survive any oven. The cakes stick anyway, as is law.

items.name: Pyreguard Cuirass
items.description: Scorched at the collar from standing closest to the burning. Never once burnt through.

items.name: Broken Pickaxe
items.description: This is what happens when budget constraints meet subterranean ambition.

items.name: Canopybrew
items.description: Green and thick and faintly moving, which the brewer swears is just settling and would rather you not watch it too closely.

items.name: Binding Thread Ring
items.description: Binds spectral energy to mortal flesh. The fine print mentions 'mild existential drift' and nothing further.

items.name: Silentedge
items.description: Makes no sound on the draw, the swing, or the landing. The silence afterward is the part people remember.

items.name: Saurian Waraxe
items.description: Carved to the angle the stone-kings favored before they went to sleep under the depths, said to remember old scores better than new ones. It has strong opinions about skulls. Nobody's found who to ask about it.

items.name: Wardchain
items.description: Forged link by link to match the Last Guardian's own, worn by those the Guardian has personally judged fit to stand the last wall.

items.name: Ember Reduction
items.description: Rendered fat from the refectory roasts. Frying, waterproofing, bribing the hounds — one jar does all.

items.name: Slothfur Cord
items.description: Threaded with the same signal-code as the gloves. Reads faster than it should.

items.name: Ursine Clompers
items.description: You will not be moved. Not because you can't. Because you won't.

items.name: Coronet Legguards
items.description: It was built to prove a point nobody remembers, a fact the maker considers a feature.

items.name: Fenbrew
items.description: Distilled over bog-fire that burns cold, giving it a chill that lingers on the tongue long after the healing is done.

items.name: Drownmarked Tome
items.description: The ink runs a little more each time it's opened underwater, which the deep-weald scholars insist is the book revising itself.

items.name: Chasmtread
items.description: Grew a tread pattern nobody designed, matched to a gait nobody recognizes, which fits the wearer anyway.

items.name: Blockhead
items.description: Named by the smith's apprentice, who meant it as an insult, and got promoted anyway.

items.name: Ectoplasmic Tome
items.description: The binding oozes translucent goo. The librarian said it was normal. The librarian was also translucent.

items.name: Wooling Practice Bow
items.description: Strung with wooling gut. The wooling's sacrifice was involuntary but appreciated.

items.name: Glowcap
items.description: A translucent mushroom that glows faintly in the dark, as if mocking you for spending hours looking for it in broad daylight.

items.name: Skyburial Leggings
items.description: The wearer swears by it; everyone else has doubts, so the wearer has stopped asking.

items.name: Ramrage Sash
items.description: Woven from ramrage wool. Nearly indestructible. The smell, however, is eternal.

items.name: Throneless Gauntlets
items.description: It was forged during an argument nobody won, and the second draft never materialized.

items.name: Rotted Flesh
items.description: Peeling off a zombie is easy. The smell lingers for weeks. Your party members will remember this betrayal.

items.name: Fuwa Cloak (Black)
items.description: A soft, absurdly fluffy cloak. Zero armor value, infinite nap value.

items.name: Timberwolf Legguards
items.description: Wolf fur-lined greaves that keep your legs warm in winter and overheated in everything else. The fur pattern shifts in firelight, creating the unsettling impression that something is still alive in there and merely biding its time.

items.name: Wallbreaker
items.description: Rated for masonry the wall itself is made of. The rating was not theoretical. There is a hole to prove it.

items.name: Brackish Poultice
items.description: Packed with salt-mud that draws a wound clean and stings enough that the patient knows, precisely, when it's working.

items.name: Phacochef's Tribal Tusk
items.description: Ripped from the maw of a boar so stubborn it once headbutted a mountain and won. The stench alone grants its bearer supernatural toughness — or maybe everyone just stays far away.

items.name: Crab Claw Hatchet
items.description: The claw still opens and closes on its own. Mostly at inconvenient moments.

items.name: Apprentice Blade
items.description: The first sword a smith makes that doesn't immediately snap. A milestone. A low one, but still.

items.name: Gildsteel
items.description: It was found where the records say it shouldn't be, so both entries remain on the record, unreconciled.

items.name: Requiem
items.description: It performs adequately, by its own admission, and the maker stands by that, mostly.

items.name: Silkweave Grips
items.description: Won't release whatever it's holding. Wonderful for combat, catastrophic for handshakes.

items.name: Wooligan's eye
items.description: A Wooligan's detached eye is much less intimidating when it can't blink, which turns out to be always.

items.name: Aftershock
items.description: The first strike is polite. It's the next four your ribs will want to discuss.

items.name: Shadowsteel Morningstar
items.description: The spikes drink light rather than reflect it, which makes it a genuinely terrible night-light.

items.name: Diadem Charm
items.description: Its effectiveness has never been independently verified, which nobody has the energy to dispute anymore.

items.name: Mark of the Unbroken
items.description: Press this searing brand against your flesh to prove you're a veteran and it'll be granted to you for life — because nothing says 'battle-hardened warrior' like voluntary third-degree burns.

items.name: Amber
items.description: Fossilized tree sap containing bugs that died millions of years ago, finally useful for something.

items.name: Nightcap Gaia
items.description: A nocturnal variant of the Gaia species that has adapted to perpetual darkness with an enthusiasm that borders on philosophical commitment, carrying its owner's possessions through lightless corridors while radiating a silent and comprehensive disapproval of every decision that led to this arrangement.

items.name: Abyss Loop
items.description: Pulled from water that swallowed the light whole. Still carries the weight of it.

items.name: Talokan Pearl
items.description: A deep-sea pearl carried as currency by the talokan. Glows faintly blue underwater. Land merchants accept it reluctantly.

items.name: Wallbread
items.description: Field medicine issued to the wall's defenders, sealed in wax and rated to keep longer than most of the defenders do. Grim, but honest labelling.

items.name: Fenwood Channeler
items.description: Kweebec bark topped with a charm carved specifically for patience, which it needs — it channels water magic with all the calm serenity of a tap that never quite shuts off.

items.name: Koa Slime Rod
items.description: A stick coated in solidified koa slime. It channels magic or at least pretends to.

items.name: Collapse Bludgeon
items.description: Swung once by a Riftling settling an argument about territory, and the territory stopped arguing. Ends sentences, fights, and occasionally furniture, roughly in that order.

items.name: Goblin Scimitar
items.description: Goblins do not forge swords. They find them. This one was found in someone else's inventory.

items.name: Shark Fin Saber
items.description: Serrated after shark teeth. The sharks remain, understandably, quite bitter about the whole thing.

items.name: Eternal Eclipse
items.description: Exists in permanent shadow regardless of the light source, same as the Voidmoth wing it was cut from. Astronomers have opinions. The blade has never asked for them.

items.name: Bag of Bloodstone
items.description: Everything inside stains red eventually. Statistically, so will everything outside.

items.name: Fate's Reach
items.description: Requisitioned from a lancer who no longer files complaints.

items.name: Corvid Chain
items.description: Each link stamped with a campaign. Nobody has counted them all.

items.name: Quietplate
items.description: Quenched the day one Sundered Soldier line formally broke rank for the last time. The metal quit ringing that afternoon and hasn't made a sound since.

items.name: Moonstone
items.description: Glows faintly under starlight which is utterly useless since miners work underground.

items.name: Larvano Ring
items.description: Pulses like a tiny heartbeat. The scarak hive it came from has not stopped counting its losses.

items.name: Spicerusk
items.description: Twice-baked and aromatic enough that weaponsmiths render the oil for something other than baking.

items.name: Anorak
items.description: The emerald runes etched into this arachnid's carapace pulse with the bound essence of Aragog, the great spider reduced to a manageable size.

items.name: Seraph Resin
items.description: It was found where the records say it shouldn't be, so the ledger simply lists both, side by side.

items.name: Brandmark
items.description: Used to mark conscripts too fresh to know better. Heats fast, fades slow.

items.name: Gobelin's tribe Relic
items.description: The goblins venerate this artifact with the same fervor they apply to not being eaten — meaning desperately and without dignity.

items.name: Cuirass of the Hollow King
items.description: Not armor a king commissioned — armor a Voidmoth grew, that a king later claimed credit for wearing. The distinction mattered to exactly one person, and he's not in a position to argue anymore.

items.name: Loomstock
items.description: Woven under pressure at the deepest bench in the weald, where the layers bond so tightly the seam becomes a rumor rather than a feature.

items.name: Nightcap
items.description: A bioluminescent fungus that pulses with an unsettling azure glow, suggesting origins in caverns where sunlight is less a memory than a rumor. Alchemists covet it for its soporific properties, though the mushroom itself remains profoundly indifferent to their affections.

items.name: Coatcheck
items.description: White fur from a frostwolf, permanently cold to the touch. Useful for coats. Rude to the wolf.

items.name: Crabclaw Guardian Mace
items.description: Standard-issue to the tomb wards. Dents outlast the wielder.

items.name: Infested ring
items.description: A band of hollowed chitin, its grooves teeming with nameless things that wriggle and bite.

items.name: Obsidian Psalter
items.description: Every recipe ends with the same instruction: leave it in until it stops screaming. Works on roasts. Works on heretics.

items.name: Deepwoven Philter
items.description: Steeped in Matron-silk that never fully dissolves, so a thread of it always stays behind, mending things it was never asked to mend.

items.name: Ursine Chaperon
items.description: Makes you look intimidating. Makes your neck hurt. Tradeoffs.

items.name: Bearclaw Trousers
items.description: Heavy enough that squatting becomes a workout. Light enough to run when the workout goes wrong.

items.name: Scalehide Mail
items.description: Fired in the pits where the pyre priests burn the dead. Never fully cools.

items.name: Warscale
items.description: Cut from armor too old to place. The scale pattern matches nothing catalogued in the corps.

items.name: Emberglow Staff
items.description: The ember core at its tip never fully dies. Neither do the burns it inflicts.

items.name: Gecko Chopper
items.description: Wielded, legend insists, by the greatest gecko king Pandora Reach never actually had.

items.name: Rex Scale Breastplate
items.description: Peeled scale by scale off something that ruled the food chain and knew it.

items.name: Woolice Fleece Legguards
items.description: So comfortable that two separate adventurers have napped mid-battle wearing them. Undefeated record.

items.name: Kraken Temple Key
items.description: Corroded by salt and barnacles. The tentacle motif on the handle is not subtle.

items.name: Brackish Waraxe
items.description: The corrosion crept into the haft and stopped, held off by nothing anyone can identify, which the wielder tries not to rely on too heavily.

items.name: Wool fists
items.description: Nothing says 'desperate brawler' quite like punching enemies with weaponized livestock byproduct.

items.name: Ashtablet
items.description: Baked in the pyre pits until it stopped being anything else. Smiths press it flat before it cools.

items.name: Reprise
items.description: The choir sings a line, then sings it again, harder. So do these. Learn the tempo or wear the second verse.

items.name: Stormwalker Boots
items.description: Walks through any storm without complaint. The boots, not the wearer — the wearer complains constantly.

items.name: Saurian Bow
items.description: Strung tight enough to drop something that was, until recently, actively hunting you.

items.name: Arcanize
items.description: Peasants have learned the hard way that harvesting glowing crops is the leading cause of spontaneous wizardry in agricultural communities.

items.name: Cinderchoir Tassets Vitrified
items.description: Reinforced where praying wears fastest. The patches are new; the knees beneath are a lost cause.

items.name: Coldwalk
items.description: The void seeps up through the soles. Wearers report warm hearts and unbearable toes.

items.name: Malt
items.description: Some warriors prefer their courage fermented, others distilled — this grain accommodates both philosophies.

items.name: Ramhorn Battlecleaver
items.description: Legend calls it the axe that ended an age. History mostly just remembers the fence it hit.

items.name: Spectral Essence
items.description: Distilled from the Soulless Regent himself. Smells like the void between stars. Absolutely ruinous market value.

items.name: Dragonlily
items.description: A botanical impossibility clad in iridescent scales and exuding a malodorous perfume best described as funeral parlor crossed with sulfur pit, which even actual dragons find disagreeable enough to avoid. Scholars remain divided on whether it is a plant pretending to be a reptile or a reptile that has given up on ambition.

items.name: Weaver's Shivs
items.description: Tipped with spider silk gland. The poison is slow. The regret arrives early.

items.name: Voidkeen
items.description: Grew its own fuller, its own edge, its own faint reluctance to be sheathed, none of which the smith takes credit for.

items.name: Spectral Edge
items.description: Half in this world, half in the next. Customs at the border are very particular.

items.name: Deadmaw
items.description: Hades seldom lends his hounds to mortals, yet this scorched beast now pads faithfully alongside a new master.

items.name: Glacial Verdict
items.description: The blade hands down its own ruling on every fight: guilty of standing too close.

items.name: Pyrehymn Gauntlets
items.description: Tea towels wound tight to the wrist. Somewhere a kitchen drawer misses them terribly.

items.name: Cinder Heart Staff
items.description: Carries an ember that never fully cools. The march remembers its warmth.

items.name: Malt Flour
items.description: Flour with a sweet, malty undertone that makes bread taste suspiciously like it is trying to become beer.

items.name: Leviathan Tentacles
items.description: Cured stiff after being pried from something the Kraken calls family. It still twitches. Occasionally.

items.name: Antiphon Grips Voices
items.description: Flour to the forearm, forever. The dough fought back exactly once.

items.name: Scarak Shell
items.description: Chitinous plate that clicks when you flick it. Makes decent shingles. The queen would be furious if she had emotions.

items.name: Hymnbound Hatchet
items.description: Light in the hand, heavy in the aftermath. Leaves a fine grey dust that gets into everything.

items.name: Raptorscale Gauntlets
items.description: Each scale was pried from a raptor that objected, vocally, at considerable length.

items.name: Scythe of the Abyss
items.description: When you stare into the abyss and the abyss hands you a weapon. Surprisingly good customer service.

items.name: Venomscale Signet
items.description: Stamped with what passed for a face on one particular Cinder Shade before the fire finished its edits. Sealed documents arrive smelling faintly of char. Recipients don't ask.

items.name: Crabclaw Grips
items.description: Fashioned from pincers that spent a lifetime clamping onto things and refusing to let go. The gauntlets inherited this trait. Removing them requires warm water, patience, and a friend who won't judge you.

items.name: Bearclaw Grips
items.description: Reinforced knuckles for when words fail. Words always fail.

items.name: Originite
items.description: Pressed from the oldest fibers on the mountain into something that refuses to behave like its age. Suspiciously springy for a relic.

items.name: Coronet Visor
items.description: It functions on a technicality, and the committee never reconvened to revisit it.

items.name: Bag of Crimson Truffles
items.description: Fifty truffles, one container, and a market value the stitching was never rated for.

items.name: Scarab Cleaver
items.description: Shaped like a wing. Flies exactly as well as the merchant's other claims held up.

items.name: Riftcleave
items.description: Splits whatever it hits into a clean 'before' and 'after,' the same way the Riftling it's named for split from its own molt-line. A 'later' is rarely part of the outcome.

items.name: Feran Whiskered Mitts
items.description: Grown back within the week. The ferans, unbothered, already regret nothing.

items.name: Tidecore
items.description: A core that grows heavier and lighter on a slow cycle no craftsman has matched to anything, least of all to a tide the weald denies having.

items.name: Cinchward
items.description: Tightens by itself when the wearer forgets to breathe carefully near the wound. It holds firm opinions about posture.

items.name: Crooked Staff
items.description: A walking stick with delusions of magical grandeur. The only spell it casts is 'mild embarrassment'.

items.name: Seraphbound Casque
items.description: It holds up under scrutiny, barely, so it shipped anyway, doubts and all.

items.name: Scalehide Hauberk
items.description: Cured in bog-water until the rust gave up. Smells like the marsh because it is the marsh.

items.name: Quillbound Cord
items.description: It holds up under scrutiny, barely, a claim that has never once been tested.

items.name: Jade Pickaxe
items.description: Uses jade to mine jade. The philosophical implications are lost on most miners, who are too busy getting rich.

items.name: Threshcinch
items.description: Cinched by a Gate Watcher who measured every threshold by hand-span before deciding whether to let it stay open. The buckle still clicks in five distinct positions. Nobody remembers what they mean.

items.name: Sutureband
items.description: Bent into a closed loop the way the Suture Priests close everything, on the theory that the Scar can't unravel what was never left open.

items.name: Magmooligan Sabatons
items.description: Cast in the vents a Cinder Shade favored for warming its feet between patrols. Stay hot for weeks after crafting, which the smiths list as a feature and the wearers list as a complaint.

items.name: Gilded Circle
items.description: Whether it's reliable remains an open debate, so the manual was left deliberately vague.

items.name: Obsidian Signet
items.description: Presses a mark into hot wax and, given the chance, into the odd forehead. It seals things either way.

items.name: Emberchant Treads
items.description: Knitted thick enough to cross the cold flagstones at midnight without waking the crypt.

items.name: Mo Hood
items.description: A tattered hood strung with tiny skulls. Mo never explains where they came from, and nobody asks twice.

items.name: Whiskerbind
items.description: Six feran whiskers, each a precision instrument the feran would very much like returned.

items.name: Codex of the Damned
items.description: Bound in barrow-leather. Every spell inside failed its caster at least once.

items.name: Bara Hood (Sapphire)
items.description: A plain hooded cowl offered in a spread of gemstone linings. Cheap, honest, everywhere.

items.name: Hades Breath
items.description: Channels whatever the gate below exhales between openings. Smells of it too, which the enchanter really should have mentioned before the fitting.

items.name: Frosthowl Stilettos
items.description: Daggers that whistle in the cold. The sound is deeply unsettling to both enemies and allies. Mostly allies.

items.name: Godspear Impaler
items.description: Forged to hold a line at a threshold no Gate Watcher was ever meant to hold alone. Whichever end you grip matters less than whether you're standing on the right side of the gate.

items.name: Crabclaw Crown
items.description: Forged from the pincers of a crab that pinched exactly the wrong archmage. The ghost still complains.

items.name: Elder Totem Girdle
items.description: Tied on for the final muster. The names read that day are still recorded somewhere.

items.name: Bara Hood (Vitality)
items.description: A plain hooded cowl offered in a spread of gemstone linings. Cheap, honest, everywhere.

items.name: Frostbound Band
items.description: Marks the hour without a sound. Someone still winds it, out of habit.

items.name: Ghostcap Philter
items.description: Glows faintly for an hour after you drink it, long enough to find your way out of the dark and just long enough for something to find you.

items.name: Venom Band
items.description: The alchemist who stabilized this coating lost two fingers proving it works. It works.

items.name: Groundbreaker
items.description: Marketed for prospecting. Used, exclusively, for the other thing.

items.name: Hiveguard Enforcer
items.description: Hardened with hive wax and dusk-forged steel. It enforces one law: the hive comes first.

items.name: Rex Jawbone Talisman
items.description: A single rex fang, polished and mounted as a talisman. The previous owner was not a rex. The one before was.

items.name: Voidcleave
items.description: Cleaves through armor, morale, and the occasional dimensional barrier. Handle with existential care.

items.name: Venomcore
items.description: Purified toxin used in poison-tipped weapons and several regrettable bar bets.

items.name: Drownmarked Loop Matron
items.description: Cast from a fang the Matron left in something she decided wasn't worth finishing, a distinction the wearer would rather not share.

items.name: Primordial Legplates
items.description: Salvaged after the fourth push failed. The fifth wore them anyway.

items.name: Thornspine Greaves
items.description: Reinforced with quills from something small and extremely opinionated about being sat on.

items.name: Pearlshard Seal
items.description: Pressed from the still-hot core of a Cinder Shade, cooled just enough to wear without regret. Runs warm against the skin in a way that sharpens focus at exactly the wrong moments.

items.name: Whisker Weave Belt
items.description: Six ferans contributed, unwillingly, to a belt not one of them will ever be caught wearing.

items.name: Emberchant Core
items.description: A coal that simply will not go out. Forges love it; anyone carrying it in a pocket learns fast to stop.

items.name: Frost Totemic Club
items.description: Topped with a frozen totemic effigy. Its carved expression changes with the weather. And your luck.

items.name: Bogforged Greataxe Tide
items.description: Hammered on a bog anvil that swallows sparks whole, which the smith found unsettling and the axe apparently found agreeable.

items.name: Cataclysm Tassets Breach
items.description: Plated at the hip by whichever Gate Watcher pulled fifth shift on the day the count stopped meaning anything. The metal remembers standing at attention. The wearer's legs, less so.

items.name: Cindervisor
items.description: Angled to catch the first light that ever crossed the Scar, which the smiths claim is different light. Nobody's proven them wrong, chiefly because nobody's proven them anything.

items.name: Ocean Sigil Treads
items.description: Walk on water. Not literally. But close enough to annoy physicists.

items.name: Magmooligan Gauntlets
items.description: Built to end a charge in one exchange. Rarely needs a second.

items.name: Apexbound Helm
items.description: Cast to withstand whatever the Wound exhales when it's forced shut. The visor seals from the inside, which tells you who it's really protecting the wearer from.

items.name: Bloodwheat Bread
items.description: The crimson crumb pulses faintly when cut. Bakers insist it is a thermal reaction. Bakers are liars.

items.name: Regalfall Breastplate
items.description: It functions, technically, in most conditions, which is exactly as reassuring as it sounds.

items.name: Overhang
items.description: Protects the head from everything except the thing directly above it, which is the actual threat here.

items.name: Silkamu
items.description: Woven from threads no spider surrendered willingly. The arachnid union has placed a bounty on the weaver's head, payable in flies.

items.name: Splitpitch
items.description: Oozes from a rock that split in two and never forgave either half.

items.name: Bearfury
items.description: The bear whose claw went into this axe was reportedly quite annoyed about it. Understandable.

items.name: Hymnbound Cuirass
items.description: Worn over everything, committed to nothing. Pockets deep enough to lose a censer in.

items.name: Crystal Ward Tome
items.description: Encrusted with shattered crystal. Every spell cast through it sounds like a chandelier falling very slowly.

items.name: Wraith-Touch Gauntlets
items.description: Everything they touch turns faintly, politely dead. Roughly the effect of your love life, several regulars at the tavern have pointed out, but now at least it's wearable.

items.name: Moonfang Waistguard
items.description: A belt fashioned from moonfang alpha hide. Howls faintly during full moons. Awkward at dinner parties.

items.name: Wealdknot
items.description: Tied in the same root-knots the weald's guides use to mark a safe trail. Whether the knots still mean anything this deep is a separate question.

items.name: Tidebound Grips Mire
items.description: Recovered gauntlets from the drowned court, still curled in the grip of holding something the silt long since took.

items.name: Goldenfleece Whisper
items.description: Lined in golden fleece and so light it barely announces itself in your grip — which is precisely the problem for everyone standing on the other side of it.

items.name: Bag of Arcanite
items.description: The humming gets louder when you carry more than ten. Nobody knows why and nobody wants to find out.

items.name: Embalmed Bow
items.description: Preserved in the burial spice. Drawn from a corpse-keeper's arsenal. The string was never meant for the living; it still holds.

items.name: Dregs
items.description: The last pour of the pot. Bitter, gritty, and somehow the strongest cup of the day.

items.name: Cursed Gem
items.description: Whispers dark promises to anyone who holds it too long, though the promises are mostly about back pain.

items.name: Training Battleaxe
items.description: Weighted with lead instead of sharpened with steel. Excellent for building arm mass. Terrible for everything else.

items.name: Emberbrew
items.description: Boiled down until it holds against the kind of injury the Wound hands out, meaning the injuries nobody expects to walk away from. Some do now.

items.name: Warkneel
items.description: The kneeling stance of a last order, locked into the joints of a kneeling Sundered Soldier by whatever finished the rift's work. Standing back up takes a fresh decision every time.

items.name: Fenwire
items.description: Iron-hard reed that grows only where the fen runs deepest, harvested by those willing to reach an arm in and trust it comes back.

items.name: Molten Verse Hauberk Pyre
items.description: Cut from the nave great curtains. Moths took the hem; the grandeur survived.

items.name: Ivory Orchid Paste
items.description: A paste so smooth it could negotiate peace treaties, if peace treaties smelled like cave fungus and regret.

items.name: Spicebark Bread
items.description: One bite and every sinus in a three-table radius surrenders unconditionally.

items.name: Scarak Chitin Crown
items.description: Wearing a scarak's head on your head. There's a philosophical recursion here that the scaraks definitely haven't thought about.

items.name: Shark Fin
items.description: A dorsal fin from a hammerhead. Soup merchants have been arrested for less.

items.name: Blunt Cudgel
items.description: A stick with pretensions of being a weapon. Your enemies will die of laughter, eventually.

items.name: Goblin Masher
items.description: Goblins don't season their food so much as introduce it to this. The technique transfers remarkably well to skulls.

items.name: Sealcore
items.description: A core forged around a fragment of genesis and sealed the way the Oracle seals a wound — tightly, and with a written note advising against opening it.

items.name: Packfang
items.description: Six inches of yellowed canine. The alpha who wore this was not available for comment. Or breathing.

items.name: Palespear
items.description: Tipped in pale lunar shell, cold right to the point, a small comfort to whoever holds the far end in the fever-warm dark.

items.name: Venomfang Battleaxe
items.description: The spider venom on this blade barely adds to the damage. The look on your opponent's face when they notice the colour of the edge does considerably more of the actual work.

items.name: Bag of Witherblooms
