items.description: Each bloom saves its finest performance for the moment it dies, with the theatrical commitment of an actor determined to be remembered. Open the bag and every bard within earshot reaches for a quill mid-conversation.

items.name: Nerak's Marrow Crown
items.description: Said to be cut from Nerak's own spine by a bone-merchant who turned to dust mid-sentence, which the court considers the single most convincing review it's ever received. Wear it and the wind starts telling you things. Best not to answer back.

items.name: Barley Bread
items.description: A dense loaf that tastes like a farmer's entire personality. Filling, dependable, and utterly joyless.

items.name: Slothian's Patience
items.description: It travels slowly, the way everything a slothian does travels slowly, and lands like the ground itself changed its mind about staying put. Nobody's ever accused it of being in a hurry.

items.name: Hymnbound Sabatons
items.description: Channel the ground-heat out through the heel. Warm feet, scorched footprints, no complaints yet.

items.name: Glacial March Boots
items.description: Built for the eternal march through frozen wastes. Or the commute. Same energy.

items.name: Antiphon Grips Verse
items.description: Made for laundry day. Wring a shirt, a mop, or the truth out of somebody.

items.name: Canopyrend
items.description: Balanced for felling the canopy-vine that ropes the tiers shut, a mundane task it performs with wildly disproportionate enthusiasm.

items.name: Flooded Nave Key
items.description: Slick with nave-water that never quite dries. The Drowned Prior still leads a congregation down there; nobody has explained who's left to preach to.

items.name: Cinderpitch
items.description: Sap boiled down over Scar-heat until it sets glassy and holds a seam better than most metals. It smells, faintly and permanently, of the fire that made it.

items.name: Mirepane
items.description: Silt-glass melted down and re-set with something living stirred in, which the crafters swear improves the temper and never specify whose.

items.name: Shadowsteel Greaves
items.description: The shadow knight's final creation before retiring to keep bees in complete darkness.

items.name: Threefold
items.description: Struck once by the smith, folded twice more by something that isn't a smith. Nobody's asked what.

items.name: Zenithscar Draught
items.description: Bitter enough to keep a sentry awake through a watch the quiet part of them would rather sleep through. It respects neither the sentry's wishes nor the enemy's.

items.name: Scalehide Breastplate
items.description: A full plate of salvaged war-steel. Getting into it costs more than getting out.

items.name: Truelength
items.description: Measured against the smith's own forearm, a unit of measurement that died with him. The sword remains the only copy.

items.name: Ivory Gaia
items.description: An earthbound guardian spirit, sworn to keep buried riches away from careless plunderers.

items.name: Claude's Axe
items.description: Once wielded by the tireless Claude, whose stamina in battle became the stuff of legends — and whose stamina in bed became the stuff of nightmares.

items.name: Crude Ring
items.description: Bent wire with aspirations of being jewelry. If you squint and tilt your head it almost looks intentional.

items.name: Shark Mail
items.description: Shark fin scales sewn onto mithril rings. Waterproof, sharkproof, and a conversation piece.

items.name: Brackish Legguards Deep
items.description: Wading-rated for water that would rot anything else off the leg, which it eventually will to these too; the smith just won't say when.

items.name: Cinderchoir Alloy
items.description: Rings a chord when struck, which is charming right up until you need to work it quietly.

items.name: Tremor Crest
items.description: Vibrates faintly at all times. After a week you stop noticing. That's the problem.

items.name: Razmo Bone Pike
items.description: Carved from a razmo femur. The teeth marks are a feature, not a flaw.

items.name: Throneless Sabatons Godbone
items.description: Its origin story changes depending on who tells it, and the paperwork reflects none of this.

items.name: Pyre Crown Fragment
items.description: A piece of the Cinder Tyrant's head ornament. Radiates authority and extreme heat. Followers form involuntarily near it.

items.name: Cinderchoir Cincture Pyre
items.description: Warm to the hand and quietly shedding grey. You will find ash in your rations for weeks.

items.name: Crownrot Greaves
items.description: It does exactly one thing, and disputes even that; nobody involved will say if that was the plan all along.

items.name: Sunscale Cuirass
items.description: A cuirass of gleaming scales that offers protection from steel and spells alike, assuming one doesn't roast inside it first.

items.name: Diadem Lattice Crown
items.description: Its exact properties depend on who is asked, a discrepancy nobody has been assigned to resolve.

items.name: Sky Shard
items.description: A solidified piece of storm cloud that floats if you let go. Arcanists bind them into staves. Gravity is offended.

items.name: Cinderchoir Warboots
items.description: Soles poured from cooling runoff. They hold the day's heat well into the freezing night. A gift, mostly.

items.name: Maw Visage
items.description: A helm that insists on being right even when the facts suggest otherwise. It makes principled stands about nothing in particular.

items.name: Scarwalkers
items.description: Worn thin by pilgrims who walked the Scar's edge more times than the leggings, frankly, were built for.

items.name: Bone Marrow Club
items.description: Hollowed from a Marrow Shambler's own femur and packed with lead for good measure. Somewhere below, Nerak is said to notice things like this eventually. Best to have a good excuse ready.

items.name: Stingsac
items.description: Swollen with toxin. One puncture turns your evening from 'adventuring' into 'negotiating with a healer.'

items.name: Quillhide
items.description: Boar belly skin so dense it stops arrows. Nature's kevlar, except it smells terrible and nobody thanks you.

items.name: Crownfire Rod
items.description: It works, provisionally, pending further review, so nobody bothered filing a complaint.

items.name: Shadowsteel Cuirass
items.description: The previous owner left a forwarding address. Nobody has been brave enough to check it.

items.name: Duskspot
items.description: Spotted cat-kin fur, incredibly supple. Leather workers get teary-eyed at the quality. The feran was less emotional.

items.name: Bag of Dragonlilies
items.description: Fifty dragonlilies, scales overlapping, rustling just loud enough that the porch cat won't sleep tonight.

items.name: Stormfeather Shortbow
items.description: Limbed with kweebec bark and strung with storm-charged feathers that hum before every shot.

items.name: Bag of Wheat
items.description: Fifty bushels of wheat. The Chaff Sentinel gave its life; the bakery gave a shrug.

items.name: Damp-Iridescent Hide
items.description: Thick, iridescent, and carries faint moisture. Armorers weave them into aquatic plate. Dry-cleaning not recommended.

items.name: Wraith Whisper Knives
items.description: Quenched in wraith ectoplasm, they cut cleanly through armor and, somewhat less cleanly, through sleep. The wounds close properly, victims report. The dreams never quite do.

items.name: Grizzly Persuader
items.description: Bear-claw studs, boar-hide wrap, golden fleece lining. Lighter than it looks, heavier than you would hope. Very persuasive.

items.name: Lastline
items.description: Cut for the leg that intends to reach the boundary and stop there, which the plating enforces by being genuinely unpleasant to run in.

items.name: Titan Koa Stompers
items.description: Built for the mud, not for silence. Silence was never the point of a column on the march.

items.name: Lavachitin Coil
items.description: Mild in the hand. A genuine liability the moment you actually cast something.

items.name: Phantom Gaia
items.description: Grandmother swore her nanny-goat walked through the cellar wall every full moon and came back smelling of spores. Nobody believed her until the goats started doing it themselves. This one still prefers the wall to the door.

items.name: Wraith's Testament
items.description: Written by someone with very strong opinions about the afterlife's customer service.

items.name: Steppemeal
items.description: Milled from grain that crossed a hundred bad harvests to get here, the flour bakes into loaves tough enough that one village reportedly used the leftovers as a doorstop for a generation.

items.name: Journeyman Saber
items.description: Good enough to kill a goblin if the goblin stands very still and agrees to be stabbed. Progress.

items.name: Pyre Ash
items.description: A dustpan of cathedral floor: ash, glass glitter, and one lost earring per shovelful.

items.name: Pyrecleaver
items.description: Technically for firewood. The congregation files past it very politely.

items.name: Wardcore
items.description: The dense heart-metal recovered from a fallen Guardian's chest-plate, and only ever from a fallen one. Nobody has yet worked out how to ask a standing Guardian for theirs.

items.name: Ivory Shrooms
items.description: Cream-colored mushrooms that seem almost luminescent against the dark earth from which they sprout. Proof that even in the darkest places, beauty exists—usually right before it kills you.

items.name: Twine Belt
items.description: Woven from whatever was growing near the road. It smells faintly of desperation and holds together through sheer spite. The knot is decorative. The function is theoretical.

items.name: Firstmarked
items.description: Scored with the same mark the Wound leaves on everything it grazes. The smiths added it deliberately, which the Wound found unnecessary and slightly insulting.

items.name: Gilded Carapace
items.description: It works on the honor system, which nobody can confirm without starting the argument over.

items.name: Bag of Ukranize
items.description: Ukranize grain never took to good soil — the story goes it prefers wherever the harvest is hardest to reach. Wise crop. Terrible for your knees.

items.name: Nullband
items.description: Set with a stone that isn't. Looking directly at the empty setting is not recommended twice.

items.name: Phantom Spore
items.description: Half in this world and half wherever spores go when they'd rather not be touched, they slip through unworthy fingers like a rumour slipping through a closed door. Harvesting them takes an empty mind — a state most herbalists reach only by accident.

items.name: Cinder Loop
items.description: Set with shards of a cinder heart. Pleasantly warm, and now and then far too warm once a few drinks are in.

items.name: Ember Silk
items.description: Thread spun from cocoons that smolder eternally, warm to the touch and perilous to the careless hand.

items.name: Ancient Tusk Cleaver
items.description: Carved from a rib that grew wrong. Still holds an edge.

items.name: Basalt Falchion
items.description: You swing, they answer, the conversation ends. Rarely a long dialogue.

items.name: Coronet Rod
items.description: The design committee never actually agreed on this, which is either reassuring or deeply concerning.

items.name: Rex Fang
items.description: A tooth longer than your forearm. The rex that grew this was very large and very angry. In that order.

items.name: Yajin's broken daggers
items.description: Yajin's twin blades have known better days, their edges dulled by countless failed attempts at violence.

items.name: Obsidianite Powder
items.description: Microscopic shards suspended in mineral dust, with safety notices long enough to wallpaper a healer's waiting room. They are, without exception, all justified.

items.name: Evergreen
items.description: A living leaf that refuses to wilt. Druids use them as focus items. The leaf judges your character silently.

items.name: Sundered Elixir
items.description: The final brew a unit puts up before it stops being a unit. Loud going down. Quiet after.

items.name: Frost Sabre
items.description: A curved blade trailing frost. Every swing is a relationship ender.

items.name: Mineral Biscuit
items.description: A biscuit fortified with diamond dust. Technically edible, practically a grinding wheel for your molars.

items.name: Ursine Plate
items.description: Refuses to quit out of pure, magnificent spite. It's working so far.

items.name: Seraphbound Cordial Crown
items.description: Nobody quite agrees on its aftertaste, so it's sold with a shrug instead of a guarantee.

items.name: Hive Warden Mace
items.description: Coated to the haft in wax the Combmother herself pressed. Every scarak in the deep galleries gives the bearer a wide, respectful berth — the smart ones, anyway; the tale never mentions the foolish ones twice.

items.name: Wolfcrest Helm
items.description: Crowned with a preserved wolf's head that stares forward with an expression somewhere between menacing and mildly inconvenienced. The taxidermist was reportedly drunk, which explains the slightly crossed eyes and the tongue that pokes out on the left side.

items.name: Frostfang Requiem
items.description: Half sword, half funeral hymn. Guess which part you hear first.

items.name: Haloforged Resin
items.description: It was declared authentic by a narrow margin, which changes depending on the season and the asker.

items.name: Balmleaf
items.description: A succulent leaf full of soothing gel. Healers swear by it, alchemists hoard it, and everyone else wonders why a plant is worth fighting over.

items.name: Stoneheart
items.description: Cold to the touch at every hour, in every season, regardless of what's happening to the person wearing it.

items.name: Diadem Casque Crown
items.description: The wearer insists it works; the evidence is inconclusive, a decision made under considerable time pressure.

items.name: Aftershakes
items.description: Deliver the blow, then a little extra buzz. The extra is not a feature you can turn off.

items.name: Haloforged Fists Regent
items.description: The design committee never actually agreed on this, so the matter remains, for now, unresolved.

items.name: Sharkhide Fists
items.description: Shark skin wrapped over thorium plates. The rough texture doubles as a cheese grater.

items.name: Threadlock
items.description: Strengthens textile fibers to withstand combat-grade abuse. Tailors soak every thread in this before stitching anything serious.

items.name: Moltmail
items.description: Chainmail sized for a Riftling's pre-molt frame, every ring cast slightly wrong on purpose. It holds together the way the Riftling did: barely, and only under tension.

items.name: Brackish Grips
items.description: The salt got into the joints and stayed, so they seize now and then at the worst possible moment, reliably.

items.name: Pearl Shard Mace
items.description: Studded with crab pearl fragments. Every hit sounds like wind chimes at a funeral.

items.name: Chitin Shellplate
items.description: They say wearing it protects against backstabbers, mostly because the stench ensures no one ever gets close enough to try.

items.name: Gravegrip
items.description: Surprisingly hard to snap in two. The old rigor, the diggers say, never really lets go of a draugr — and apparently didn't read the part where it was supposed to stop after death.

items.name: Moonstone Cactee
items.description: Only visible during full moons and overcast Tuesdays. Nobody has figured out why Tuesdays.

items.name: Fenpulse
items.description: The actual heart of a fen dread, still beating very slowly. Store in a sealed container unless you want nightmares.

items.name: Regalfall Grips
items.description: It works, provisionally, pending further review, a small mercy, considering the alternative.

items.name: Arcane Gaia
items.description: A Gaia specimen inscribed with luminous arcane runes that pulse in sequences no living scholar has managed to decode, though several have published competing translations ranging from profound cosmological truths to what appears to be an inventory manifest. It carries burdens with the dignified resignation of a creature that suspects it was meant for greater things.

items.name: Rusty Daggers
items.description: The tetanus is a feature, not a bug. Every hit comes with a complimentary infection risk.

items.name: Crimson Truffle
items.description: A subterranean delicacy so rare its price is set by auction, not by any sane market logic.

items.name: Scarforged Tonic
items.description: Doled out one swallow per climber for the final push, on the reasoning that anyone who needs a second swallow isn't finishing the climb anyway.

items.name: Saurian War Harness
items.description: Cut down from a harness built for a saurian three sizes larger than any wearer since, the armourer grumbling the whole while about craft and dignity. It still carries a faint air of a territory nobody's dared re-claim.

items.name: Ambush-Bone Talisman
items.description: A bone totem from a feran's belt, smelling of prey blood and ambush. Rangers pay double, no questions.

items.name: Hollow Signet
items.description: Presses a blank seal into wax. The blankness is the point.

items.name: Faultline Visor
items.description: In this world the horizon has a seam in it. Staring at it for luck is optional and unwise.

items.name: Bindthread Grips
items.description: Fingertips glow whenever a familiar creeps close. Handy. Occasionally a little too intimate.

items.name: Coronet Lattice
items.description: Its classification has been disputed since it was found, which the survey team still argues about.

items.name: Cursed Root
items.description: Pulled from cursed fungus with real effort, since it has a habit of gripping back harder than anything lacking a spine has any business managing. It stays warm in storage and twitches on occasion. Veteran herbalists call this normal in a tone that convinces absolutely nobody.

items.name: Bristleguard Cuirass
items.description: Tusker hide cured in its own bile, because tuskers are exactly the kind of creature that would insist on that.

items.name: Twitchstraw
items.description: Taken from a scarecrow that was significantly more animate than expected. Still twitches when nobody's looking.

items.name: Rexfang Daggers
items.description: Paired blades capped with rex fangs and lashed in grave-silk. Quick enough to split the breeze, and whatever was hiding behind it.

items.name: Coldgrip
items.description: The fingers never quite warm up. Handy for tempers, terrible for handshakes.

items.name: Wither Pastry
items.description: A pastry that decays anything organic it touches except itself. Alchemists use it as a controlled necrotic reagent.

items.name: Arcaneshroom
items.description: A fungus suffused with residual arcane energy that causes it to emit a faint, accusatory glow, as though it holds the harvester personally responsible for disturbing its scholarly contemplation. Handling it with bare skin has been known to produce involuntary levitation, temporary synesthesia, and an inexplicable craving for dusty tomes.

items.name: Iron Sickle
items.description: A curved blade that cuts herbs with surgical precision. The previous owner was not a surgeon, which explains the blood.

items.name: Hollow Tome
items.description: Half the names are crossed out. The book keeps writing them anyway.

items.name: Shadowsteel Treads
items.description: Forged during an eclipse by a knight who insisted on total silence and mostly achieved it.

items.name: Sutureline
items.description: Cinched the way the Suture Priests cinch a wound before it can widen. Works about as well on a waist as it does on the Scar.

items.name: Embalmed Silk Ring
items.description: A ring woven from embalmed silk. The dead have a surprisingly firm handshake when wearing this.

items.name: Riftlattice
items.description: A brittle frame grown along the lip of the Scar, where the crystal takes the fracture's shape whether the crafter wants it to or not.

items.name: Healing Potion
items.description: Standard-issue battlefield restorative. Glows faintly, heals adequately, and smells worse than the wound it treats.

items.name: Fuwa Hood (White)
items.description: The matching hood. Wearing both at once is a documented cause of spontaneous cuteness.

items.name: Tempest Whisper
items.description: A bow strung with sky shard filament. Arrows fly so fast they arrive before the sound.

items.name: Summitsteel
items.description: The strongest alloy the summit forge can hold before the crucible itself gives out. The smiths know the exact temperature and never write it down.

items.name: Goblin Wartop
items.description: A helmet that has passed through more goblin skulls than a particularly persistent headache. Each owner carved their name inside, resulting in a layered history of increasingly poor penmanship. The dents add character. The bloodstains add context.

items.name: Suizemeal
items.description: Crystalline and light-catching enough that bakers swear it makes bread taste more expensive.

items.name: Last Guardian Aegis
items.description: Worn by the Last Guardian since before the Scar had a name, dented in places nothing since has managed to dent twice. Not once has it been the reason the wall fell.

items.name: Obsidian Elixir
items.description: One small glass before bed. The bed is optional; the glass is not.

items.name: Stormplume Wraps
items.description: Thin as a promise, fast as an excuse. Perfect for the nimble-fingered.

items.name: Wraith Scripture
items.description: It writes itself when nobody's watching, in a hand that keeps changing along with whoever's reading it. Scholars who've studied it can't agree if that's fascinating or deeply, personally alarming. It's usually both.

items.name: Regalfall Warbelt
items.description: The instructions were lost in a heated debate, so the original argument was declared a draw.

items.name: Spectral Fangs
items.description: Forged from condensed ghost complaints. Every stab comes with an itemized grievance.

items.name: Siltgreave
items.description: The silt shell adds a stone's weight to each step, which the wearer stops noticing right around the time everyone else does.

items.name: Wolfbone Blade
items.description: The handle is carved from a timber wolf femur. It howls in strong winds, which is either atmospheric or deeply concerning.

items.name: Sabertooth Band
items.description: More decoration than defense. But it looks fantastic while dodging.

items.name: Pyre Cleaver
items.description: The cinder heart embedded in the pommel keeps the edge permanently hot. Great for combat. Terrible for scabbards.

items.name: Raptor Bone Bow
items.description: Carved from a raptor's own ribs, still holding the shape of its final furious charge. Every arrow leaves the string fast, angry, and utterly unconcerned with your opinion of the matter.

items.name: Draconite Cactee
items.description: Radiates heat like a furnace with feelings. Terrible for your leather satchel, wonderful for cold nights.

items.name: Arcane Reagent
items.description: Seven herbs, a splash of water, and no earthly reason for the purple glow. Alchemists file that under research; everyone else files it under warning sign.

items.name: Fenwave
items.description: Its wave-pattern deepens the longer it sits in fen-water, so an old one cuts a wound no straight blade could stitch shut.

items.name: Glacial Loop
items.description: A ring of frozen crystal that regenerates when chipped. You will, eventually, stop being cold. Eventually.

items.name: Frostshamble Girdle
items.description: Cinches your trousers in place while something considerably less alive shuffles along behind you.

items.name: Cinderchoir Locket
items.description: Holds a pinch of a burned hymnal. On still nights the ash arranges itself into legible verses. Don't read them.

items.name: Throneless Cleaver
items.description: The craftsmanship is sound; the premise is not, a compromise reached after everyone gave up arguing.

items.name: Cursed Amalgam
items.description: The culmination of an herbalist career condensed into one jar. It whispers at night. Nobody asks what it says.

items.name: Obsidian Cordial
items.description: A bright ascending warmth that lifts the spirits and, briefly, the actual hair on your arms.

items.name: Razmaster's Verdict
items.description: The Razmaster settles all disputes the same way. This blade is the closing argument.

items.name: Embalmed Locket
items.description: Holds a portrait painted on burial silk. The face inside hasn't aged since the sitting.

items.name: Hivewax Cinch
items.description: Chitin from scarak who died the way they'd lived — shoulder to shoulder, ten thousand strong, convinced right up to the end that the swarm made them safe.

items.name: Goblin-Powder Cudgel
items.description: Packed with goblin gunpowder in the head. Nobody told the goblins that was the plan. Nobody tells goblins anything.

items.name: Melted Koa
items.description: Found curled by a cooling pyre. Refuses to leave the warmth.

items.name: Goblin Raider Vest
items.description: Patched together from at least four different armours, none of which matched and none of which were acquired legally. There's a faded insignia on the chest that says 'Property Of' followed by a name scratched out so aggressively it left a hole.

items.name: Halo Draught
items.description: The dosage instructions contradict themselves halfway down the label, which the brewer insists was intentional.

items.name: Venomscale Leggings
items.description: Cut for the last column to march the line. It did not come back.

items.name: Fenrot Draught
items.description: Ferments a little more with every day it isn't drunk, until eventually it stops being medicine and starts being a decision.

items.name: Hornhead Greaves
items.description: Hammered from bronze dense enough to turn a blade and heavy enough to make every staircase a mortal enemy. The smith, they say, had forearms like felled trees. Wearers are expected to grow their own.

items.name: Primordial Worldpiercer
items.description: The last thing you craft before the L100 gate, and the first thing that survives it.

items.name: Emberchant Extract
items.description: What remains after the boiling. The cook calls it stock; the alchemist calls it a solvent; the drain calls it a colleague.

items.name: Grimreminder
items.description: Issued to new pilgrims as a lesson in what the Scar does to enthusiasm. Most keep it long after the lesson lands.

items.name: Sundered Stompers
items.description: The rift beneath answers every footfall a Sundered Soldier takes, which rather defeats the purpose of the sneaking lessons. Surprise entrances are, structurally, off the table.

items.name: Dragonite Crust
items.description: The crust fights back when broken. Axe smiths embed shards into axe heads for a self-sharpening edge effect.

items.name: Slackline
items.description: Never actually slack. The name is what the previous owner called it, right before it wasn't.

items.name: Bamboo Staff
items.description: This weathered bamboo pole has guided countless wanderers through marsh and moorland alike. Curiously, it functions equally well as a walking aid and as an impromptu lesson in humility.

items.name: Silt Wrapped Maul
items.description: Its silt casing adds a stone of weight and, on impact, a small burst of the weald floor, so every blow leaves a little of home behind.

items.name: Tribal Summoner's Totem
items.description: A totem carved by wildling shamans. The carvings depict animals. The animals depicted have filed complaints.

items.name: Riftfray
items.description: Frayed at both ends the way a Riftling's hide frays at a molt-line, and just as stubbornly still holding its shape. Replacing it feels, somehow, like a betrayal.

items.name: Crab Shell Cuirass
items.description: The armourer took one look at the crab, said 'that's basically a breastplate already,' and charged full price for what was essentially reshaping and a coat of oil.

items.name: Farshot
items.description: Strung for range no sane archer needs at the Scar, where everything worth shooting is already close enough to smell.

items.name: Goblin Knuckle Ring
items.description: Forged from a goblin's favourite knucklebone — its own. The goblin was reportedly philosophical about the loss, right up until it wasn't. Fits perfectly on any finger, because goblins apparently have universally-sized knuckles. Evolution is mysterious.

items.name: Heartweald
items.description: Grown from bark around a heart of packed moss, still faintly warm the way living wood stays warm. The Titan Bear is missing a very similarly shaped chunk of hide.

items.name: Stormplume Helm
items.description: Aerodynamic enough to shave half a second off your retreat time.

items.name: Goblin Toothed Belt
items.description: Every tooth belonged to somebody who personally annoyed a goblin chieftain. The list was long.

items.name: Apexbound Pendant
items.description: Meant to rest against the sternum of whoever holds the highest watch, close enough to the heart to keep count of how fast it's going.

items.name: Slothian's Patience Charm
items.description: The Slothian waited a hundred years for a worthy owner. It is still, technically, waiting.

items.name: Mirrormelt Essence
items.description: Distilled from the one patch of Mirrormere that never fully freezes. It remembers everything that melted into it.

items.name: Key to the Wound
items.description: Fused shut around whatever the Wound Oracle keeps sealed at the center of the Scar. It doesn't turn so much as it's persuaded, and only briefly.

items.name: Riftfangs
items.description: Twin blades ground on opposite walls of the same crack, which is why they never sit quite parallel. The gap does the work you'd rather not admit to.

items.name: Elixir of Vitality
items.description: Standard-issue before a push. Doesn't ask if you're ready.

items.name: Glacial Waistguard
items.description: Packed with ash-cured leather. Holds a line better than it holds a shine.

items.name: Crown of the Void Sovereign
items.description: The void has no sovereign, officially. This crown was a self-appointment nobody present had the density to argue with. Cataloguers list its holder as 'disputed.'

items.name: Raptorskin Treads
items.description: Raptors are nature's way of reminding you that everything in the food chain is someone else's footwear. These ones still twitch when they smell prey.

items.name: Scalehide Crown
items.description: Given to whoever called the final roll. No one answered the last name.

items.name: Bloodgrain
items.description: Grain so deeply infused with hemoglobin that it has developed opinions about blood types. It disapproves of most.

items.name: Siltcore
items.description: A crafting core sheathed in silt that has to be cracked open to use, and re-forms overnight if you leave it too long between jobs.

items.name: Haloforged Brew
items.description: It was brewed to settle an argument, and didn't, so results may vary, considerably.

items.name: Greater Stamina Tonic
items.description: Amber, thick, and floods you with more ambition than your legs are currently prepared to honor.

items.name: Glowbiscuit
items.description: Glows faintly at twilight. Tanners soak leather in it for a finish nobody can quite explain.

items.name: Scrawled Tome
items.description: Found floating in the Flooded Nave, its ink still wet after what the barge-folk swear was a decade underwater. Nobody has translated the last page; the first three discouraged them.

items.name: Longdrop
items.description: Rated for falls the plummet through thin gravity makes almost survivable. Almost.

items.name: Splintbread
items.description: Part bread, part bandage. Alchemists crumble it into healing paste. Tastes like medicine, works like a miracle.

items.name: The Zenith
items.description: Worn by whichever pilgrim makes it furthest up the fractured peak before the climb ends them. It has changed heads more times than the current wearer would like to think about.

items.name: Ashclaw Fang Charm
items.description: The fang still remembers the fire it was pulled from. So, occasionally, does your collarbone.

items.name: Glacial Visor
items.description: Fogs up in warm weather. The last owner solved this by not thinking too hard.

items.name: Roadworn
items.description: Walked the pilgrim road so many times the leather forgot it was ever new. It remembers every mile since.

items.name: Hivewax Girdle
items.description: Moulded in beeswax and alchemical flame, it remembers the shape of whoever wore it last with unsettling precision. Nobody in the village will say where that person went. Several will change the subject very quickly.

items.name: Serrasaur
items.description: Grip enough to hold a struggling meal. Bite enough to end the struggle.

items.name: Godspine Staff
items.description: Its function was settled by a coin flip, a distinction without much of a difference.

items.name: Cursed Gem Powder
items.description: The whispering got worse after grinding. Now it critiques your crafting technique in real time.

items.name: Stamina Tonic
items.description: Mineral-laced stimulant that convinces your legs they aren't tired. Your legs know better, but comply out of chemical fear.

items.name: Yeti Skull Crown
items.description: A hollow yeti skull worn as a crown. The previous owner filed a complaint. In person. Loudly.

items.name: Chantmarked Rod
items.description: The business end dried out years ago. The stick has conducted the choir ever since, badly.

items.name: Crab Pincer Shivs
items.description: Sharpened crab claw joints. They pinch before they cut, which is honestly just rude.

items.name: Glacial Brand
items.description: A longsword quenched in glacial meltwater. The blade frosts over between strikes, which looks dramatic and solves nothing.

items.name: Breachforged Crest
items.description: Nine ridges, one per crack the smelter counted before giving up counting.

items.name: Living Spark Pendant
items.description: A captive spark too stubborn to know it should have died out decades ago.

items.name: Summit Girdle
items.description: Cinched to keep a sentry upright through a watch nobody was expected to survive standing. It kept the last three; it isn't sentimental about it.

items.name: Peasant's popsickle
items.description: The height of agricultural chic, assuming the look one is going for is 'dirt-smeared desperation.'

items.name: Crownrot Ration
items.description: It tastes like a decision made too quickly, so results may vary, considerably.

items.name: Umbral Conductor
items.description: Channels water magic through a core of compressed dread. Very efficient, morally questionable.

items.name: Glasswrought Tassets
items.description: Hemmed high against the wash-water and the rats. Practicality has never looked so grim.

items.name: Rex Tooth Talisman
items.description: Grants courage, allegedly. Mostly grants a permanent crick in the neck.

items.name: Swamp Conduit
items.description: Channels swamp water into something vaguely magical. The smell never washes off.

items.name: Ashwater
items.description: Grey, gritty, and technically drinkable. The ash never settles, which tells you where you are.

items.name: Graverags
items.description: Cut from a robe worn through a hundred burials. The weave still holds grave-dust in it.

items.name: Nerak Marrow
items.description: Blackened marrow drawn from Nerak's own ancient bones, still humming faintly with a life it shouldn't have. Alchemists prize it for the potency. Everyone else avoids it for the whispering, which nobody's ever quite caught the words of.

items.name: Ironset
items.description: Brushed onto metal mid-forge to stop it changing its mind about being a sword.

items.name: Green Shroom powder
items.description: A bag of finely ground spores harvested from verdant forest fungi, their toxic properties concentrated into a single, lethal pinch.

items.name: Embalmed Ancestor
items.description: What's left after the embalming rites. Weighs more than a club this size has any right to.

items.name: Glasswrought Focus
items.description: Phoenix feathers, allegedly. The dust ignites, which is one way to be thorough.

items.name: Warped Staff
items.description: Dried improperly, resulting in a permanent twist. Channels magic in unpredictable spirals. Aim is more of a vibe.

items.name: Quickbite
items.description: Three strikes in the time it takes to notice the first one. The Scar's wildlife has stopped waiting to find out.

items.name: Skyheld Claymore
items.description: It works, but only if you don't ask why, so the matter remains, for now, unresolved.

items.name: Steadfast
items.description: Keeps volatile mixtures from becoming unscheduled explosions. The unsuccessful batches are not discussed.

items.name: Stormfeather Loop
items.description: Plaited from plumes that never stop crackling. A handshake here comes with a small, apologetic shock.

items.name: Kindleplate
items.description: Magmaclaw shell, naturally fireproof. Smells faintly of the argument it lost.

items.name: Finfang
items.description: Small, triangular, and always sold by the couple hundred. One piranha alone is never the problem.

items.name: Seraph Lance
items.description: The maker still isn't sure it was finished correctly, which explains the crossed-out warranty clause.

items.name: Choir Conductor Staff
items.description: Point it and the whole pyre keeps your tempo. Drop it and the fire improvises. Don't drop it.

items.name: Skyheld Stilettos
items.description: The maker still isn't sure it was finished correctly, so it shipped anyway, doubts and all.

items.name: Rivenfall
items.description: The half-molted legs of a Riftling caught mid-collapse, still bent at the angle of the fall that finished it. Wearers report the same knee giving out, on schedule, forever.

items.name: Cinder Heart Amulet
items.description: The piece all the others are still, quietly, trying to get back to.

items.name: Hollow Knuckles
items.description: Padded with silk over old plate. Hits harder than the padding suggests.

items.name: Crescendo
items.description: Grows warmer the longer the fight runs. Long fights end with you glowing and the enemy gone.

items.name: Pyrehymn Draught
items.description: Bottled from the steam off a cooling vent. Tastes of minerals and mild regret. Revives all the same.

items.name: Padded Coif
items.description: Stuffed so thick it muffles blows and thoughts alike. You'll stand forever, wondering why.

items.name: Duke's Last Word
items.description: Once belonged to a goblin duke who had very strong opinions about taxation.

items.name: Ekusoni Mask
items.description: An exorcist mask that hums faintly near the recently deceased. Probably nothing.

items.name: Cursed Loaf
items.description: Whispers recipes to anyone holding it. The bread has opinions about your crafting technique, and they are not kind.

items.name: Shadowsteel Buckle
items.description: Keeps your trousers from becoming a problem, and allegedly your mortal dread too. Only one of those claims is verified.

items.name: Hollowcrown Draught
items.description: The label lists an ingredient nobody can identify, which the label discloses in very small print.

items.name: Fengland Torc
items.description: Hums a low note when someone nearby is dying. Very popular at parties.

items.name: Bearclaw Hoop
items.description: Tightens slightly when you're angry. Loosens when you calm down. Mostly stays tight.

items.name: Sash of the Void Emperor
items.description: The largest Voidmoth on record wore this into its final molt and never came back out. Whatever replaced it in that shell hasn't been catalogued yet, and the catalogers are in no hurry.

items.name: Marshrot
items.description: Bottled from the deepest bog-rot. The cork rarely lasts the trip back to the quartermaster.

items.name: Scorch Grimoire
items.description: The cover is singed. The contents are worse. Anyone who reads chapter three out loud is asked to leave.

items.name: Heartsap
items.description: Sticky, sweet, and mildly sentient. The kweebec didn't appreciate the extraction. This is basically tree blood.

items.name: Yeti Jawbreaker
items.description: Named for the jaws it breaks, made from the jaw it once was.

items.name: Bag of Ivory Shrooms
items.description: Fifty luminescent mushrooms packed with such reckless density that the bag emits a steady phosphorescent glow visible from an embarrassing distance, functioning as a portable nightlight that no one requested and everyone within a thirty-meter radius is forced to acknowledge. Merchants have attempted to market this as a feature rather than a liability, with predictable results.

items.name: Fen Moss Mallet
items.description: A mallet covered in living fen moss that regenerates overnight. Hit something hard enough and the moss sighs.

items.name: Polar Reaver's Greataxe
items.description: The captain's weapon of choice. Nobody stays neutral once it swings.

items.name: Fenrot Girdle
items.description: Rotted supple enough to cinch one-handed in the dark, a small mercy the fen grants and immediately makes you pay for.

items.name: Crownrot Cuirass Crown
items.description: How reliable it is remains hotly debated, and the maker moved on before finishing the thought.

items.name: Scarscript
items.description: The main text is unremarkable. Everything worth knowing was scrawled in the margins by someone who clearly disagreed with it.

items.name: Frostshamble Helm
items.description: Whispers all night. Mostly reviews. None of them positive.

items.name: Basalt Crest Choir
items.description: Heavy enough that you nod along to the dirge whether you meant to or not.

items.name: Hardset
items.description: A purified alchemical medium that refuses to oxidize out of sheer stubbornness. Mid-tier crafters live and die by this stuff.

items.name: Bag of Barley
items.description: A sack of barley that rattles with the unmistakable sound of grain harvested under protest from its guardian.

items.name: Plagueborn Mace
items.description: Carries a faint green glow and an unfaint green smell. The business end is coated in something that healers refuse to identify.

items.name: Venomweave Sash
items.description: Three failed antidotes and one very patient priest went into stabilizing this belt's lining.

items.name: Amulet of the Shore
items.description: Carved from the shell of a crab that pinched the wrong fisherman. The sand trapped inside rattles when danger approaches, or when you walk. It can't tell the difference.

items.name: Slothfur Girdle
items.description: Made from the fur of a creature so lazy it evolved armor instead of moving away from danger.

items.name: Basalt Maul
items.description: Rated for rugs, tapestries and anything else that holds a grudge along with its dust.

items.name: Koa Slime Brigandine
items.description: Leather plates lacquered with Koa mucus, which hardens into a surprisingly resilient coating. The Koa produced this mucus as a stress response, which means this armour is literally made of anxiety. It still glistens when it rains, giving you the appearance of a very well-moisturised warrior.

items.name: Muleteer's March
items.description: Logged more miles behind the supply column than any soldier alive. Never once lost a wagon.

items.name: Warlord's Roving Eye
items.description: A bloodshot eye ripped from the Goblin Warlord. It still darts around nervously, as if searching for the next thing to eat.

items.name: Crabclaw Claws
items.description: Fingers stained by water that never sees daylight. The stain doesn't wash out.

items.name: Solomonk Cowl
items.description: The cowl of a monk who traded three vows of silence for one very loud hat.

items.name: Brinebow
items.description: Strung with sinew that swelled in the salt and never shrank back, so it draws heavier than it looks and rewards the arms that expected it.

items.name: Dented Mace
items.description: More dents than a parking lot bumper. Each one represents a lesson in 'aim lower than the kneecap'.

items.name: Worldsplitter
items.description: Legend says the first test swing created a canyon. Legend exaggerates, but only slightly.

items.name: Tidebound Grips Matron
items.description: Scavenged from the drowned court and never desalted, so they leave a faint white print on everything the wearer touches for long.

items.name: The Saurian Ripper
items.description: Carved from bone still warm enough to make the smiths nervous.

items.name: Kraken Tide Boots
items.description: Grips any surface, wet or dry. The kraken-derived soles read the tide before you do.

items.name: Ashgrain
items.description: A handful of grain blackened by fire, its golden promise reduced to charcoal and bitter memory.

items.name: Palefoot
items.description: Plated in Moonclaw shell that stays cold underfoot, which is the closest thing to moonlight the wearer will feel this far down.

items.name: Koa Eye Ring
items.description: Set with a polished Koa eye that appears, unsettlingly, to still be looking for something.

items.name: Wraith Lantern Staff
items.description: Topped with a lantern the Nave-Stone Wraiths use to lure barge-folk off the safe paths. It still burns cold, and it still works.

items.name: Sapling Bark
items.description: Peeled from a kweebec sapling. It reformed into armor-grade panels on its own. Even dead, this wood has ambition.

items.name: Claw-Hinge Cartilage
items.description: The hinge mechanism of a massive claw. Engineers study these. The engineering is better than anything we've built.

items.name: Choirmaster Locket
items.description: Every key in the cathedral on one iron loop. Whoever wears it answers for every locked door and every noise behind them.

items.name: Weftgrip
items.description: Woven from mire-silk the Sporebacks spin between root systems, sticky enough to improve a grip and unpleasant enough that nobody asks how it's harvested.

items.name: Glubkey
items.description: Salvaged from the wreck the Hull Warden still patrols. It hums faintly whenever the tide turns, as if counting down to something.

items.name: Wraith-Crowned Helm
items.description: The crown still hums with its last owner's final thoughts, and most of them turn out to be regrets. A few, oddly specific, concern a shopping list he never got to finish.

items.name: Canticle Cuisses
items.description: The ridges whistle a fifth of a tone when you walk. The choir has learned to transpose around you.

items.name: Thickskull
items.description: The compliment was meant literally. It has saved more lives than the enchantment stitched into the lining.

items.name: Stormtide Coif
items.description: Can't decide if it's for water mages or earth knights. Serves both grudgingly.

items.name: Cindermetal
items.description: Beaten together on heat drawn straight off the Scar, which the smiths ration carefully — the Scar does not reheat on request.

items.name: Curvefang
items.description: Longer than a dagger. Sharper than most comebacks. The cat did not need it anymore.

items.name: Sentinel tooth
items.description: One wonders what manner of fool gets close enough to wrestle a crocodile for its teeth, yet here we are.

items.name: Crownless Signet
items.description: It does what it's told, eventually, a compromise reached after everyone gave up arguing.

items.name: Kweebec Band
items.description: Warm from the forge long after it left it. Never fully cools, like everything else here.

items.name: Gilded Chopper
items.description: It does its job, then apologizes for doing it, so the manual was left deliberately vague.

items.name: Latticebone
items.description: A crystalline frame that only sets under the pressure found at the peak, which makes it exactly as hard to obtain as it sounds.

items.name: Shadowsteel Halberd
items.description: Forged from shadow knight shards. The darkness is load-bearing. The weight is character-building.

items.name: Frostwolf Paws
items.description: Grips ice like it insulted your family personally. It's complicated.

items.name: Totembound Spirit Club
items.description: A gravewisp nests in the head. It only glows when something is dying nearby.

items.name: Snuffer
items.description: Extinguishes candles, lanterns and enthusiasm at range. The long handle is for the chandeliers.

items.name: Enka Muru Cloak
items.description: A traveller’s cloak stitched for long roads and short conversations.

items.name: Ectoplasm Locket
items.description: Opens to a portrait nobody living has ever recognized. Several dead have, but they aren't talking.

items.name: Walker's Helm
items.description: The previous wearer's head is still inside, though in considerably worse condition than the helmet itself.

items.name: Frostshell Trident
items.description: Three prongs of frozen crab-shell that never thaw. Effective against fish, fish-adjacent enemies, and common sense.

items.name: Skyheld Crest Crown
items.description: Its effectiveness has never been independently verified, which nobody can confirm without starting the argument over.

items.name: Iridoscale
items.description: Rainbow-sheen scale from a pike. Jewelers polish them into cheap pendants. The fish had no say in the matter.

items.name: Jade Hoe
items.description: A farming tool so beautiful that farmers hesitate to use it. Then hunger wins, as it always does.

items.name: Shadowsteel Gripcuffs
items.description: Fingers articulate perfectly in darkness and stiffen the instant sunlight touches them.

items.name: Razord Fangblade
items.description: Forged around a fang that refused every attempt to melt it down. The smiths built around it instead.

items.name: Alpha Fang Circlet
items.description: Wolves mourn their dead in howls that carry across the whole archipelago. This circlet remembers every one.

items.name: Bulwark of the Risen
items.description: Recovered from a barrow that reopened at dusk. The dead had no more use for it.

items.name: Pepe Hat
items.description: A humble green cap. The starter flex. Every royal was once just a pepe in a hat.

items.name: Skybalm
items.description: Cool where it touches, like the far side of the seam. Do not ask how they know.

items.name: Pebble Pendant
items.description: A smooth river pebble on a string. The jeweler called it 'minimalist design'. Everyone else called it a rock.

items.name: Vitrified Chausses
items.description: Cut so narrow the tailor had to be talked down twice. Kneeling is a memory.

items.name: Slumbercase
items.description: Half-formed and sticky. What's inside is either a larva or, worryingly, your lunch.

items.name: Lastbreath
items.description: Sized for whoever wears it last. The armorer never explains what that means, and nobody's asked twice.

items.name: Frost Titan's Cudgel
items.description: What a frost titan flosses with. What flattens you in one swing.

items.name: Bone Flail
items.description: Assembled from whatever the bonelet left behind. Rattles with every swing.

items.name: Cinderchant Robe
items.description: Quilted, floor-length, faintly singed. Dying in it is acceptable; answering the door in it is not.

items.name: Frostshell Signet
items.description: Made from a frostclaw's shell fragment. The crab never signed the donation form.

items.name: Crystal Tide Staff
items.description: A staff topped with a red crystal that pulses with tidal energy. It occasionally drips, which ruins the dramatic effect.

items.name: Scarforged Legguards
items.description: Beaten flat on the Scar's own anvil-stone, which leaves a faint ripple in the plate that no amount of polishing takes out. Nobody tries anymore.

items.name: Stormfeather
items.description: A feather that sparks when shaken. Storm mages weave these into wands. Postal workers refuse to deliver them.

items.name: Tribal Plate
items.description: Assembled from tribal relics by someone who valued survival over subtlety. It shows.

items.name: Shadowsteel Stilettos
items.description: Forged from light-absorbing shards. Your enemies won't see the miss coming either.

items.name: Coronet Torc
items.description: It works exactly as described, allegedly, and somehow that's still considered a success.

items.name: Wolf Pelt
items.description: Thick forest wolf hide. Warm, durable, and carries a faint musk that makes horses deeply uncomfortable.

items.name: Pyrehymn Greaves Pyre
items.description: Slotted to vent the heat downward, so your boots take the brunt and say nothing.

items.name: Bara Hood (Wisdom)
items.description: A plain hooded cowl offered in a spread of gemstone linings. Cheap, honest, everywhere.

items.name: Timberfall
items.description: Rated to fell the petrified trees the wound left standing. Works just as well on anything that once was a person.

items.name: Barbfin
items.description: Fin-barbed like something dragged up from deeper water than the weald technically has. Nobody's asked where the fins actually came from.

items.name: Mire Waders
items.description: Standard footing for anyone posted past the reed line. Dry feet are not part of the contract.

items.name: Plague Razmo Fang Blades
items.description: Standard vermin-work blades. The barrow rats bite back; these bite first.

items.name: Chantmarked Visor
items.description: The knob on top is a design flaw and a carrying convenience in one.

items.name: Groundswing
items.description: Follows through into the dirt on a miss, which happens often enough that the wall's masons keep a running tally.

items.name: Lorito Cloak (Aquamarine)
items.description: A parrot-feather cloak dyed to a gemstone hue. Loud, cheerful, and entirely cosmetic.

items.name: Hymnbound Ingot
items.description: Solid iron, heated on the stove, guided by grievance. Creases and dissent surrender alike.

items.name: Rex Bone Cuisses
items.description: Thigh guards reinforced with rex bone plating. Walking is a workout. Running is aspirational.

items.name: Suizeroot
items.description: The original strain of suize, predating cultivation itself. It will likely outlast those who try to farm it.

items.name: Hymnbound Gauntlets
items.description: For the beds of fire-lilies behind the apse. The thorns burn; the gloves disagree.

items.name: Chantmarked Warbelt Pyre
items.description: Loops for the hammer, the snips, the wax, the holy water. An empty loop means trouble found you first.

items.name: Plaguemo Trekkies
items.description: The tanner who cured these hides survived three separate plagues and one deeply awkward rash.

items.name: Choir Obsidian
items.description: Polished volcanic slab. Cool to the touch, immune to knife scars and hot pans alike.

items.name: Judgeye
items.description: Bulging, unblinking, and somehow still judging you. Reagent for vision potions. Side effects may include paranoia.

items.name: Tanjirize Bricheton
items.description: A copper-furred pack beast that attracts spice merchants and repels personal space at approximately equal rates.

items.name: Cinder Crown
items.description: The glow makes you look important. The set, once complete, makes you look inevitable.

items.name: Talokan Sting
items.description: Coral-edged and salt-crusted. They smell like low tide and regret.

items.name: Yetifur
items.description: White as fresh snow, warm as guilt. The yeti didn't need it anymore. It insists.

items.name: Skymote
items.description: A single grain of floating pollen that never quite agrees to land.

items.name: Piranha Fang Necklace
items.description: Teeth from a fish that eats everything, including its own school's feelings.

items.name: Empyrean Charm
items.description: It performs its stated function with visible reluctance, and the difference stopped mattering somewhere along the way.

items.name: Bag of Tanjirize
items.description: A warm pouch that radiates faint heat, as though the tanjirize inside is still convinced it belongs in the sun.

items.name: Duskwalk
items.description: Soled to grip the slick edge of the Wound, where one wrong step is also, conveniently, the last one you'll ever have to worry about.

items.name: Tidegrasp
items.description: Timed to the tide the weald pretends it lacks, hardened at high water when the metal, briefly, agrees to cooperate.

items.name: Archaeo Plume Belt
items.description: Feathered, fossilized, and still trying to convince everyone it could fly.

items.name: Cinder Greaves
items.description: Every seat you sit in remembers you were here. So does the ember.

items.name: Breachforged Claymore
items.description: Swung by the Gate Watcher who quit counting faults and took to closing them personally. Too heavy for precise aim. Precision was never the plan.

items.name: Bristleback Bow
items.description: Strung with bisonbrute sinew. Every arrow carries the emotional weight of a stampede.

items.name: Molten Verse Sash
items.description: Threaded with a ribbon of coloured glass. Pretty, until it catches the light and blinds your own eyes.

items.name: Volatile Extract
items.description: An unstable reagent that vibrates audibly. Handle with care or don't handle at all. Weapon smiths can't get enough of it.

items.name: Vesper
items.description: Rings faintly at dusk with no bell attached. The smith stopped taking questions about it.

items.name: Breachrunners
items.description: For crossing a widening gap at speed. The theory is sound. The gap disagrees.

items.name: Shardtruth
items.description: Permanently frozen crystal that drains warmth from anything nearby. Stays cold so you don't have to.

items.name: Scar Suture Daggers
items.description: Modeled after the Suture Priests' own ritual blades, thin enough to close a wound or open one depending on the angle. The Priests insist it's always the former.

items.name: Moonclad Tonic Mire
items.description: The mire-water base settles into layers if left to stand, which the brewer says to shake and never says what the bottom layer is.

items.name: Crude Hatchet
items.description: More of a sharpened rock on a stick. The caveman aesthetic is free of charge.

items.name: Rex Bone Signet
items.description: Carved from rex bone with a fang inset. Pressing it into wax leaves a mark. Pressing it into enemies leaves more.

items.name: Wildling Shortbow
items.description: Stolen from a wildling camp. They were not consulted about the transaction.

items.name: Showfleece
items.description: Shimmers like actual gold. Every judge has, at some point, tried to bite it to check.

items.name: Rawhide Belt
items.description: Untanned leather that smells faintly of existential dread and damp animal. A tanner's first real project.

items.name: Fungal Flatbread
items.description: A thin bread infused with ivory orchid paste. Tailors soak it in dye and use the residue to waterproof fabrics.

items.name: Blue Antenna
items.description: Still pulses with the insect's last thought: 'Why did the giant squash my mate?'

items.name: Windfire Cuirass
items.description: Can't decide between fire and air affinity. Burns your back, chills your front, and the constant flinching wears down everything except your will to keep standing.

items.name: Preserving Oil
items.description: Prevents organic materials from decomposing. Bakers use it to keep bread fresh. Necromancers use it for other things.

items.name: Wildlord War Girdle
items.description: Buckled on before every roll call. Never once buckled on for a good reason.

items.name: Vitrified Crown
items.description: Fused in one lightning strike. Wearing it, you feel briefly chosen. The feeling is a lie.

items.name: Incandescent Lance
items.description: Glows with heat that never dims and a grip that clearly wasn't built to match.

items.name: Silk
items.description: Filaments of impeccable quality, smooth as water and stronger than chains. A pity about the knots — they hold fast, but familial bonds were never meant to be tested this way.

items.name: Walkature
items.description: Fashionable enough, assuming one's style icon is a shambling corpse.

items.name: Reforged Ember
items.description: Scraped sulphur, candy-red and eager. One strike, no refunds.

items.name: Primal Catalyst
items.description: Endgame universal reagent that combines all four elemental essences. Required for legendary-tier equipment across every craft job.

items.name: Deep Scale
items.description: Black as the abyss it came from. The leviathan wore thousands. You have one. Be humble about it.

items.name: Wolfpaw Treads
items.description: Once belonged to a wolf who outwalked every hunter Pandora Reach ever sent after him.

items.name: Bogscale Cord
items.description: Marked with tally-scratches for every crate signed over. Nobody has recounted since.

items.name: God's Maw Key
items.description: Cast from something that used to be part of the god, back when the god was still using it. The Maw doesn't ask for it back so much as expect it.

items.name: Mossgreave
items.description: Padded with moss that stays faintly damp no matter how long you wear it, drawn from wherever the Moss Bears den. It resents staying dry, and that resentment loses.

items.name: Abyssal Edge
items.description: A sword that seems to absorb light around its blade. The darkness is cosmetic. The damage is not.

items.name: Gilded Extract
items.description: It was declared authentic by a narrow margin, and the second explanation was never fully ruled out.

items.name: Clavis de Fulgure
items.description: Forged in voltglass, permanently live with static charge from the plateau's storm cells. The Storm Warden's vault has been struck by lightning more times than anyone's counted, and this key is why it still opens.

items.name: Hymn Ember
items.description: The heat a stone keeps after the fire moves on. Bottled while the bottling was good.

items.name: Ocean Sigil Legguards
items.description: Shimmer like the ocean at sunset. Smell like the ocean at low tide.

items.name: Executioner's Verdict
items.description: Rings like a court-martial gavel on the downswing, delivered by whichever Sundered Soldier drew the short straw that century. The sentence is always the same. The paperwork is not required.

items.name: Vine-Woven Sash
items.description: Bound during a three-day Kweebec chant that not even the Kweebec fully remember the words to.

items.name: Cinder Widow Chitin
items.description: Shed from the Cinder Widow's oldest molt. The edges hold a trace of warmth still.

items.name: Embercore Saber
items.description: An ember core beats in the pommel, pulled off a Cinder Shade still warm when the smith reached it. The blade recolors itself to the wielder's mood, consent not required.

items.name: Diamond powder
items.description: Proof that the only thing unbreakable in this world is the price tag attached to it.

items.name: Saurian Twist
items.description: Bound to two elements that agreed to share custody and nothing else.

items.name: Rex Fang Claymore
items.description: A rex alpha donated its largest fang. Involuntarily.

items.name: Relic of the Past
items.description: An echo from a forgotten age. This artifact was once forged in the crucible of creation, but its maker has since vanished from all known realms. Only a faint hum of ancient power remains — a whisper of what once was.

items.name: Crabsnap Cinch
items.description: Tanned feran leather, supple and dark as a moonless coast. The feran was a solitary predator of the tidal flats, and the belt carries its temperament — it creaks irritably when wet and absolutely refuses to pair with anything fashionable.

items.name: Haloforged Philter
items.description: Whoever bottled it never settled on a final version, and the brewer still refuses to pick a side.

items.name: Moonlit Choker
items.description: Clasped tight before the graves open at dusk. Loosened only after the watch ends.

items.name: Fuwa Cloak (White)
items.description: A soft, absurdly fluffy cloak. Zero armor value, infinite nap value.

items.name: Duneshade
items.description: Cut from glass fused by two suns that have never once agreed on anything else.

items.name: Amber Cactee
items.description: Smells like ancient pine forests and poor life decisions. Occasionally traps flies in its resin.

items.name: Lorito Cloak (Ruby)
items.description: A parrot-feather cloak dyed to a gemstone hue. Loud, cheerful, and entirely cosmetic.

items.name: Summit Draught
items.description: Brewed for the dizziness that takes climbers near the top, where the air thins and the mind starts negotiating with the drop. Drink before the negotiations begin.

items.name: Drakar Helm
items.description: Draconic plate that runs warm to the touch. Small dragons find it flattering; large ones find it rude.

items.name: Ursine Legguards
items.description: Your legs become a fortress. Your mobility becomes a memory.

items.name: Bearclaw
items.description: Fitted with claws pried from a Moss Bear that didn't need them anymore. The grip strength transfers; the temper does too, apparently.

items.name: Duskgait
items.description: Soled black enough to vanish in the weald's dark. The wearer stops seeing what they're walking into around the third day. By the fourth, it stops mattering.

items.name: Magmaclaw Hewer
items.description: Bear claws for the grip, magmaclaw chitin for the edge. Splits logs, skulls, and philosophical arguments with volcanic enthusiasm.

items.name: Koa Eye Signet
items.description: Koas have roughly the same expression whether they're happy, angry, or being turned into jewellery. The eye in this ring still blinks occasionally, though nobody's sure if it's on purpose.

items.name: Voidrender
items.description: Arrows loosed from this bow strike the target before the string has fully released. Out here, causality is less a law than a polite suggestion.

items.name: Alpha's Cleave
items.description: Taken from the alpha of the pack. He did not give it willingly, and frankly neither did the pack.

items.name: Cantor Basalt
items.description: Kitchen floor stock, worn smooth by four centuries of pacing cooks.

items.name: Glasswrought Stilettos
items.description: Two paring knives, thin as excuses. Peel an apple in one strip or a lock in one sitting.

items.name: Ducal Seal
items.description: A seal shaped like a stick figure giving a thumbs up. He commissioned it himself.

items.name: Ashskin Cutlass
items.description: Sheathed in ashskin lizard hide. Warm in the grip and giving absolutely nothing away.

items.name: Crab shell
items.description: A sturdy husk harvested from a crustacean that clearly lost an argument with someone very hungry.

items.name: Faultline Quartz
items.description: Grew along a fracture, so it's flawless everywhere except the one line that matters.

items.name: Gildcap
items.description: The poor man's gold—equally useless, far harder to find, and impossible to spend at the tavern.

items.name: Bogforged Vambraces
items.description: Quenched in bog-water so foul the metal came out harder and the smith came out coughing for a week.

items.name: Goblin Stompers
items.description: Stitched together by goblin cobblers who clearly had strong opinions about foot comfort but no formal training. The left boot is slightly larger than the right. Whether this was intentional remains a matter of furious academic debate.

items.name: Glowfang
items.description: Its blade is threaded with ghost-cap spores that glow along each cut, so the wound lights up before the pain does.

items.name: Tome of Oblivion
items.description: The last chapter writes itself as you read, in whatever dust a Voidmoth leaves behind when it stops existing mid-sentence. Reviewers agree the ending is honest, if nothing else.

items.name: Chantmarked Tonic
items.description: For when the fight was over and then, rudely, wasn't. Buys you one more chorus.

items.name: Glacial Grasp
items.description: Everything you touch freezes slightly. Including your weapon. Including your friendships.

items.name: Sunwarmed Band
items.description: Still holds the warmth of a lizard that, respectfully, is no longer using it.

items.name: Bag of Draconize
items.description: The scales on the outside may be natural, or may mean the grain inside is unionizing.

items.name: Living Spark Greataxe
items.description: The head still crackles with whatever it last cut down, and nobody's entirely sure what that was. The reports are filed and sealed. What's known for certain: the axe picks its targets. The one holding the handle is mostly along for the ride.

items.name: Tanned Girdle
items.description: Stiff and uncomfortable, like a first date. Softens with use. The belt, not the date — that gets worse.

items.name: Choir Procession Boots
items.description: Built for a slow dignified walk to the altar. Break into a run and the dignity leaves first.

items.name: Moonstone Hoe
items.description: Tills soil with lunar resonance. The wheat grows 12% faster. The farmer ages 12% faster.

items.name: Cinderheart Cleaver
items.description: A longsword powered by a still-molten cinder heart. Heavy enough to split the earth. Or at least whatever is standing on it.

items.name: Arcanite Powder
items.description: Spontaneously rearranges itself into arcane symbols when left unattended. Very distracting.

items.name: Tidebound Band
items.description: Tarnishes and brightens on a cycle that has nothing to do with wear, which the wearer eventually stops timing against the tide they're told isn't there.

items.name: Throneless Extract
items.description: Nobody can say for certain where this came from, so both entries remain on the record, unreconciled.

items.name: Arcanite Hoe
items.description: Imbued with enough arcane energy to make dead soil sprout. Also makes dead farmers sprout, but we don't talk about that.

items.name: Wolf Fang Blade
items.description: A blade with wolf fangs embedded in the edge. The wolf did not volunteer them.

items.name: Sunscale Chopper
items.description: Edged with scales that drank enough sunlight to glow for a whole generation of geckos.

items.name: Basalt Locket
items.description: Holds a single low tone, sealed in stone. Crack it in a crisis; regret it in the quiet after.

items.name: Piranha Cleaver
items.description: Serrated with true piranha teeth, still apparently under the impression that everything in front of it is a meal. In fairness, so far, it hasn't been wrong often.

items.name: Lorito Helmet
items.description: A full parrot pulled over the ears. The sprout on top is load-bearing, emotionally.

items.name: Toll of the Mender
items.description: Distilled by the Suture Priests from the runoff of their own work, which they insist is safe and drink themselves to prove it. They are still here, so far.

items.name: Faultline Treads
items.description: Soled with a Riftling's shed foot-plates, which grip fractured ground the same instinctive way the living limb once did. One sole always finds purchase. The other is still arguing about it.

items.name: Kweebec Choker
items.description: Worn beneath the armor, close enough to feel the pyre through the plate.

items.name: Warbelt of the Dawn
items.description: Weighted to anchor a body against the updraft that hauls at anything near the peak. It anchors well. What it anchors you to is your business.

items.name: Frondcrest
items.description: Camouflaged for the layer where the canopy blots out what little light gets this deep, which is to say for hiding, which the weald rewards.

items.name: Obsidian Arc Bow
items.description: Strung with waxed apron cord. The drapes fell years ago; the rod moved on to a second career.

items.name: Feran-Stalker Vest
items.description: The feran who wore this pelt was, by all accounts, the laziest of an extremely lazy species.

items.name: The Lastscar
items.description: Bears a nick the Wound put there before the smith ever touched it. The smith worked around the nick, on the sound theory that it was there for a reason.

items.name: Gobeline Blade
items.description: The green tint comes from copper content, goblin blood, or both—philosophers suggest not asking.

items.name: Feathergilt Waraxe
items.description: Its maker refused to elaborate further, and the wearer has learned to live with the ambiguity.

items.name: Deepwoven Cincture
items.description: A woven belt that cinches tighter by itself in cold water, a helpful reflex until you remember it doesn't ask first.

items.name: Shore Mace
items.description: Encrusted with barnacles that add texture and tetanus risk.

items.name: Stumpwork
items.description: Built for the trees that survived the wound only halfway. Finishing the job turned out to be steady, reliable work.

items.name: Runic Warden Blade
items.description: Kweebec runes glow faintest at dawn, exactly when the ceremonial spear this was forged from once did too.

items.name: Matron's Grasp
items.description: Plated with shell off the Cinder Widow. Still faintly warm from the burrow.

items.name: Soulglass
items.description: A crystallized fragment pulled from a revenant mid-rite. Still hums with something unfinished.

items.name: Ursine Wraps
items.description: Lined with crab chitin thick enough to blunt strikes and fine motor control alike. Your fingers are safe, your dexterity is not, and whatever's left underneath is nearly impossible to kill.

items.name: Sunscale
items.description: A broad plate scale from an ashskin lizard, still warm long after the lizard has left the conversation.

items.name: Hidecut
items.description: Dark green and perpetually slimy. The crocodile grew a spare. Leatherworkers accept it with visible reluctance.

items.name: Cinder Striders
items.description: The upgraded pair. Somehow warmer, somehow louder, somehow still watching.

items.name: Chantmarked Grips
items.description: Calibrated on a pickle jar sealed before the founding of the choir. It opened. Eventually.

items.name: Momaku Mask
items.description: A spirit-mask worn to frighten debtors and impress no one who is already dead.

items.name: Stormplume Coil
items.description: Spins freely on your finger like it's trying to escape. The enchantment is working as intended.

items.name: Rock Koa
items.description: Rock Koa: a koa that took "grow thicker skin" as a literal engineering brief — weighs a scandalous amount, sinks like a verdict, wins every staring contest by geology.

items.name: Duskite Cactee
items.description: Old story: a candle went out in the deep gallery and never came back on — this is what grew where it stood. Perfect for vanishing mid-argument. It has never once helped anyone win one.

items.name: Chitin Longsword
items.description: This blade was carved from the carapace of some nameless deep-dwelling beast, its edge jagged yet unnervingly sharp.

items.name: Cinderchoir Brew
items.description: Brewed near the vents, so it never quite cools. Mostly it warms you. Occasionally it warns you.

items.name: Sandwraith Reaper
items.description: Dug up half-buried in the dunes. Its former owner was recovered considerably more buried.

items.name: Aberrant Treads
items.description: Soles cast from a shape that was never quite a foot. Leaves the wrong prints.

items.name: Cracked Mace
items.description: The head rattles ominously with each swing. Structural integrity is a suggestion, not a guarantee.

items.name: Stormfeather Blades
items.description: Stormhawk feathers folded into steel until the metal forgot it was ever anything else. Every strike lands with a rumble of thunder from a storm that's long since moved on without it.

items.name: Sunscale Battlecleaver
items.description: Two-handed, double-edged, still warm from the ashskin lizard. Terrible for opening letters, excellent for opening enemies.

items.name: Bindsap
items.description: Sets faster than you can pull free. Ask any apprentice by their nickname.

items.name: Genesis Blade
items.description: Forged, according to the pilgrims who still make the climb, from whatever the world looked like before it fractured. Nobody's in a position to confirm that.

items.name: Obsidianite
items.description: Volcanic glass that shatters into edges sharp enough to cut through both stone and career ambitions.

items.name: Rex Ribcage Plate
items.description: Fashioned from the ribcage of a rex alpha. The crafters insist it was already dead when they found it.

items.name: Quartz Powder
items.description: Ground quartz mixed with diamond dust. Sneezing near it is strongly discouraged.

items.name: Slothfur Grips
items.description: The last heat of one Cinder Shade, folded into leather before it could finish cooling. Palms stay warm through any winter. Handshakes get awkward.

items.name: Bogscale Choker
items.description: Found coiled at the neck-ridge of a Cinder Shade, warm centuries on. It keeps its wisdom close to its chest — yours too, while it's at it — and pays the whole debt back in raw endurance.

items.name: Glasschant Daggers
items.description: The good scissors. You were told never to use them. You are using them.

items.name: Kweebec Basher
items.description: Kweebec wood so dense it forgot it used to photosynthesize for a living.

items.name: Totem Club
items.description: Carved with symbols nobody living can translate. Hit something hard enough and it seems to translate itself.

items.name: Spider Leg
items.description: Handle with care, unless you enjoy the sensation of invisible spiders crawling beneath your skin for weeks.

items.name: Bloodstone
items.description: Dark red mineral that definitely got its color from iron oxide and not ancient curses, probably.

items.name: Hollow Legguards
items.description: Taken from a barrow that had already been picked clean once. Nothing left the second time either.

items.name: Sparkweave Vestments
items.description: Monks wove this under a vow of second-degree burns. Most kept the vow. Fewer kept eyebrows.

items.name: Goblin Trinket Chain
items.description: A chain of stolen baubles, pilfered coins, and at least one tooth that doesn't belong to the goblin. Goblins call this 'haute couture.' Everyone else calls it evidence.

items.name: Clearsight
items.description: Improves visibility at the Scar, which is less a mercy than it sounds. Some things are better half-seen.

items.name: Moonstone Sickle
items.description: Glows faintly under starlight. Herbalists claim it improves yield. Alchemists claim that's placebo.

items.name: Onestep
items.description: The tread that only matters once, on the final step, which is exactly the moment most wearers stop having feet to appreciate it with.

items.name: Fenrot Ration
items.description: Field medicine wrapped in fen-leaf that keeps it fresh and lends it a taste no one has ever called good, only effective.

items.name: Kraken's Abyssal Eye
items.description: Plucked from a leviathan so ancient it remembers when the sea had a different color.

items.name: Seepbleed
items.description: Weeps from the torn ground in slow beads. Collect it patiently or not at all.

items.name: Celestial Wafer
items.description: It was catalogued twice, under two different theories, a discrepancy nobody has been assigned to resolve.

items.name: Glassleaf
items.description: Crystallized aloe gel layered with herbal residue. Healers swear by it, patients swear at it.

items.name: Diamond
items.description: A shard of compressed carbon that forgot to finish becoming magnificent, dug from the earth's miserly grip.

items.name: Water
items.description: Pure, refreshing water that quenches thirst and cleanses the body of impurities. A rare substance in a world where most liquids want to kill you.

items.name: Barley Flour
