items.description: A coarse flour that brewers covet and bakers tolerate, ground from barley with just enough wheat for plausible deniability.

items.name: Ursine Signet
items.description: Pressed into wax on requisition forms. The wax never quite sets right.

items.name: Woolice Fleece Helm
items.description: Woven so tight it stops arrows and any chance of being taken seriously.

items.name: Pyrehymn Girdle
items.description: A band of scorched leather that stops a blaze at the waist. It has stopped several. It shows.

items.name: Frostbound Grimoire
items.description: Its pages stay damp no matter how many fires you set beside it. Reading it feels like drowning in knowledge — a sensation the author, whoever they were, apparently found instructive.

items.name: Millstone
items.description: Village millstones ground wheat for six generations before someone thought to swing one. It works. Nobody asked the miller.

items.name: Dawntread
items.description: Cobbled from leather older than the trade of cobbling. It creaks a language, and the cobblers who'd translate it are all long gone.

items.name: Wooly Moonwalkers
items.description: Felted from wool that still remembers being alive, and occasionally still tries to graze.

items.name: Wispash
items.description: Scraped off a gravewisp after it burned out. Bowyers work it into bowstring resin.

items.name: Inferno Clutch
items.description: The leather never fully cools, not since the pyre pits. Grip tightens on its own near heat.

items.name: Seraphbound Vambraces
items.description: Its function was settled by a coin flip, and the argument outlived everyone who started it.

items.name: Drownmarked Cordial
items.description: Mixed at the turn of the tide the weald says it doesn't have, which the brewer times by feel and refuses to explain.

items.name: Coronet Warblade
items.description: It was approved on a split decision, and the argument outlived everyone who started it.

items.name: Razmo Pelt
items.description: A scraggly rat hide. Leather workers accept these but they will absolutely judge you for it.

items.name: Tectonic Severance
items.description: Legends say the blacksmith who forged this split a mountain in the test swing. The mountain sued.

items.name: Venomscale Locket
items.description: Set with a lens ground for watching the tomb line after dark.

items.name: Soulbinder Scepter
items.description: Carries a fraction of whatever the Soul Auditors bind at the gate below, humming with borrowed permanence. An Ash Prophet used it to ask questions the dead rarely agree to answer twice.

items.name: Moonfang Precision Band
items.description: A ring carved from a moonfang alpha claw. It guides your strikes to vital points. The moonfang taught by example.

items.name: Deepglint
items.description: Belongs in a display case, according to every museum that has ever refused to pay for it.

items.name: Lorito Cloak (Sapphire)
items.description: A parrot-feather cloak dyed to a gemstone hue. Loud, cheerful, and entirely cosmetic.

items.name: Deathless Blade
items.description: Drawn from the barrows. Sharpened against the veil between dead and living. A tool that remembers its work.

items.name: Scarak Cleaver
items.description: The scarak hive has convened three separate councils about getting this back. All three failed.

items.name: Praetorian Oath
items.description: Sworn before the standard fell. Nobody released it from service.

items.name: Halfhead
items.description: Sold at a discount on account of the missing left third. Aim your enemies accordingly.

items.name: Threshknuckle
items.description: Cast from the knuckles of a Gate Watcher who punched first and checked credentials later. Every impact leaves a faint arch-shaped bruise, like a tiny doorway.

items.name: Regent Ore
items.description: Two separate reports describe it in contradictory terms, which changes depending on the season and the asker.

items.name: Elixir of Strength
items.description: Temporarily makes you hit like someone twice your size. Side effects include overconfidence and involuntary flexing.

items.name: Bristlemail Circlet
items.description: The brow-ridge of some deeply thoughtful Cinder Shade, judging by the wear. Keeps you awake through endless councils. Scholars credit the design. It's the heat.

items.name: The Worldheart
items.description: Soled with something pulled from the deepest part of the fracture, still faintly pulsing on a rhythm nobody's matched to a heartbeat exactly, but nobody's ruled it out either.

items.name: Blood Bricheton
items.description: Its eyes catch crimson after dark, and it takes a keen, sustained interest in your pulse. Healers call the habit worrying. Necromancers call it a compliment, and insist you should too.

items.name: Lumber Cleaver
items.description: Repurposed from a logging camp. Smells of pine sap and existential career changes. Surprisingly effective.

items.name: Sericumaureum
items.description: Spun by a matron who's been alive longer than most empires. Each strand is worth more than your entire inventory.

items.name: Hermitude's Reach
items.description: Strung with crab sinew. The arrows smell like low tide, which is both a disadvantage and a distraction.

items.name: Crabclaw Vest
items.description: Worn on the final rotation before the marches went quiet. It's still quiet.

items.name: Empyrean Sash
items.description: Its purpose was reconsidered after it was finished, and the maker stands by that, mostly.

items.name: Ramrage Warhelm
items.description: Decorated with ramrage horns. Doorways become a genuine test of the crowd's patience.

items.name: Choirforged Cuirass
items.description: Full plate protection in the shape of a baking apron. The frill is structural.

items.name: Plaguemo Plague Treads
items.description: Every footprint fades green after an hour. The plaguemo considers this a signature, not a symptom.

items.name: Yetifur Beastcaller
items.description: Bound in yeti pelt and scored with old calling-glyphs. Rap the ground three times and something turns up, usually cold and in a foul mood.

items.name: Scarab Greaves
items.description: Hammered out between musters, whenever the forges had iron to spare.

items.name: Woundholder
items.description: Fitted over the seam the Suture Priests worked hardest to close, so the wearer carries the repair around with them. It holds better on a chest than it did on the Scar.

items.name: Ember-Studded Belt
items.description: The magmooligan was on fire when this wool was sheared. The shearer was also on fire shortly after. The belt retains a cozy warmth and a faint sense of mutual regret.

items.name: Breachforged Circle
items.description: Worn on the counting hand of a Gate Watcher whose job was tallying breaches before they became a problem. It still counts. The extra beat of readiness it grants is the ring finishing the Watcher's job for you.

items.name: Grasploop
items.description: The last thing a great many climbers held before they stopped needing to hold anything.

items.name: Crackbound
items.description: Engineered by a Sundered Soldier quartermaster to keep working after it broke, which is either brilliant design or a very sad commentary on expectations. Both, probably.

items.name: Ember Core Scepter
items.description: An ember set in iron, comforting right up until the moment you notice the heat has never once stopped climbing. The old smiths have a phrase for that feeling. It does not translate kindly.

items.name: Groundswell
items.description: A rush of vigour that hits like the floor coming up to meet you, which it also might.

items.name: Tanjirite
items.description: Tanjirize that has undergone a transformation no botanist can explain and most prefer to leave unexamined.

items.name: Bag of Diamonds
items.description: The contents of this pouch could buy a small kingdom, though they make for rather disappointing throwing weapons.

items.name: Lunashell
items.description: Its Moonclaw plating is said to glow faintly on nights the moon shows, which this deep in the weald means never, so the claim is safe from testing.

items.name: Rat Bile
items.description: Extracted from the rat's spite gland. Scientists insist this gland doesn't exist. The rats disagree.

items.name: Orb of Purity
items.description: Every mother in the Palewood warns her children about the orb that lets you start over. One squeeze, and you're reborn spotless, innocent, and thoroughly clueless. Magical amnesia is still amnesia; it just has better manners.

items.name: Bread Leavening Agent
items.description: Makes bread rise with alchemical efficiency. Bakers consider this a miracle. Alchemists consider bakers easily impressed.

items.name: Ursine Judgment
items.description: Infused with bear rage and an unreasonable amount of body heat.

items.name: Draugature
items.description: A band of hardened leather forged in the unyielding cold of the barrow-tombs, threaded with the sinew of the restless dead who wander the frozen wastes.

items.name: Razmoket
items.description: The severed tail of a common sewer rat, still bearing traces of the filth it once dragged through dank tunnels.

items.name: Emberchant Tonic
items.description: Honey, herbs and a whisper of ash. Dissolves slowly enough to outlast the sermon.

items.name: Wispbrew
items.description: Rendered from a captured wisp. Flickers in and out like the thing it came from.

items.name: Densaragogis
items.description: A venom-dripping fang wrenched from the Spider Queen's maw. The toxin coating its surface shifts between purple and black, dissolving anything it touches.

items.name: Woolice Heart Amulet
items.description: Grown by a three-time champion who never once had to try.

items.name: Ensable Warden's Hourglass
items.description: Runs backward more often than forward. No warranty, express or implied, comes with it.

items.name: Magmooligan's Ember Charm
items.description: A volcanic wool charm that radiates gentle warmth and smells faintly of sulphur and betrayal. The magmooligan from which it came was grazing peacefully near a lava flow when opportunity struck. Well. When you struck.

items.name: Hairsbreadth
items.description: There's a crack in the band you can't quite see. You will absolutely think about it constantly.

items.name: Wallbreach
items.description: Planted along the last wall pilgrims are permitted to cross, more boundary marker than weapon until someone tries to cross it anyway.

items.name: Ghostcap Fists
items.description: The mushroom caps on the knuckles glow brighter the harder you strike, turning a brawl into an unwanted light show.

items.name: Glacial Cinch
items.description: Forged from glacial heart alloy. Cinches tight and never loosens. Ask it nicely first.

items.name: Plainsteel
items.description: No engraving, no gilt, no clever name until someone else gave it one. The steel never asked for the attention.

items.name: Goldfleece Cummerbund
items.description: More attachment points than a show handler's tackle box. Also heavier than one.

items.name: Ember Shortbow
items.description: Arrows loosed from it glow the whole way to the target, which the fletcher calls beautiful and the archer calls the end of ever surprising anyone again.

items.name: Corvid Eye
items.description: Beady, black, and still seems to be watching. Apothecaries grind these for night-vision salves. Ethically murky.

items.name: Narthex Treads
items.description: Bristle mats lashed to the ankles. You will absorb everything the world wipes on you, and you will say welcome.

items.name: Shadowsteel Kneeguards
items.description: Salvaged from a shadow knight who knelt before the wrong altar. The kneeguards survived. The knight's career in organized darkness did not.

items.name: Depthring
items.description: A plain root-ring from the tiers below, worn by guides as a badge that means, roughly, has been down there and come back.

items.name: Skyheld Crest Godbone
items.description: Whoever made it changed their mind halfway through, a resolution that resolved very little.

items.name: Gobeline Ring
items.description: Dainty by goblin standards, which means it only has three sharp edges and one suspicious stain. The gemstone is a polished bit of coloured glass the goblin jeweller was extremely proud of. Pointing this out is considered a grave insult in goblin culture. Also a death sentence.

items.name: Laststep
items.description: The crown they hand the pilgrim who reaches the top, in the brief window before they understand what reaching the top actually costs.

items.name: Worldwound Carapace
items.description: Grown rather than forged, from a shell the Wound itself started and never finished. The gaps are exactly where it lost interest.

items.name: Ironbound Bread
items.description: Doubles as a shield in emergencies. Reviews call it 'rustic.' Reviews are being generous.

items.name: Throneless Sabatons Crown
items.description: It works, but only if you don't ask why, a distinction without much of a difference.

items.name: Compendium of Last Rites
items.description: Every entry logged before the burial. The margins are still being filled.

items.name: Glasswrought Fists
items.description: Padded for a pan that has never once been washed, on principle and for the seasoning.

items.name: Raven Flight
items.description: Fletched from feathers shed mid-dive. The arrows still remember which way is down.

items.name: Seraphbound Resin
items.description: It was logged as evidence in an argument nobody finished, so buyers are advised to judge for themselves.

items.name: Coronet Resin
items.description: Nobody can say for certain where this came from, and the case file was quietly closed, unresolved.

items.name: Quartz Cactee
items.description: A pale little cactus whose spines set into cloudy crystal. It hums quietly near ore veins, mostly to itself.

items.name: Wraith Lantern Shard
items.description: Broken off the lantern a wraith carries everywhere it drifts. The flame inside was never fire — it's memory, and memory, it turns out, burns considerably slower.

items.name: Schism Signet
items.description: The engraving lengthens by a hair each year, tracing the same widening line that split the Sundered Soldier's original rank insignia. Jewellers decline to appraise it twice.

items.name: Bara Hood
items.description: A plain hooded cowl offered in a spread of gemstone linings. Cheap, honest, everywhere.

items.name: Titan Koa Lance
items.description: Planted at the tomb line for three winters. Still points the same direction.

items.name: Talokan Tide Spear
items.description: The coral tip regenerates itself between battles. Nature's way of enabling your habits.

items.name: Bogforged Greataxe Fen
items.description: Forged for whoever descends to the Fen Below and expects to swing something on the way back up, which not many do.

items.name: Sabertooth Cleaver
items.description: The fang is the blade. The handle is just there for moral support.

items.name: Voidwalker Boots
items.description: Grown, not stitched, on the legs of a Voidmoth that learned to step between one patch of nothing and the next. Side effects include a faint hum in the ears and an unshakeable sense of having forgotten something.

items.name: Slothfur Tassets
items.description: So comfortable, three soldiers fell asleep mid-battle wearing them. Command was not amused.

items.name: Scalehide Cowl
items.description: Part hood, part crown, wholly undecided — no Cinder Shade silhouette ever commits to one shape either. The indecision is load-bearing.

items.name: Breachforged Philter
items.description: Bottled by whichever Gate Watcher drew the fifth shift, back when shifts still ended. Tastes like standing still for a very long time.

items.name: Faultbar
items.description: Cast with a hairline crack down the middle, sold as 'character'. It holds. Mostly.

items.name: Goblin Loot Bag
items.description: A tiny burlap sack full of stolen trinkets. Mostly buttons, a chicken bone, and someone's regrettable love letter.

items.name: Frostfang Bow
items.description: Loosed once, and every wolf for a mile answers back.

items.name: Emberchant Composite
items.description: Layered while singing, because the old smiths swore it set the grain. It set the grain. Nobody knows why.

items.name: Wheat
items.description: Peaceful farmers spend endless hours harvesting this grain, only for soldiers to burn it as siege kindling a week later.

items.name: Faultshell
items.description: Every seam is a place it could give. So far it hasn't. 'So far' is doing heavy lifting.

items.name: Crownless Cuisses
items.description: It functions under advisement, no refunds, no further questions entertained.

items.name: Diamantine Cactee
items.description: A crystalline cactus no larger than a fist, perpetually vibrating at a frequency that makes nearby glass nervous. It feeds on raw diamond and judges you silently for your mining technique.

items.name: Frostshamble Pendant
items.description: Mutters after dark. Refuses to specify what it wants until it's far too late.

items.name: Koa Eye Seal
items.description: The embedded eye sees things you'd rather it didn't, and judges your choices freely.

items.name: Cataclysm Tassets Faults
items.description: Named for how many cracks the Gate Watcher wearing them stepped over on a single patrol. The tenth crack is the one nobody counted.

items.name: Ukranize
items.description: This hardy wheat strains toward distant horizons, its fibers dyed the blue of cloudless skies and the gold of endless steppe.

items.name: Regalfall Tonic
items.description: Its effect kicks in, or it doesn't, unpredictably, so drink at your own risk, formally speaking.

items.name: Mireweald Carapace
items.description: Grown around its wearer over a full season, so it fits perfectly and comes off, when it must, the way bark comes off a tree.

items.name: Bag of Duskite
items.description: Old miners' rhyme: what duskite takes, duskite keeps, and the light goes in and never sleeps. Mostly it just means the bag is heavier than it looks and cheaper than it should be.

items.name: Velkarion Breath
items.description: A fireplace iron that once stirred the great pyre itself. It has opinions about your kindling arrangement.

items.name: Seraphic Amalgam
items.description: Two separate reports describe it in contradictory terms, which the survey team still argues about.

items.name: Legweight
items.description: Heavier than regulation, on the theory that a leg too tired to run is a leg that stays put and fights.

items.name: Bag of Aloe Vera
items.description: A once-respectable container now oozing a viscous botanical secretion from every seam, the inevitable consequence of confining fifty aloe vera specimens in a space designed for considerably fewer gelatinous plants. Alchemists maintain with admirable conviction that its therapeutic properties increase with compression, a claim that the bag's exterior — slick, malodorous, and faintly pulsating — does little to support.

items.name: Diving Crude Grips
items.description: Down in the flooded shaft they hold anything with a grip no living hand should manage. Up here, they hold your patience just as hard — three days to dry, and every hour smells like a tide pool having a difficult week.

items.name: Endpour
items.description: The last thing you distil from a spent quake. Bitter, potent, and disinclined to keep still.

items.name: Bogmother's Blessing
items.description: Blessed by something that lives in the deepest part of the swamp. You don't want to meet it.

items.name: Lavachitin Visor
items.description: Smells permanently of campfire and questionable choices. Blocks most of both.

items.name: Shark Scale Tassets
items.description: Shark fin scales on the thighs. You are now aerodynamic underwater. Legally, a fish.

items.name: Snareweft
items.description: Ties a wraith to this plane. Cut it and watch several of your problems evaporate at once.

items.name: Yeti's Frostbite
items.description: Carved from a yeti's claws mid-blizzard. Every cut comes with a complimentary chill.

items.name: Emberspice
items.description: A spiced flour that transforms any recipe into something a food critic would describe as aggressively aromatic.

items.name: Chancel
items.description: The armour of the inner sanctum, where only the trusted stand. Trust is issued sparingly and revoked fast.

items.name: Gilded Tassets
items.description: Its origin story changes depending on who tells it, and the difference stopped mattering somewhere along the way.

items.name: Crazy Belt
items.description: A goblin's belt, dyed deep red with pigments that definitely aren't berry juice.

items.name: Frost Recurve
items.description: A recurve bow infused with glacial essence. The arrows freeze in flight. So do the archer's fingers.

items.name: Highguard
items.description: Held overhead by the wall's sentries so long the stance has its own name in three languages, none of them flattering.

items.name: Ranger's Longbow
items.description: A proper longbow made by someone who almost knew what they were doing. The 'almost' is load-bearing.

items.name: Frostshell Pendant
items.description: A polished frostshell fragment on a thorium chain. It radiates cold and mild trauma.

items.name: Whisper of Endings
items.description: Arrows fired from this bow arrive before the sound does. Targets rarely get to complain.

items.name: Alchemical Base
items.description: The foundation of all alchemical work. Smells like wet library and broken promises. Every craft chain starts here.

items.name: Bogoak
items.description: The innermost ring of a tree that grew through a battlefield. Counts more than years.

items.name: Bag of Draconite
items.description: Hot to the touch and growling faintly. The last courier left a one-star review and no forwarding address.

items.name: Vitrified Edge
items.description: Cooled slow so the glass wouldn't shatter. It kept the patience and lost the mercy.

items.name: Wooling Fleece
items.description: A tuft of greasy wool ripped from a lamb that absolutely did not consent. Smells like regret and barn floor.

items.name: Chieftain's Idol
items.description: A carved bone fetish crackling with residual power. The chief carried this into battle. It didn't help him.

items.name: Toll of the Oracle
items.description: Measured out by the Wound Oracle, who never explains the dose and has never yet been wrong about it. Trust is the only ingredient you supply.

items.name: Abyssgrown Cuirass
items.description: It kept growing after it was fitted, which the wearer discovered the day it stopped fitting and started, gently, insisting.

items.name: Splintervest
items.description: Layered from failed blades. Each one broke doing its job; you get to finish theirs.

items.name: Spark Ring
items.description: A copper loop with a lodestone heart that throws off sparks whenever its wearer is angry, anxious, or thinking too hard about supper. The enchanter called it a mood ring. The village calls it a fire hazard.

items.name: Frostkoa's Croak
items.description: Cut from a spine that let out one last, very committed croak.

items.name: Leadweight
items.description: Heavier than it needs to be for the job, and the job has never once complained about the surplus.

items.name: The Last Argument
items.description: When talking stops working, this is the next sentence. Talking rarely works out here.

items.name: Void Oracle
items.description: Sees all possible futures. Most involve you dying. It shows you anyway.

items.name: Seraphbound Stompers
items.description: The wearer swears by it; everyone else has doubts, so the debate was tabled indefinitely.

items.name: Antiphon Visor Verse
items.description: Drains soup, lava and ambition with the same even-handed efficiency. Chin strap included.

items.name: Shadow Knight's Signet
items.description: The inscription inside translates, roughly, to a threat. The shadow knights insist it's a promise.

items.name: Copper Hoe
items.description: Copper's cheapest farm tool, and every copper tool in the fen ends up wearing the exact same shade of green, whether it wants to or not.

items.name: Soulbinder
items.description: Distilled from what lingers after a revenant is finally put down. Used to hold spirit-bound gear together.

items.name: Throneless Lattice
items.description: It was logged as evidence in an argument nobody finished, and the report was filed anyway, caveats included.

items.name: Choirforged Helm
items.description: Cast iron, family size. The dent on the left is from the last owner having an opinion.

items.name: Silk-Bound Lexicon
items.description: Bound in silkling cocoon thread. Half the spells are illegible, the other half are dangerous.

items.name: Neckoath
items.description: Worn by pilgrims who swore to reach the wall or die trying. Most of them are still wearing it.

items.name: Silkspinner Stompers
items.description: Raises the wearer clear of the worst of the silt. The worst of it still finds a way up.

items.name: Blindspot
items.description: The slit shows you exactly what's in front. The floor was never in front.

items.name: Hollow Root Key
items.description: Grown, never cut, from a root the Rootmaw Tyrant keeps gnawing back into the dark.

items.name: Slothfur Hauberk
items.description: Two half-plates from two different Cinder Shades, forge-welded along a seam that still glows faintly on cold nights. Neither half remembers agreeing to this.

items.name: Ghostcap Flail
items.description: Its head is a hardened ghost-cap that lights up on the backswing, telling the target exactly when to flinch and never quite letting them.

items.name: Stormhowl
items.description: Each arrow screams on the way to its target. The neighbors have complained.

items.name: Loadbearing
items.description: Takes the strain so your spine doesn't. Your spine remains unconvinced and vocal about it.

items.name: Regalfall Legguards
items.description: Its warranty is void the moment you question it, a detail everyone involved has agreed to forget.

items.name: Bristlemail Pants
items.description: Sitting down in tusker leather is, technically, an act of faith. The bristles disagree with the faith.

items.name: Underweald Elixir
items.description: Brewed from what grows at the bottom of the Fen Below, which heals well and tastes like exactly where it came from.

items.name: Matriarch Tusk
items.description: Torn from the Great Ashback Tusker after a fight the herd still talks about. The earth remembers being hit that hard; it has forgiven no one since.

items.name: Cinder Waistguard
items.description: Never once cold in the hand. The whole set runs a fever, politely, together.

items.name: Gecko Tail Segment
items.description: Detached voluntarily by the gecko, still wriggling. Use it in alchemy or watch it dance. Your call.

items.name: Warblade of the Climb
items.description: Reforged so many times the smiths lost the original under the repairs. Whatever it started as, it is now entirely made of the intent to keep swinging.

items.name: Worldsteel
items.description: Adamant folded into steel by smiths who insist the metal has to agree to it first. The successful batches do seem oddly willing.

items.name: Yetihide Stompers
items.description: Boots lined with yeti fur. Guaranteed to keep your feet warm and your enemies at bay. The smell alone is a weapon.

items.name: Fractured Draugr Amulet
items.description: A cracked charm of draugr provenance, its runic inlays splintered across aged bone.

items.name: Phacochef's Tusk
items.description: A colossal tusk shattered from Phacochef's skull during its final charge. The impact crater where it broke off is reportedly still smoking.

items.name: Moonwomb
items.description: Grew a hollow at its heart that the wearer swears holds a drop of water older than the weald. It refuses to evaporate, which supports the claim.

items.name: Copper Sickle
items.description: Copper oxidizes into a green patina within a week. Herbalists find this aesthetically appropriate. The copper does not have opinions.

items.name: Glacial Fortress Greaves
items.description: Moving in these is a full workout. Standing still is also a full workout.

items.name: Draugr crown
items.description: Wearing it grants neither authority nor respect, though it does an excellent job of concealing a receding hairline.

items.name: Deadweight
items.description: Heavy on purpose. In a world where you can float away, that is a comfort, not a complaint.

items.name: Farpoint
items.description: Sighted for a target the wielder can barely see yet. By the time it lands, that's no longer true.

items.name: Glacial Recurve
items.description: Strung with frozen sinew that never loosens, unlike your grip when it fires.

items.name: Mireweald Tassets
items.description: Living plating that photosynthesizes what little light reaches it, which is nothing, so it slowly eats the wearer instead. Slowly.

items.name: Sanguine Orchid
items.description: This crimson orchid retains its vivid hue even after prolonged baking, its petals as thick as cured leather.

items.name: Tattleglint
items.description: Glitters in darkness which makes it easy to find and impossible to hide from tax collectors.

items.name: Miregavel
items.description: Named for the way it settles arguments in the weald's deeper reaches, which is to say permanently. The Gloom Piper composed a song about it; nobody enjoys hearing it.

items.name: Koa Slime
items.description: Viscous frog mucus that slides off containers and coats everything else. Alchemists love it. Everyone else hates you.

items.name: Ocean Sigil Buckle
items.description: Knotted with sailor's precision and a touch of magical incompetence.

items.name: Whittled Shortbow
items.description: Carved during a boring guard shift. The string is made of braided grass. Effective range: your imagination.

items.name: Crimson Brick
items.description: A blood-red brick that radiates warmth hours after leaving the furnace. Staff carvers core it into wand housings.

items.name: Bag of Arcaneshrooms
items.description: Fifty arcaneshrooms consolidated into a vessel that hums with such concentrated residual magic that it has developed its own feeble gravitational field, causing small objects to drift toward it with the inevitability of moths toward a particularly bookish flame. The bag occasionally levitates when left unattended, which its owner must then explain to increasingly skeptical innkeepers.

items.name: Glasswrought Claymore
items.description: Rings a clear high note on impact. The note is the last thing several people ever heard.

items.name: Emberchant Breastplate Voices
items.description: Eight layers of batting between you and the world. The world takes the hint.

items.name: Seraphbound Loop
items.description: The design went through several irreconcilable drafts, which is technically true and completely unhelpful.

items.name: Pulvisarcanum
items.description: Purple flour that levitates briefly when disturbed. Bakers have learned to work quickly before their ingredients achieve sentience.

items.name: Cindergrip
items.description: Quenched in the cold that pools at the fracture floor at dawn. They never quite lose the chill, which the wearer learns to stop noticing.

items.name: Beltway
items.description: Wide enough to hang a small armoury from. The wearer usually does, then regrets the weight.

items.name: Wind Koa
items.description: Wind Koa: a koa so aerodynamic it occasionally forgets to stay — tethered with a string, mostly, and it hums when the pressure drops just to gloat about being right.

items.name: Elixir of Agility
items.description: Liquid reflexes, cat-grade. Decision-making not included, and it shows almost immediately.

items.name: Wolfhide Cuirass
items.description: Bronze plates over timberwolf hide. The wolf's final howl is supposedly preserved in the metal — though most wearers report hearing nothing but their own heavy breathing after the third flight of stairs.

items.name: Tusk-Spine Gauntlets
items.description: Tusklet quills mounted on leather palms. Every handshake becomes a negotiation. Every pat on the back becomes a declaration of war. The crafting process involved pulling spines from a very angry creature, which explains why the gauntlets seem to radiate residual resentment.

items.name: Parrot Hat
items.description: It is a parrot. On your head. It does not talk, which is somehow worse.

items.name: Moonseal
items.description: A ring of Moonclaw shell that stays cool even in the fever-warmth of the deep weald, which the wearer clings to more than they admit.

items.name: Ember Core
items.description: A tiny sun trapped in mineral. Burns through pouches. Experienced adventurers carry these in clay pots.

items.name: Halfturn
items.description: Too heavy to swing twice in the time most weapons manage three. The first swing is generally the only one that matters.

items.name: Relic of Rrexn
items.description: The maker's notes consist entirely of crossed-out ideas, and somehow that's still considered a success.

items.name: Ghostcap Carapace
items.description: Studded with ghost-cap mushrooms that keep glowing after the wearer stops moving, which is a poor trait in a hiding place and a worse one in a coffin.

items.name: Frost Shard Spear
items.description: A frost shard mounted on thorium. It never thaws, which makes holding it a character-building experience.

items.name: Worldwound Edge
items.description: Drawn across the same line reality tore along when the Scar first opened. The wound remembers what shape the cut left; the blade remembers the wound.

items.name: Plague Fang Signet
items.description: The jeweller who set this fang into a ring setting wore gloves. Then thicker gloves. Then tongs. The fang seemed to take it personally.

items.name: Firstbrew
items.description: One of the last recipes written down before the alchemists stopped writing anything down. It works; the marginal note explaining why does not survive.

items.name: Ghosthide Warblade
items.description: Smithed to the pattern a Cinder Shade's own claw-ridge left in cooling lava, which is either brilliant reverse engineering or a coincidence nobody's willing to test twice.

items.name: Fendepth
items.description: Recovered from the layer the guides call the Fen Below, which they say more to warn you off than to give directions.

items.name: Wolf Sinew
items.description: Elastic and tough. Bowyers pay top coin for these. The wolf's opinion on the matter is no longer relevant.

items.name: Mireglow
items.description: Sealed against water that never fully drains out of them, so each step lands with a small, private squelch only the wearer hears.

items.name: Fracture Cordial
items.description: Fermented in a Riftling nest, in a shell that never fully closed. It heals slowly and asks nothing back, which around here borders on suspicious.

items.name: Highgreaves
items.description: Reinforced at the shin for the last stretch of the climb, where the mountain stops offering handholds and starts taking them back.

items.name: Weight of the Vigil
items.description: Issued to whoever draws the longest watch at the summit, on the reasoning that a heavier helm keeps the head from nodding off. It does. Mostly by hurting.

items.name: Raptorscale Greaves
items.description: The donor raptor objected at roughly forty miles an hour. It did not catch up.

items.name: Anglerbone
items.description: Strung from an Anglerqueen's own spine-bones, still faintly luminous in full dark. Convenient for navigation. Less convenient for staying hidden.

items.name: Antiphon Poultice
items.description: Twelve herbs, twelve prayers, one paste. Nobody remembers which herb does the work, and it may be none.

items.name: Sparkweave Handwraps
items.description: Turns every handshake into a minor safety briefing.

items.name: Pyre Walkers
items.description: Soled thick enough to cross the coal beds at a normal pace. Normal, for this posting.

items.name: Emberchant Breastplate Verse
items.description: Pulled off the altar table in one clean yank. The candlesticks never noticed.

items.name: Worldwound Circle
items.description: A band bent from a single filament of wound-metal, closed so seamlessly you can't tell where it started. The metal can. It resents it.

items.name: Mirefang
items.description: Wavy-bladed like a Mire Creeper's own fang, honestly because that's exactly what it's cast from. Slides in easier than it should.

items.name: Nerak Crypt Key
items.description: Bone, etched with runes that mutter threats in languages nobody living speaks anymore. The dead don't much care for visitors. Their locks, it turns out, feel exactly the same way.

items.name: Genesis Greataxe
items.description: Heavy enough that the first swing settles most disputes and the second is mostly for the record. There is rarely a third.

items.name: Steadyhand
items.description: Stops the tremor the Scar gives everyone eventually. Only the hand. The remainder of the shaking is your problem.

items.name: Fenrik's Legguards
items.description: Skinned from the pack's leader. The rest of the pack still sends thank-you cards, unprompted.

items.name: Sky Shard Diadem
items.description: Worn by whoever last carried the ashen standard. The role rotates often.

items.name: Emberseed
items.description: A spark that refuses to die, reigniting in your pocket. Fire mages use them as lighters. Safety hazard.

items.name: Glosscoat
items.description: Crystal-clear finishing coat for jewelry and fine metalwork. Gives everything that 'freshly looted from a boss' shine.

items.name: Tanjirize Rod
items.description: A pilgrim's walking stick that wandered too close to the Wound and came back changed. It still works fine for walking. It does other things too now.

items.name: Stormfeather Coif
items.description: The archaeopteryx that shed these feathers left, in essence, a promise of future revenge.

items.name: Zenithseal
items.description: The publisher's mark at the back outlived the publisher, the print house, and most of the language the book was written in.

items.name: Lavachitin Locket
items.description: Holds one ember that refuses, on principle, to go out.

items.name: Abyssal Codex
items.description: A spellbook dredged from the deep sea. The waterlogged pages somehow still turn.

items.name: Himalayan Wheat
items.description: High-altitude harvest blessed with ancient inscriptions to survive the long winter storage.

items.name: Drownmarked Saber
items.description: Curved to match the water it was quenched in, so it cuts along the current and fights anyone who swings it against.

items.name: Rexbone Warhammer
items.description: Studded with rex fangs and braced with shark fin. Substitutes finesse for raw blunt force. The results speak for themselves. Loudly.

items.name: Cursed Bricheton
items.description: The apex companion of the farmer profession, a warthog so steeped in agricultural malediction that crops wilt as it passes.

items.name: Feathergilt Visor Crown
items.description: It agrees to function, under written protest, so the disagreement was quietly absorbed into the design.

items.name: Fen Trident
items.description: Three prongs coated in fen muck. The smell alone keeps most enemies at bay. Allies too unfortunately.

items.name: Enka Muru Hood
items.description: A traveller’s hood stitched for long roads and short conversations.

items.name: Deepbreath
items.description: Fits snug enough that drawing a full breath takes conscious effort. Most wearers stop noticing by the second week.

items.name: Inferno Pendant
items.description: The stone at its center hasn't cooled since the pyres were first lit.

items.name: Embalmed Legguards
items.description: Your legs are mummified and, somehow, extremely well accessorized.

items.name: Saurian Fangblade
items.description: Pack-hunter honed. Alone, it's just very sharp; it prefers company.

items.name: Sparkweave Leggings
items.description: Electrical discharge is technically included. It was never, in any version, meant to be a feature.

items.name: Firstband
items.description: Older than the finger it's meant for by a margin that makes the wearer feel briefly, healthily small.

items.name: Cursed Helm
items.description: A cursed helm that dulls the mind while fortifying the body. It grants life through the loss of clarity, a bargain written in paradox.

items.name: Sparkweave Sandals
items.description: Leaves glowing footprints. Stealth was never really the plan here.

items.name: Throneless Draught
items.description: It tastes like a decision made too quickly, and the brewer still refuses to pick a side.

items.name: Feranpelt Treads
items.description: Worn by a Cinder Shade that hauled ore up a slope that shouldn't have been climbable while smoldering the whole way. Doesn't tire. Does occasionally smoke.

items.name: Shedlight
items.description: Salvaged from a Riftling molt that never fully hardened. Bends at angles a knee shouldn't, which is the point — the ground here doesn't stay flat long enough to argue with.

items.name: Gilded Philter
items.description: The recipe was argued over more than it was brewed, which the label discloses in very small print.

items.name: Eternwool Band
items.description: Cut from the same batch as a hundred others. This one came back.

items.name: Coronet Poultice
items.description: Whoever bottled it never settled on a final version, and nobody has asked for a refund, yet.

items.name: Diving Visor
items.description: Crafted from a crab that fought three fishermen and a seagull before going down. The visor still clamps shut unexpectedly, which the crafter insists is a feature.

items.name: Faultline Grips
items.description: Molded on a Riftling's forelimb the day the sky over the faultline finally gave up pretending to be solid. Grip strength triples. Depth perception does not survive the trade.

items.name: Emberwalk Striders
items.description: Let you cross a bed of live coals unbothered. Crossing back is a separate purchase.

items.name: Backswing
items.description: The return stroke does more work than the intended one. The smith calls that a feature. The wielder calls it a surprise.

items.name: Sapling Channeler
items.description: Carved from a sapling that hadn't yet chosen what it wanted to be. The kweebecs consider the whole staff a hostage situation. You consider it a weapon. Nobody's fully wrong.

items.name: Arcanite
items.description: Hums with residual magic that makes compasses spin and wizards insufferably smug.

items.name: Tide Shard
items.description: A crystallized fragment of living ocean that drips constantly. Smells like salt and unfinished business.

items.name: Alphafang Visage
items.description: Worn during the long shifts. The smell never fully washes out.

items.name: Velkarion Ember
items.description: A splinter of the dragon own flame, kept in a jam jar. If it goes out, the whole cathedral needs relighting.

items.name: Hadean Ichor
items.description: The blood of the void itself. Anyone who touches it without protective enchantments forgets their own name. Temporarily.

items.name: Chantmarked Legguards Voices
items.description: Ironed to a crease that could open letters. Sitting down would be vandalism.

items.name: Elixir of Chance
items.description: Distilled probability. Improves your stat sheet. Your actual luck remains, tragically, unchanged.

items.name: Weighted Club
items.description: Someone shoved rocks inside a hollow log and called it engineering. It works. Physics doesn't care about elegance.

items.name: Pyre Chain Girdle
items.description: Links that idle warm and turn hot the second you fight. It keeps your trousers up and your enemies wary.

items.name: Hymnbound Girdle Choir
items.description: Cinches you into the choir's posture: chest out, chin up, an easy target for anyone below.

items.name: Shadowsteel Iron Warhelm
items.description: The smith who forged this helm worked exclusively by moonlight, claiming the shadows whispered the design to him. The shadows also whispered the price. It was not reasonable.

items.name: Obsidian Extract
items.description: Polish for the great ranges. The shine lasts a week; the smell lasts a marriage.

items.name: Shoddy Spear
items.description: A pointy stick with delusions of military service. The tip wobbles but commitment is everything.

items.name: Fengland Stompers
items.description: Warms you in winter. Tracks you at night. The set is always, somehow, watching.

items.name: Sunscale Longblade
items.description: A reliable blade warmed by ashskin scales. Does exactly what you expect. In a world of surprises, that is worth something.

items.name: Scalehide Cuirass
items.description: Worn by a Cinder Shade that hauled goods along the fault roads and never once got mugged, on account of the smell. Trade caravans still hire the pattern, if not the source.

items.name: Webweaver Boots
items.description: Impossibly light, woven from the silk of spiders that were bribed with flies to cooperate. The arrangement lasted exactly long enough to finish one pair. The cobbler's assistant is still in therapy.

items.name: Arcane Bread
items.description: Baked in bulk, blessed once, questioned never. Keeps a column moving.

items.name: Moltglass
items.description: Set with a sliver of a Riftling's shed shell, still faintly warm from a molt that finished weeks ago. Catches light wrong, on purpose, same as the creature that grew it.

items.name: Binding Paste
items.description: Adhesive compound that bonds organic and mineral materials. Armorsmiths and tailors buy this faster than alchemists can brew it.

items.name: Maw Crusher Fists
items.description: Its behavior contradicts its own description, which is either a design flaw or the entire point.

items.name: Palebrew
items.description: Named for a moon that never reaches this deep, which the brewer finds poetic and the drinker finds a warning, correctly.

items.name: Bag of Sanguine Orchids
items.description: A leather pouch containing fifty sanguine orchids packed so tightly that the bag has been stained a deep and permanent crimson from within, as though it were the scene of a very small and very botanical crime. Opening it releases a perfume that is equal parts metallic sweetness and quiet menace.

items.name: Arcane Spore
items.description: Saturated with raw magic to the point of permanent agitation, it hums at a pitch that shatters nearby glass and rearranges scholars' footnotes without asking. The one safety rule handed down for handling it: don't sneeze.

items.name: Embermaw Gauntlets
items.description: Residual heat from cinder heart fragments makes these gauntlets uncomfortably warm. Like a handshake from a fever patient.

items.name: Duke's Rapier
items.description: Lifted from a goblin duke who swore, loudly and often, that he only ever used it to scratch his back. Not one soul in the court believed him, and every one of them let him keep telling it.

items.name: Scalehide Casque
items.description: Peripheral vision traded for a jaw that stops most things.

items.name: Mirestain
items.description: Stained by mire-water to a black that swallows candlelight, worn by those who would rather their hands not catch the eye.

items.name: Hollow Mace
items.description: Carved from a femur that outlived its owner and is not shy about it.

items.name: Windwalker Vest
items.description: Light enough to keep pace with the column. The march drummers wore nothing heavier.

items.name: Mireiron
items.description: Bog-iron cooked down and folded until it holds an edge, which it does grudgingly and only for those who earned it the hard way.

items.name: Crude Branch
items.description: One man's kindling is another man's legendary crafting component, apparently.

items.name: Halfrank
items.description: Issued to Sundered Soldiers who are, technically, still on the roster. Mends what it can and is honest about the rest.

items.name: Firstweave
items.description: Ringed from wire drawn before anyone thought to record how. The technique died with its smith; the hauberk, so far, has outlived the loss.

items.name: Voidripe
items.description: A concentrate that grew denser on its own after bottling, so an old vial hits harder than a fresh one and the label never keeps up.

items.name: Key of the Goblin's cave
items.description: This rusted iron key hums with faint enchantments, granting its bearer passage past the concealed wards guarding the Goblin King's treasure trove.

items.name: Yeast
items.description: A virulent strain of parasitic fungus that burrows into flesh and refuses to let go.

items.name: Great Woolame
items.description: This longsword was pulled from the glistening remains of a wooligan's last meal, its metal strangely preserved by the creature's potent stomach acids. A thorough cleaning is strongly recommended before use.

items.name: Skybound Ring
items.description: Fired in the pyre pits until the metal remembered nothing else.

items.name: Scarak Overlord Ring
items.description: Standard-issue to the tomb wards. Doesn't tarnish; nothing in the barrows does.

items.name: Corvid Clutch
items.description: Finger-guards molded on the forelimbs of an ember-carrier Cinder Shade: one continent crossed, zero embers dropped. Whatever you hold stays held until the Shade would have let go.

items.name: Seraph Heart Pendant
items.description: This amulet undoes itself with quiet insistence. It is simultaneously here and elsewhere, worn and discarded, real and disputed.

items.name: Vitrified Tear
items.description: Sheet glass cooled on the volcano own schedule. The bubbles are called character.

items.name: Tempest Requiem
items.description: Each arrow carries the small thunderstorm an Ash Prophet saw coming three verses before it arrived. The extra reach isn't strength. It's knowing where the wind will be standing.

items.name: Godflesh Plate
items.description: Its warranty is void the moment you question it, and the second draft never materialized.

items.name: Stillbead
items.description: Beads on a cord that click softly when the wearer breathes, a comfort in the silent deep until you realize they click a beat after each breath, not with it.

items.name: Icebreaker
items.description: Pulled from beneath the ice where the Frost Dragon sleeps. Cold enough to hurt, warm enough to still work.

items.name: Verger Teaspoon
items.description: The verger lucky teaspoon on a loop of twine. Stir your tea with it and the minute politely waits for you to finish.

items.name: Phacochef Den Key
items.description: Carved from a warthog tusk and sealed with mud. Smells exactly how you'd expect a key to a pig dungeon to smell.

items.name: Firstlight Halberd
items.description: Long enough to keep the Wound's edge at exactly the distance the Wall Fragments consider survivable. The measurement is precise and non-negotiable.

items.name: Cursed Gaia
items.description: The apex companion of the herbalist profession, a Gaia so thoroughly permeated by cursed fungal energy that it murmurs unsolicited commentary about the weight distribution of its owner's inventory in languages that predate recorded history. It is an unparalleled beast of burden whose loyalty is absolute and whose nocturnal whispering is, according to those who have survived prolonged ownership, something one eventually stops hearing.

items.name: Pyrehymn Cuirass
items.description: Fired, not forged. It came out of the furnace already sick of your problems.

items.name: Throneless Sabatons Halo
items.description: It was built to prove a point nobody remembers, a footnote the maker never got around to writing.

items.name: Slothian Wisdom Stone
items.description: A moss-covered stone that hums with ancient knowledge. It knows the answers. It just doesn't think you're ready.

items.name: Venomfang Razors
items.description: Coated twice in gland extract and once, unofficially, in bad decisions.

items.name: Haloforged Carapace
items.description: The design went through several irreconcilable drafts, so the original complaint was never formally withdrawn.

items.name: Ukranize Bricheton
items.description: Bred, the herders say, from a beast that once carried a starving village across three winters without complaint. It hasn't complained since. It also hasn't once let you pack light.

items.name: Scarecrow's Last Straw
items.description: A vow sworn by something that technically lacks a mouth. It has kept the vow anyway, out of spite.

items.name: Tyrant's Gavel
items.description: Used to pass sentence on deserters. The marches had a great many.

items.name: Bag of Burnt Wheat
items.description: Opening this bag releases a smoky fragrance and the faint impression that someone made a terrible agricultural decision.

items.name: Fen Reaper
items.description: Harvests reed and bone with equal patience. The marsh never runs short of either.

items.name: Momaku Cloak
items.description: A spirit-mask banner draped down the back to frighten debtors and impress no one already dead.

items.name: Throneless Pendant Crown
items.description: The wearer insists it works; the evidence is inconclusive, no refunds, no further questions entertained.

items.name: Bristlemail Talisman
items.description: The eye blinks on its own schedule. You've decided not to think about that.

items.name: Halftoken
items.description: Half a unit medallion of the Sundered Soldiers, issued in pairs that were never meant to part. The other half is out there, presumably still working on completing the set.

items.name: Jade Powder
items.description: A fine green powder that stains everything it touches including your reputation as a clean miner.

items.name: Chantmarked Crusher
items.description: Institutional grade. What it did to the potatoes, it will do to morale.

items.name: Coldopen
items.description: The frozen core of a yeti's chest, containing enough cold to freeze a lake. It already has.

items.name: Cinder Heart
items.description: Pulled still-molten from a firesteel golem's chest, hot enough to serve as a whole forge on its own. Anvils set too close simply melt. The forge-cult has stopped calling this an accident.

items.name: Cinder Fists
items.description: One finger-snap away from being the other five pieces' problem too.

items.name: Frostshamble Tidestaff
items.description: Wrapped in frostshamble silk and crowned with a glacial core. Hums with the rhythm of distant tides. Useless for swimming.
